YOR TO HERSELF[1]

Yor Forger (ヨル・フォージャー, Yoru Fōjā?), née Briar (ブライア, Buraia?) is one of the main characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. While she works as an ordinary office clerk at Berlint City Hall, she also leads a secret life as a Garden assassin under the code name "Thorn Princess" (〈いばら姫〉, <Ibara-hime>?).

Needing a cover to continue her job as an assassin, Yor enters a fake marriage with Loid Forger with the intention of fulfilling both of their respective goals and subsequently becomes the adoptive mother of his daughter, Anya.


Appearance

Yor is a very beautiful, graceful, and fairly tall woman in her late twenties, with a slender, curvaceous frame. She has long, straight, black hair reaching her mid-back with short bangs framing her forehead and upturned red eyes.

At home, Yor generally wears a semi-backless red off-shoulder sweater with black tights, a red skirt, and brown-heeled ankle boots. She wears a white headband and a pair of dangling gold earrings in the shape of small spikes. When going outside, Yor typically wears a long beige (sometimes looking like a pale pink) coat with black buttons over the chest. She splits her hair into two parts and crosses it over her head, securing it with a headband and forming two thick locks of hair that reach below her chest.[7]

At Berlint City Hall, Yor wears the standard work uniform. It consists of a long-sleeved white shirt with a sleeveless green vest over it, a knee-length green office skirt, and black heels.

As an assassin, Yor wears a form-fitting, halter-style black dress that shows off her shoulders and chest, with a rose choker and a red rose pattern on the inside of her skirt. The front of the skirt is mid-thigh length, while the back reaches below her knees. She also wears a pair of black thigh-high boots with a rose symbol at the bottom of their sole and black fingerless gloves. The headband Yor wears is gold-colored with a rose and two spikes on each side. Her weapons are of the same color as well. In this attire, Yor would occasionally wear red lipstick, and her hairstyle is similar to the one she wears as a civilian but in a more elaborate updo formed from braids wrapping around her head.

Yor's assassin dress was the only good dress she had before marrying Loid. When attending her co-worker Camilla's party, Yor wore the dress under a shawl, a white headband with a flower design and jewelry on its right side over her hair, and short black heels instead of the usual thigh-high boots. After marrying into the Forger family, she purchased more formal wear to better present herself for Eden Academy's admissions interview.[8] However, Yor still continues to wear her black dress as a cocktail attire, for example, on board Princess Lorelei.

As a child, Yor had shorter hair that reached just below chin-length, similar to the current hairstyle of her younger brother, Yuri.[9] As she grew up, she gradually grew out her hair to her current length.
Personality

Yor is glad she married Loid
Yor's kind nature
Yor lacks social skills and initially comes across as a somewhat aloof individual, interacting minimally with her co-workers and being rather straightforward, described as robotic by Camilla. Similarly, Yor is remarkably collected and able to keep her composure during combat. She is incredibly polite, to the point of asking her assassination targets for "the honor of taking their lives." Despite her job, Yor is a genuinely kind person with strong maternal and big sister instincts. After becoming a family with Loid and Anya, Yor becomes more expressive and opens up to her co-workers, asking for help on being a better wife or cooking. On one occasion, after getting drunk with her co-workers, she is described in thought by several, including Camilla, as being "adorable" and "pure."

Yor is protective of her faux family, especially towards Anya, whom she has no trouble defending with extreme violence. By contrast, however, she appears not to be bothered in the slightest by the almost comically brutal acts of murder she commits on a regular basis. Although she seems to believe that all her targets deserve their fate, she tries to kill everyone quickly so as not to provide unnecessary torment. She has similarly little regard for her own life and noted at least once that if someone managed to kill her on a job, she would view it as entirely fair.

Due to spending most of her life as an assassin, Yor's ways of thinking are often highly deviant. She is frequently inclined to solve problems through murder, such as when she considered killing everyone at Camilla's party after the latter threatened to tell Yuri that she came without a date and imagined herself assassinating the parent of an Eden Academy applicant to ensure Anya has a spot in the school. She also briefly considered killing Fiona Frost when she believed her to be competition for her role as the family's mother and Loid's romantic affections. She is, however, well aware that these thoughts are not to be acted upon and is always seen chiding herself for having them afterward. She appears to have a deep aesthetic appreciation of bladed implements and was seen to be captivated at one point by a painting of a guillotine, and at another by a table knife.

Loid and Yor's imagination of dogs
Because of her job, Yor imagined pet dogs as ferocious
Somewhat counterintuitively, Yor can be extremely naive and gullible. Despite her professional competence, Yor has a startling lack of common sense and is rather clueless when it comes to nearly all situations outside her assassin work. For instance, she once asked if boogers made coffee taste better in response to Millie's suggestion that they put one in their superior's coffee and later believed Loid's explanation that the smugglers whom he attacked were his patients. Yor's first instinct with regard to solving everyday problems is seemingly to apply her assassin's skills and mindset to those problems. When that approach invariably fails, she is often left floundering, and this gives the impression of her being comically airheaded. For example, she once answered a question from Loid about Anya passing an exam by talking about causes of death, apparently confusing passing a school exam with passing away. At another point, Loid mentioned to Anya that dogs do not discern consonants well, and Yor somehow misinterpreted it as him saying that dogs do not discern between causes of death well. She then immediately proceeded to have a daydream about threatening Bond with various forms of death that he refused to choose between. What little common sense she does have disappears almost entirely under the influence of alcohol.

Anya thinks that Loid and Yor are flirting
Yor becomes flustered at Anya's suggestion of flirting with Loid
Her hyperfocus on her profession and lack of social skills have left her entirely clueless when it comes to romance. This is usually unimportant as romantic interactions between her and Loid are effectively non-existent; neither seems to have any genuine romantic inclinations towards the other. However, in the few instances where any sort of romantic intimacy between the two is even hinted at, Yor becomes extremely flustered and embarrassed. In one instance, when it seemed that she and Loid would have to kiss in front of Yuri to confirm that they were a genuinely loving couple, Yor had to down an entire bottle of wine to disinhibit herself enough to even attempt it. However, the wine only exacerbated her feelings of embarrassment, and she ended up semi-accidentally slapping Yuri across her living room twice in the span of as many minutes.

Yor kicks Loid
Yor kicks Loid in an inebriated and embarrassed state
On that note, Yor being drunk in situations in which she thinks that anything romantic is likely to occur never ends well. On one occasion, when Loid flirted with her in an attempt to deepen his cover, she became so flustered that she kicked him clear across a restaurant. During another such occasion, she incorrectly believed that she and Loid would share a welcome-home kiss after her co-workers suggested it during a dinner together. Extremely embarrassed at the thought of being kissed, her first instinct was to attack him, but she dimly remembered the aforementioned situation in which she previously injured him. Not wanting a repeat incident, she opted instead to fling herself violently to the floor while profusely apologizing to Loid for "being weird."

Yor imagines fighting Loid
Yor imagines herself fighting Loid to preserve her identity
As was previously alluded to, Yor is prone to having nonsensical flights of fancy, a tendency that appears to be significantly exacerbated when she is intoxicated. For instance, once after becoming drunk at a dinner with some of her female co-workers, they joked to her that wanting to kill one's husband over essentially nothing was normal. So, in an effort to appear normal, she picked up a table knife and strode to the restaurant door, all while having a daydream about asking the Shopkeeper for permission to kill Loid "for the sake of preserving her marriage." She then imagined herself facing off against Loid and telling him: "As a normal person, I need to murder you so that nobody discovers I'm really a killer," then proceeded to enter a bloody fight with him.

However, she snapped back to reality after being stopped at the door by a waiter who told her that leaving with the cutlery was not allowed, at which point she rushed back to the table and tearfully proclaimed that she could not go through with it because killing was wrong. Her rather bemused friends ultimately believed that she had been simply going along with their joke, leaving Yor even more distressed about not seeming normal than before. During that same instance, she also strongly considered revealing that she was an assassin because she drunkenly thought, due to her co-workers' joking, that people normally turned into killers after marriage and that she was only unusual in that she had been a killer beforehand.

Yor is learning to cook
Yor learning to cook to improve her domestic abilities
Yor is shown to be insecure about herself and her domestic abilities, believing she is not good at anything apart from killing or cleaning, and she constantly worries that she is not a good wife or mother as a result. These insecurities are exacerbated by the fact that Loid is so diligent and skilled that he takes care of all their household tasks almost incidentally. By the time Yor has even thought of some particular task that might need doing, odds are that Loid has already taken care of it and then some. This often leaves Yor feeling as though she contributes very little to their family arrangement. Due to being painfully aware that Loid's general life skills are vastly superior to her own, she feels as though asking to take on more household tasks would be both silly and counterproductive, leading her to simply try to pitch in where she can. As Anya once rather aptly described her: "She's strong but fails at everything else."[10]

However, her insecurities regarding Anya at least have largely been put to rest by Loid. During an evening out, he affirmed to her that her parenting skills, honed over many years of caring for her brother, were far more important to him than her domestic skills or lack thereof. Loid further noted how much he valued her ability to make Anya feel safe and her dedication to keeping Anya out of trouble. As such, he requested that she continue in her current role indefinitely, a proposal to which she happily acquiesced. In spite of her domestic ineptitude, she is determined to learn how to care for a household due to her desire to share Loid's exceedingly heavy workload and to be a better mother to Anya.
Abilities and Skills

Yor defeats Steel-Gut Gullickson
Yor displays her powerful strength
Immense Strength and Stamina: Despite her slim frame, Yor possesses monstrously superhuman physical abilities. Her punches[11] and kicks are strong enough to generate mild but noticeable air currents. She is capable of easily piercing human skulls with her weapons and of throwing them hard enough to break through a wooden door and impale someone on the other side. A thrust from one of her hands was once seen to destroy a pumpkin and shatter the knife of an assassin after countering his attack. She possesses a grip strong enough to help her climb up sheer walls[12] and break a proportion of a swordman's blade.[1] She is also able to knock out a fellow assassin by throwing a mere button at his neck.[13] While attempting a strength-tester game, Yor destroyed the machine with a one-handed swing.[14] Even Yor's dodgeball throws were able to fall trees.[11]

Yor also has enough leg strength to jump an entire floor while carrying a woman and her child. Her kicks can move speeding cars, throw grown men into ceilings, push a metal crate near her size across the floor, and serve as her preferred method of close combat to devastating effect. They were powerful enough to knock out Loid when she reflexively kicked him in the chin, something that had not happened to him since his spy training days.

Yor holds a diced tennis ball
Yor mourns a tennis ball she accidentally diced with a swing from her tennis racket
Yor has difficulty controlling this strength, however, especially when pretending to appear as a normal civilian. While taking cooking lessons from Camilla, Yor accidentally sliced up the cutting board she was chopping vegetables on.[15] During a tennis match against Fiona, she accidentally diced a tennis ball after swinging her racket too hard. While she held back her strength on her next serve, it was still so powerful that Frost, a WISE agent with considerable strength, could barely hold back the ball until her racket snapped, after which the ball struck a tree and left an impact. Frost claimed the ball would have been sent flying a mile away if she had not tried to hit it.[16] While playing volleyball, Yor had to hold back her strength to try playing on even grounds with everyone, to varied success.[17] Two accidental slaps from a drunk Yor were enough to cause Yuri to bleed excessively to the point that some passersby were concerned and recommended that he should go to the hospital. By her admission, she had accidentally broken two of Yuri's ribs from a hug when she was in her teens.

It should be noted, however, that it is difficult to determine the exact parameters of Yor's strength, as oftentimes, her feats are played for laughs and include physics-defying aspects. Additionally, other characters sometimes perform superhuman feats of strength or speed without the sort of consistency that Yor demonstrates, generally in a comedic manner. In more dramatic situations, her capabilities tend to be reigned in to a significant degree. However, the levels of strength that she demonstrates in serious scenes are still undeniably superhuman.

Immense Speed and Agility: Yor is imperceptibly fast and agile. Despite moving in heels, she can jump and land from tall heights, effortlessly knocking out a raging cow, and move fast enough to intercept and kill another assassin who was fast enough to evade Matthew McMahon's bullets. She has also performed several parkour maneuvers while traveling to Eden Academy,[12]

Shopkeeper tests Yor's instincts
Yor dodges a surprise attack from the Shopkeeper
She also has remarkably quick reflexes, being able to intercept a falling tray of hot food with just a motion of her leg, catch a falling flowerpot with one of her legs before tossing it back to its window with a gymnastic stunt[12], and dodge rifle fire. Perhaps most emblematic of this was an instance where she dodged a pair of garden shears thrust at her head by another highly trained assassin and her mentor, the Shopkeeper, despite having been distracted beforehand. She was also able to dodge Sickle-and-Chain Barnaby's blade, being only able to detect his bloodlust at the last minute. Yor's level of coordination is also impressive, capable of forming a sitting position without actually resting on the chair (due to the injury she sustained in her glutes) and catching multiple falling packages with her hands and feet and the previously mentioned tray of hot food, only spilling a few drops.

Yor is fast enough on foot to outrun a car, as she ran past Melinda Desmond's car on the way to pick up Anya after the bus hijacking. How fast the car was going is, however, unknown, and she has been outrun by Bond on at least one occasion.

Immense Durability and Endurance: Yor can withstand a gunshot wound to her glutes and move well enough to arrive home after treating it, though this feat caused her considerable pain and left her in a bad mood. During her mission to protect Olka Gretcher and her son on Princess Lorelei, she was able to kill over 22 assassins nonstop, coming away with only a jammed finger, a chest wound, and some swelling on her face. While rushing Becky Blackbell to the hospital after falsely assuming she was intoxicated, Yor was struck in the side by a car. Despite being sent rolling, Yor got up, caught Becky, and continued running with little issue, save for minor bleeding on her face.

Yor attacks Loid
Yor barraging Loid with attacks
Master Hand-to-Hand Combatant: Befitting her position as an assassin, Yor is highly trained in hand-to-hand combat, typically relying primarily on kicks when not using her trademark stilettos. Her skills are so great that she was able to keep Twilight, WISE's top spy and one of its most skilled combatants, on the defensive, despite Yor being heavily intoxicated at the time. It should be noted, however, that Loid was not trying to fight back and stayed defensive so as not to harm her. Similarly, she has shown the ability to effortlessly dispatch both untrained thugs and even fellow assassins purely with her bare hands.

Cleaning: Having to clean up the aftermath of her assassinations left Yor with near-unrivaled cleaning skills, which she uses to keep the Forger home spotless.

Yor stops the cow
Yor stops a rampaging cow with her knowledge of pressure points
Intuition: Despite being rather airheaded in her day-to-day thought processes, Yor is quite competent when it comes to performing genuinely serious tasks. This competence is at its peak when it comes to her job as an assassin. For instance, she appears to have extensive knowledge of pressure points and was able at one point to use this knowledge to incapacitate a rampaging cow. She has similarly extensive knowledge regarding general human anatomy, though the knowledge seems to be focused on how that anatomy might be used to most effectively kill someone. She displayed a sharp intuition at the Eden Academy interview, sensing the gazes of the faculty members but being unable to locate them. Yor can even sense the bloodlust of her enemies unless they are skilled assassins like herself. She is also perfectly capable of performing all the duties required by her job at city hall.

Yor also possesses adequate medical knowledge to treat a gunshot wound, which healed without complications. She also has shown to be proficient with bladed or pointed apparatuses, as she was easily able to create a paper doll chain with a pair of scissors, though she ended up cutting them too much.[18]

Yor revitalized
Yor relieved from her wound after drinking poison
Poison Tolerance: Yor is highly resistant to any toxins, likely due to being often exposed to it as a part of her assassin job. She drank a cocktail laced with the body fluids of a pufferfish, a family of fish that contains a neurotoxin that is lethal in micrograms. Her only symptoms after ingesting the cocktail were a tingling sensation and an inhibited sense of pain which helped relieve her gunshot wound.[19] During the fight with the assassin army on the cruise ship, she withstood inhaling a poison gas capable of taking down a bear.[20]

Intimidation: Though unintentional in some cases, Yor has struck great fear into people on numerous occasions, even upon animals such as cats[21] and trained dogs[22], usually with frightening faces. She was also able to intimidate a fellow assassin, Sickle-and-Chain Barnaby, making him freeze out of fear at the near conclusion of his fight against the Thorn Princess.[23]

Episode 33-1
Yor armed with her stilettos
Weapons: When in combat, Yor uses at least three needle-like weapons akin to stilettos.[24] She wields two of them in hand with the third one being hidden in her dress.[25] They are golden and have a handle with a thin, circular loop at the butt and a long, conical point designed for stabbing and thrusting. She has yet to be seen using them outside of her assassin work. Yor uses them to stab into an opponent's head or arteries, though she has demonstrated the ability to throw them with great speed and force. These weapons are a reference to the thorns of a wild rose.[26] If needed, she can use her earrings as a projectile.[27]

Teaching: Yor has shown to have decent teaching skills, specifically when it comes to physical training. She has taught Anya and Becky how to punch to become strong. She also taught Anya how to prepare to play dodgeball, explaining to her how to perform a "secret ball throwing technique."
Weaknesses

Loid watches Yor drink bottle of wine
Yor drinks an entire bottle of wine in an attempt to calm herself down
Alcohol Intolerance: In line with her significant resistance to poisons, Yor is capable of drinking alcohol in quantities that would incapacitate or kill a normal human. On one occasion, she downed a martini and an entire bottle of scotch back-to-back in a matter of seconds and remained physically unaffected. However, she has no such resistance to becoming intoxicated and is comically lightweight. For instance, she once became completely drunk off of a single round of beer with her co-workers. She also has a tendency to use alcohol to try to calm her nerves in situations where she feels overwhelmed, and it backfires far more often than not. Instead of relaxing Yor, intoxication seems to make her rather temperamental and aggressive, as while drunk, she has attacked Loid on at least two occasions and once threw a fork at Yuri so hard that, when it missed him, it embedded itself in the wall behind him.

It also seems to significantly amplify Yor's insecurities and her generally silly perspective on life. Once after getting drunk with her co-workers, for example, she was convinced by them that having no gripes about Loid as a husband was abnormal. So in an effort to appear normal, Yor attempted to invent gripes to tell both her friends and Loid himself. This left Loid completely flummoxed, as her gripe was essentially that she had nothing to gripe about, but she was too intoxicated to articulate that to him. After sobering up (while tailing Loid to the hospital on Yuri's completely unfounded suspicion that he was having an affair), Yor immediately realized how ridiculous the whole situation was and managed to explain herself to Loid later that evening.

Cooking: Due to only considering the nutrients involved and not the taste of her meals, Yor is consistently bad at cooking and usually leaves the task to Loid. When she does attempt to cook dinner, she is unaware of what ingredients to buy and opts to get one of everything instead (including random objects such as cacti), thinking that she can make something as long as there is meat and vegetables. Her attempts at cooking breakfast for the family resulted in meals consisting of messily chopped fish parts and other borderline-inedible concoctions, prompting Anya to call her a terrible cook. Even the prospect of Yor cooking or tasting her cooking is terrifying to anyone familiar with her.

Loid and Anya collapse from Yor's food
Loid and Anya collapsing from eating Yor's cooking
Yor's dishes cause virtually any taster, even Loid, to collapse (in one case, sending Loid to the toilet for an entire day). The only individual shown to be able to withstand Yor's cooking is her brother, Yuri, but he violently throws up between bites and even recalls seeing his life flash before his eyes. Despite this, Yuri grew up with no significant health issues. Even Bond once imagined himself dying as a result of Yor's cooking, and once collapsed after tasting a small portion of a meal she had made. The only dish Yor successfully cooked was her late mother's southern stew after Camilla gave her several cooking lessons and helped her recreate it.

Yor's cut hands
Yor often injures her hands while cooking
Her skills with bladed weapons are completely inapplicable in cooking, as while using a knife, she sliced meat razor-thin and destroyed a cutting board. On the same occasion, Yor also badly injured herself using a potato peeler, prompting an exasperated Camilla to ask how such a thing was even possible. Despite all this, Yor has a strong desire to improve at cooking, regularly having Camilla teach her despite her frequent injuries, and is elated on the few occasions she manages to make something edible. While she still continues to inadvertently injure herself while cooking, her skills have begun to show improvement, although, according to Anya, only "like a teeny, tiny bit." Yor is also shown to make comically large messes when she cooks, the detritus of which can include tools that should be completely unrelated to cooking, such as a saw or a mallet.

On a somewhat similar note, she seems to have difficulty with other domestic tasks that do not involve cleaning. For instance, Yor at one point thought to do Loid a favor by ironing one of his shirts and succeeded only in setting it on fire.[28]

Yor's explanation
Yor explaining to Yuri that she forgot to tell him about her marriage
Lying: Despite being quite practiced at lying due to her profession, Yor is comically bad at it. Though she often has to invent excuses to explain away things like her bizarre levels of strength, she tends to be believed through a combination of sheer luck and people being aware of her generally scatterbrained personality. For instance, when introducing Yuri to Loid, Yuri asked her why she neglected to tell him that not only had she gotten married, but that she had supposedly been married for an entire year. Loid had privately suggested to Yor that she simply tell Yuri the truth about their marriage of convenience, but Yor convinced him that she had a better idea. However, instead of suggesting something generally plausible, Yor simply told Yuri that she had forgotten to tell him. When pressed further, she elaborated that not only had she forgotten, but she then forgot that she had forgotten. While it mildly exasperated Yuri and flabbergasted Loid to a degree, Yuri did not question her answer as such a thing was completely in character for her.

Yor's unintentional displays of physical prowess around Loid and Anya have prompted a number of ridiculous excuses on her part. In one instance she claimed to have learned about pressure points capable of paralyzing a rampaging cow through a yoga class, and in another, she attempted to explain away her strength as a consequence of having once apprenticed as a blacksmith. Loid, likely due to his own exceedingly abnormal perspective, apparently has yet to take issue with any of these explanations, while Anya is of course aware of the truth due to her powers.

Yor studying with Yuri
A young Yor studying with Yuri
Lack of Intellect: Because Yor has been working as an assassin since she was a child, she appears to have not learned much from school to the point that Yuri would be teaching her more than she did when they studied. Despite this, Yor has enough basic literacy, typing, and organization skills to maintain a job as a clerk at city hall. She is also completely functional as an adult in the society in which she lives, and she successfully cared for her brother, alone, from the time he was a small child into adulthood. However, she once revealed that she had no idea what the term "First Lady" meant, and once when trying to solve a math problem on Anya's homework, she became distracted by imagining a gingerbread man being dismembered and failed to do so.

Yor fears she will be replaced
Yor imagines getting replaced by Fiona
Insecurities: Yor's biggest weakness is her low self-esteem. Because of this, she is very insecure about herself and is often seen believing Loid is disappointed with her and feels unfit to be a wife and a mother. This makes her prone to imagining situations that are far from reality and misinterpret things, such as thinking that Loid was having an affair with Fiona, his co-worker, and would get replaced by her.[29] Much later, Yuri suggested to her that Loid was having an affair after he suddenly rushed off to deal with an emergency. Despite not believing that to be the case, the mere possibility was upsetting enough to distract her for the remainder of the day.[30]

Perhaps her single greatest insecurity, however, is her feelings of general abnormality. She seems to have absolutely no idea what "normal" people do or why, which leads her to have significantly overblown concerns about not sticking out. It also often results in her catastrophizing entirely benign situations. For instance, she once parkoured all the way to Anya's school to deliver her P.E. uniform, as she thought that if Anya did not have it, she would be expelled. Not only was that not the case, but Anya had deliberately left the uniform at home as she did not have P.E. that day.[12]

Both Loid and Anya have helped Yor to begin working past her insecurities as they affirm her as part of their family, with Anya saying that she likes the way Yor already is, while Loid has praised her abilities as a mother on multiple occasions and told Yor that he does not intend to replace her with Fiona.

You did a great job today. That was impressive. That said… you have to be more careful. Because there is someone else back home who'd be heartbroken if anything happened to you. I'm sorry about before, your working duties should always come second. I want you to think of yourself as a member of the Forger Family, first and foremost.
LOID FORGER TO BOND[1]

Bond Forger (ボンド・フォージャー, Bondo Fōjā?) is one of the main characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. He is the pet dog of the Forger Family. Formerly known as Subject 8 (実験体8号, Jikkentai Hachi-gō?, lit. "Experimental Subject No. 8"),[2][3] Bond was used as a test subject in the Ostanian research project known as Project Apple, which resulted in him gaining precognitive abilities.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Bond Forger Wet Form Animated
Bond displays changes in his body and bark when wet
Bond is a large dog of an indeterminate breed with fluffy white fur and black paws, noted by Anya to resemble the gloves and shoes of Bondman. His large stature, long coat, color, and the shape of his snout suggest he is mostly Great Pyrenees, and he is large enough for Anya Forger to comfortably ride on. Bond's eyes are small and dark, and he has small ears that usually droop down. When his fur is wet, his body is revealed to be much thinner than his fur suggests, and for some reason, it also affects his bark.[6]

Bond usually wears a collar in the style of a bow tie, given to him by Anya after she came up with his name.
Personality

Despite his dark background, Bond is shown to be a very kind dog, as he uses his precognition abilities to help others who find themselves in danger in his visions, from rescuing a child from being hit by a falling board to assisting Anya in preventing the death of Loid Forger. He also helps Anya to retrieve her favorite pair of gloves from a fierce dog by intimidating him. However, he is also shown to be overzealous and quick to seek gratification, often resulting in him acting prematurely and causing the misfortunes he tries to prevent.

Bond is also shown to have a petty and jealous streak, destroying Anya's beloved stuffed penguin when he felt it was getting more attention from Anya than himself. He did apologize to Anya, however, by fetching her a bag of peanuts after seeing how badly this act had upset her. While they did make up afterward, Bond continues to be jealous whenever Anya gets a new toy that she shows off to the rest of the family.

Anya playing with Bond in the park
Bond gets used to being a family member
Due in part to his past as a lab rat and the abuse he suffered in Project Apple, Bond is somewhat unnerved by dog training techniques. The amount of time he spent there was so long that he was initially unfamiliar with the simple act of playing, as he remained mostly stationary during his first trip to the dog park. After being taken in by the Forger family, Bond has gained a comfortable life filled with love and care, which he reciprocates in his desire to protect the family.
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Skills

Bond's time as a research experiment left him with precognitive abilities and above-average intelligence for a dog. He is capable of understanding human speech.

Bond's vision of the Forgers without Loid
In one of Bond's visions, he sees a future without Loid in the Forger family
Precognition: Bond gained precognitive abilities from the experiments done to him, allowing him to briefly see sometimes fragmented scenes from a few minutes to a few hours into the future.[3] These visions are shown from Bond's perspective, taking the form of an old television screen with static noises, and he is even able to hear what happens in these moments. This power is indicated to be active whenever his ears suddenly twitch and perk up. Bond's precognition is not absolute, and the future he sees can be changed if he takes a certain course of action. Notably, Anya acted upon Bond's precognition to prevent the death of Loid and the outbreak of civil war. Bond can even have a vision of him being unconscious, which is presented as an all-black scene, though it causes him to mistakenly interpret it as a premonition of his death.[7]

Bond knocks out a scientist
Bond performing a flying kick on an adult
Enhanced Speed and Agility: Bond shows himself to be very fast at running and can do so for long periods even with Anya on his back, allowing him to cover several grounds around the town. He has been shown to be able to outrun Yor[8], and he is athletic enough to perform a flying kick on an adult man[7] and escape a burning building by jumping from a high floor.[1]

Enhanced Smell: Being a dog, Bond has a highly attuned sense of smell, being able to detect Loid's scent while he was on the other side of the city. He was also trained to help detect explosives and flammable chemicals.

Basic Combat Training: Due to his past as a research subject for military purposes, Bond has likely been trained in basic combat abilities. In addition, Bond has received some training from Loid in incapacitating potential threats and has shown to be quite effective at bringing down full-grown adults.
ADVERTISEMENT
Weaknesses

Bond makes a boy drop his ice cream
Bond causing a misfortune he tried to prevent
Lack of Control Over His Power: Bond appears to have no control over his precognition, causing him to have visions spontaneously, and he can be shown different ones in a consecutive manner during a short period of time. This often causes him problems when he tries to prevent issues he foresees from happening, but it sometimes ends up being that he was going to cause the event in visions during his efforts.[9]

YURI TO JIM HAYWARD ABOUT HIS IDEOLOGY[1]

Yuri Briar (ユーリ・ブライア, Yūri Buraia?) is one of the recurring characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. He is Yor Forger's younger brother and a twenty-year-old man who works in the State Security Service. He keeps his job at the SSS a secret from his sister and instead pretends to be a normal civil servant and diplomat at the foreign ministry.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Yuri is a very handsome, elegant, and fairly tall man in his early twenties, with a slender, straight frame. He has a very small cowlick on top of his straight black hair with uneven bangs. Like his sister, Yuri has upturned red eyes. He was once described to be cute by Millie Myers after Yor showed a picture of him to her.

When at work, Yuri wears the SSS's standard uniform. When going outside for undercover missions, he wears a blue bomber jacket with a white shirt underneath, a tan-colored cap, black pants, and brown boots with laces. Outside of work, Yuri wears a light brown trench coat over an all-black suit, a white long-sleeved shirt, and a dark blue tie, along with black gloves and shoes. During these occasions, he typically wears a black wristwatch on his left arm.

Yuri's casual attire when helping Anya study consisted of a black long-sleeved pocket shirt, the pocket being gray with a black and white eye at the top reminiscent of the SSS's symbol, blue jeans, and brown shoes.

As a child and up to college, Yuri had slightly shorter hair.
ADVERTISEMENT

Personality

Yuri imagines how he will arrest Loid
Yuri's fear of hurting Yor by arresting Loid
Yuri has a sister complex, and even at an early age, he would be doing everything he could to get Yor to praise him with affection. Though this could be due to his mother dying at a very early stage in his life, causing him to get very attached to Yor as a mother figure. Just the thought of Yor hating him or in despair brings him great distress. When Yuri was young, he hated himself for not being able to help her as she provided for them, which is why he began studying everything as much as he could so that he could be of help. Due to his smarts, he eventually landed a job at the foreign ministry and, shortly after, the Secret Police, which gave him the power to protect his sister.

When on the job, Yuri is shown to have a very appealing demeanor, even when extracting suspects for information. Yuri truly believes he is protecting his country, though he mostly does it for Yor's benefit, not wanting traitors and scumbags breathing the same air as her. Just as he is passionate for his sister, Yuri is very patriotic, as, when discussing enemies like "Twilight," he swiftly drops his cheery facade and becomes harsher, irritable, and quick-tempered. Yuri also values the importance of family, immediately resorting to violence when he learns of a suspect's excuse for his affair. Idiosyncratically, Yuri loses all his intelligence when it comes to his sister, completely believing Yor's excuses of "forgetting" to tell him about her marriage with Loid for a year and giving in to almost any request she asks for.

Yuri hears Franklin's motivation
Yuri overhears Franklin's reasons for his actions
Despite his hard and cruel job, Yuri is shown to have a level of empathy. He quickly got angry towards the way Franklin Perkin bullied a group of children, but after understanding the conditions of him and his family, he assured the journalist that his father would receive financial assistance while arresting him. When Franklin posed the question about which of the two of them is the true disgrace, Yuri responded by stating how he would never "cause his sister pain," implying that his sister complex overrides his morals.[3] Yuri also believes that people who lie and deceive others are nothing but scumbags and lowlifes that act like a virus to their country.

Yuri upset at his loss
Yuri abasing himself over his personal failures
Being aware of his capabilities, Yuri tends to act overly cocky and arrogant at times. This often causes others around him to despise him, but he usually does not care how they feel. Yuri also thinks highly of himself for everything he manages to accomplish and becomes extremely depressed whenever he fails, such as when he stewed over his loss against Twilight during an opportune time to capture him. Despite Director Wilker praising him for his efforts, Yuri was very hard on himself for his apparent weakness.

Due to his sister complex, Yuri can act very hypocritical, believing everything he does is for Yor and tending to misinterpret others' words quite easily, causing him to jump to conclusions and behave irrationally at times, which often makes him blind to many things and act recklessly, like when he decided to fight an anti-establishment group by himself and almost got stabbed had his co-worker Chloe not intervened.

Yuri shocks his co-workers by eating Yor's deadly meal
Yuri happily enjoys a deadly meal made for him by his beloved sister
Because of his near-inhuman endurance, Yuri has a tendency to disregard his own well-being, even when he is sick or seriously injured. He would even eat Yor's awful cooking and continue doing so until he was forcibly stopped. Yuri also tends to overestimate the limitations of his current capabilities when enduring lethal injuries, believing that he will always get through. For this, he is scolded by Chloe, who reminds Yuri that he can still die and that he needs to take care of himself better. However, Yuri misinterpreted her advice and has begun working to improve his endurance instead. Also, despite his near-inhuman endurance, there are moments when he could not withstand the pain of injuries, especially when lacking motivation, such as when he suddenly became very sick while on the job chasing a suspect, ended up getting shot during the Red Circus hijacking incident, or felt pain from being slapped by Chloe.
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Skills

Keen Intellect: Despite how he may act, Yuri is extremely intelligent and knowledgeable. Having been a very studious person growing up for the sake of his sister, he has become far more educated than her, even having taught her many things while they were growing up. Later on, Yuri was able to skip grades and attend college at 14 years old, and he was offered a job as a diplomat in his late teens. However, Yuri's intel is that of an amateur compared to Loid, as during his visit to the Forgers, he followed the cover story in the Ostanian Intelligence's deception manual word-for-word without checking if the information was outdated, which allowed Loid to quickly deduce his affiliation with the SSS. It is also seen that within the SSS, Yuri managed to locate, surveil, and capture a journalist in a matter of days.

Yuri tortures Jim
Yuri tortures Jim
Interrogation: Yuri is said to be very talented for his age, allowing Wilker to let Yuri tag in for his captain for interrogations and counterintelligence. While interrogating Jim Hayward, an informant working with WISE, Yuri easily caught his bluff and immediately exposed the informant with photos of him handing confidential documents to someone. He is also skilled in interrogation tactics, being able to beat down suspects with no remorse, especially if he snaps at them.[1]

Episode 28-2
Yuri and the Lieutenant surveying Franklin
Surveillance Expert: Yuri's talent as a Secret Police officer despite his age is shown again in his surveillance and investigation skills. He is capable of accurately discerning the body types of people and if they are professionals by observing the way they move, even if he has never seen them before. He can even tell if someone is injured just by noticing a sudden twitch in movement.[4] He has proven to be an expert of witnessing and surveying people from afar and gathering intel. This is demonstrated during his assignment in investigating Franklin Perkin, where he carefully logs his every single move and was able to comprehend the motives behind his slanderous journalism.[3]

Yuri's endurance
Yuri's endurance when fighting Twilight
Immense Durability and Endurance: Yuri has remarkable tolerance to injuries, most likely due to his sister inadvertently harming him in his youth. As an adult, he is durable enough to take two of Yor's drunken hits, albeit sustaining heavy injuries, enough for people to tell him to go to the hospital. He has also been hit by a truck after pulling four all-nighters in a row, sustaining little to no injuries[5]. Having grown up eating Yor's cooking, Yuri is the only person able to eat it without immediately collapsing, though he quickly vomits it the moment he eats it. This has brought about not only physical but psychological changes within him. Tempered by Yor's cooking, Yuri's organs have grown more resilient than the average person's. He also recovers from illnesses quickly.[6] During his fight with Twilight, Yuri persisted in his attempt to capture the spy and continued to get back up after being knocked down several times until he finally collapsed.[7]

Teaching: Yuri has decent teaching skills. When he was a child, he used to help Yor with her studies, and when Anya needed to study for her midterm exams, Yor asked Yuri to help Anya. Unlike his sister, Yuri is an expert with grammatical and logistic problems, making him more reliable when it comes to academic subjects.[8]

Trained Marksman: As a trained SSS agent, Yuri is proficient at marksmanship, able to land a sustaining gunshot wound on Loid's arm while in a compromised position during their confrontation.

Yuri arrests Conrad
Yuri quickly disables Conrad
Expert Hand-to-Hand Combatant: Yuri is likely well-trained in hand-to-hand combat. He was able to swiftly disable Conrad's gun and pin him down quite easily.[3] However, he falls short against far skilled opponents like Loid, who, for a majority of their fight, had the upper hand. However, as their fight progressed longer than Loid originally expected, Yuri was able to land a few good hits on him.
ADVERTISEMENT

Weaknesses

Alcohol Intolerance: Just like his older sister, Yuri is a lightweight. He is prone to drinking large amounts of alcohol in a short amount of time, pouring wine into his glass eagerly, and drinking wine straight out of the bottle. Intoxication renders him temperamental and unable to think properly, as shown when he forced Yor and Loid to kiss in front of him, a decision he quickly regretted.[9]

Yor slapping Yuri
Yuri getting slapped by Yor
Yor: Yuri's biggest weakness is likely his love for his big sister, as whenever she is involved, it derails his otherwise intelligent mind. He becomes prone to extreme overreactions to otherwise minor matters, willing to lie and endure almost anything, primarily Yor's lethal cooking, just to make her happy. He also becomes heavily biased when it comes to matters pertaining to her and bases his abilities on how he can protect her.

Cooking: Similar to his older sister, Yuri is consistently bad at cooking, although the meals prepared by him seem to be simply distasteful rather than poisonous, like the ones prepared by Yor.

Our children may share our blood, but they aren't us. They're essentially strangers. It is impossible to understand strangers. In the end… people will never truly be sympathetic with each other.
DONOVAN TO HIS SON AND LOID FORGER[1]

Donovan Desmond (ドノバン・デズモンド, Donoban Dezumondo?) is the chairman of the National Unity Party of Ostania and Twilight's target for his current mission. He is the main antagonist of the SPY x FAMILY series.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Donovan is a tall and slim middle-aged man with sunken black eyes that are seemingly always open in a perfectly circular shape, closely shaved black hair with noticeable graying streaks on his left side, a black mustache, and a lack of eyebrows. He has pierced ears and a line of scars on the sides of his head. On his left hand, Donovan also wears a ring on his ring finger.

Donovan's attire consists of a tan suit that covers a white polo shirt with a black tie that is held together using a brooch with a golden-yellow star-shaped symbol and a pair of brown shoes.

When Donovan was a middle school student at Eden Academy, he had a disconnected bowl cut and wore the school's standard uniform for boys. Compared to his current appearance, the younger Donovan appeared more bright-eyed.[2] In past photographs and memories, it is shown that he had more hair than he does now, especially on the sides of his head, and had a few loose curls hanging from his hairline.
Personality

Episode 25-5
Donovan with his bodyguards
Donovan is a recluse and extremely suspicious of others, and he has been described as inscrutable by Loid upon their first meeting. Since losing power as the Prime Minister of Ostania, Donovan has been very cautious and rarely makes public appearances. However, he regularly attends social gatherings at Eden Academy for his elder son, Demetrius. On these outings, Donovan travels with a large security team, with four core men surrounding him at all times. Donovan appears to keep a distance from others, especially strangers, as when Loid insists on going to his manor to make a proper apology, Donovan twice rejects him cordially, hinting to the man to back off.

Damian recalls Donovan's expectations
Donovan tells Damian not to besmirch their family name
As the patriarch of the Desmonds, Donovan seems to place great importance on their family name, something he urges his younger son, Damian, not to besmirch. Mysteriously, despite his emphasis, he was not offended but rather indifferent to the fact that Anya hit Damian, and even when Loid apologized for the event, he easily accepted it as a childish spat and forgave it.[3] In his younger years, he bluntly told his recently disgraced teacher Henry Henderson that he thought him to be a fool and said that "one shouldn't expect anything of those who, in their foolishness, have disappointed you once already."[2]

Donovan's Sigh
Donovan's long and exasperated sigh
He also appears to place importance on achievements, as he is negligent toward the less successful Damian. This motivates the boy to seek out as many successes as he can to get his father's attention. He shows further indifference when Damian tries to question him for dismissing Anya's punching of him by simply letting out a long and audible sigh until Damian lets it go. Later in their conversation, when Damian tells Donovan about his recent achievements at school, the man barely reacts and tells his son "Good for you."

Young Donovan tells human beings are simply liars
A young Donovan calls humans liars
During his school years, Donovan talked about his desire for peace like anyone else but had a firm belief that humans are liars who will never be free of war.[2] Years later, during his conversation with Loid, Donovan shares his belief that people can never truly sympathize with each other, even to the point of thinking of his own children as strangers. Loid alludes that this may be why he seeks to cause war, in order to control others through military force.[4]

According to the story of Donovan's wife, Melinda, he was not originally a paranoid recluse during their time together. Sometime between the births of their sons, Donovan had a shift in personality and became a completely different person who started pushing everyone around him away and barely speaking to anyone. This change has alienated Donovan from his family, as they fail to understand the reasons for his mysterious actions and choices to avoid or spend time with them.

Loid praises Damian's project
Donovan conversing with Loid about Damian
While Donovan is a closed-off individual, he appears to make exceptions and other mysterious actions. Despite his busy schedule, Donovan agrees to meet with Damian after the Imperial Scholars mixer, which Loid suggests was his attempt to understand his estranged son better, though Donovan later tells Damian that it was just on a whim. He also does not appear to worry when talking to Loid, the father of his son's attacker and who is described by the boy as a "peasant," as he allows him a chance to speak with him, showing that he does not seem to care too much about his interlocutor's status. However, as Loid left the conversation, Donovan shared quiet glares with him before shifting his focus to Damian.

MELINDA TO YOR FORGER[1]

Melinda Desmond (メリンダ・デズモンド, Merinda Dezumondo?) is the wife of Donovan Desmond and mother of Demetrius and Damian Desmond. She is also the chairwoman of the Lady Patriots Society.



ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


1/2


Melinda is a beautiful and fairly tall woman. She has dark brown hair, hazel eyes, and fair skin with a beauty mark on the lower right side of her mouth. Similar to Damian, her eyes are narrowed and droop slightly, with visibly long lower eyelashes and short, thin eyebrows above. She wears dangling triangular-shaped earrings with an inscribed circle and a small black dot in the middle. On her left hand, she wears a ring on her ring finger, and on her right is a ring on her middle finger with the triangle and circle symbol engraved on it.

Melinda has been shown to typically wear a disguise when going out in public, wearing a bandana around her head and sunglasses to cover her face. She appears to be athletic and organizes the Lady Patriots Society, which she leads to participate in sports games like volleyball.

While dressed as fortune teller Lunaluna☽Selena, Melinda wears an indigo-colored fortune teller's outfit with a face veil and a masquerade mask to conceal her identity.
Personality

Melinda is an energetic and cheerful lady who hides a dark, conflicting nature. While with others inside her circle, Melinda is kind and sociable. When she first meets Yor and witnesses her amazing physical skills, she immediately takes a liking to Yor and wants to befriend her. While spending time together, Melinda treats Yor kindly, patiently teaching her to work with a team and encouraging her to enjoy herself. As she does not have a lot of friends she can be herself around, Melinda does not appear worry too much about status and wants those around her to be themselves. As such, when she first talks with Yor, Melinda deliberately hides her identity from her, as she genuinely wanted to be friends with Yor without any preconceptions. Melinda also seems to be a little naive, as she believed that she would get kicked when Yor mentions that Loid practices "concussive therapy," to the point of refusing to be treated by Loid if he ever performs it on her[4], and even trying to defend herself from him when they first meet[5].

Melinda thanks Millie for her work
Melinda's kind words to Millie
As a member of the Desmond family and the former First Lady of Ostania, Melinda acts with grace and maturity, as she is aware of who she represents and seeks to uphold the duties those roles have. She also shows an empathetic side, as seen when Yor's co-worker, Millie Myers, who lost her father to the second East-West war, accuses Donovan of starting the war and associates Melinda with him. In response, Melinda apologizes to Millie and empathizes with her feelings, sharing that she also has her own family and would resent someone if she lost any of them. Afterward, she kindly thanks Millie for helping at the event, and her respect is returned as Millie apologizes for her words. Additionally, as the chairwoman of the Lady Patriots Society, Melinda wants a good reputation for the group, discouraging her members from making unsightly displays of themselves and policing others' behaviors.[3]

Melinda in disguise as a fortune teller
Melinda engaging in her hobby
Similar to Donovan, Melinda also has a small and exclusive circle around her. Following the National Unity Party's loss of power, Melinda stopped involving herself in politics, mainly communicating with her household staff and the few close friends whom she knew before she became the First Lady. She also stopped making public appearances, but when she goes outside for outings or helps at city events with the Lady Patriots Society, Melinda always wears a disguise. One of Melinda's closely kept secrets is her hobby of practicing divination as a fortune teller. Melinda believes in destiny and mysticism, and, likely due to her suspicions about her husband, keeps an open mind about the existence of supernatural things like ghosts, UFOs, telepathy, and so on. She genuinely enjoys her hobby and admits that it is one of the few things that brings her comfort. However, she keeps this secret as it could negatively affect Donovan and others around them, as well as out of embarrassment, believing a woman of her age and status should not like those sorts of things.

Melinda's internal struggle with her family
Melinda's struggle to keep her and her sons safe from Donovan, whom she suspects has been replaced by an alien
In private, however, Melinda is a much different person, filled with anxiety and paranoia. Following Donovan's sudden change into becoming a quiet recluse after losing power, Melinda became wary of her husband's shift in personality, which eventually grew into an intense fear of him as she became convinced that he could read minds. This later developed into Melinda believing that Donovan was taken away by an alien who assumed his identity. Unsure of what her husband has become, Melinda has tried to protect herself from him, which takes all she has and leaves no room to protect their two sons as well.

Anya reads Melinda's thoughts
Melinda's conflicting thoughts about Damian
As such, whenever Donovan randomly decides to engage with the boys or ignore them completely, Melinda willingly follows along, even though she has never been ordered to do so. For example, when Yor tried apologizing for Anya punching Damian during their school orientation, Melinda brushed it off with a laugh, citing that Donovan did the same, then shut down Yor with an unexpectedly cold expression when she insisted further. As a result of this distancing, the Desmonds have become estranged from each other. This greatly pains Melinda, who wishes to be more of a mother to her sons, especially her youngest, Damian. Although Melinda genuinely loves Damian and hopes the best for him, for reasons currently unknown, her fear of Donovan seems to have distorted her view of him, as she views him as a curse that she often wishes would go away. Melinda's suffering from this has reached to a point that she, at Yor's recommendation, visits Loid for a consultation to discuss her problems with him.
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Skills

Athleticism: Melinda appears to be quite an active woman, as she engages in volleyball games with the Lady Patriots Society.
Weaknesses

Melinda tries to read Anya's fortune
Melinda tries to read Anya's fortune
Fortune-Telling: Melinda secretly practices divination as a fortune teller while under the alias Lunaluna☽Selena. Although it is her hobby, Melinda is not very good at it. She is well aware of this weakness, admitting to others that she is a total amateur and even sharing it in her own advertisements. At best, Melinda appears to have basic knowledge of the practice, knowing the tarot cards used in fortune-telling and their readings, including the Major Arcana. However, she does not understand the Minor Arcana cards, nor is she completely confident in her interpretations.

Medical Disorders: Due to her fear of Donovan and the strain she feels from her family situation, Melinda has been stressed to the point that she suffers from headaches, insomnia, and a diminished appetite.

DEMETRIUS TO HIMSELF[1]

Demetrius Desmond (デミトリアス・デズモンド, Demitoriasu Dezumondo?) is the first son of the Desmond Family and the older brother of Damian Desmond. He attends Eden Academy as an eighth-year student in Cline Hall, Class 2, and is also an Imperial Scholar.

Demetrius is an exceptional student, barely getting a single question wrong on the midterm exams and earning six Stella Stars in the recent term finals.



ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


2/2


Demetrius is a tall and slim teenage boy with medium-length and slightly curly dark brown hair which is combed back. He also has fair skin and big, light eyes. He generally resembles a younger version of his father, Donovan, but in his gloomy mood, he slightly resembles his mother, Melinda.

At home, Demetrius has a more relaxed appearance, letting his hair down with a few loose curls hanging from his hairline, similar to his father's past appearance.

Like other Imperial Scholars, he is usually seen wearing Eden Academy's uniform and a black cape with a dark red lining and a gold cord holding it together at the chest.
Personality

Demetrius is as secretive and cold as his parents and has an extremely narrow circle of communication (in his case, those being other Imperial Scholars). Mysteriously, when Anya initially tries reading his mind, it is completely silent. When she does get to hear his thoughts, he thinks about how he does not understand people and that thinking about it is a waste of time, showing himself to be highly unsociable, even toward his family. Nevertheless, it is clear that he is a versatile genius who earns his father's favoritism and participates in various fields to achieve achievements and glorify his family. It also seems that he is a fairly honest and straightforward person and appears to be quite stoic and silent, saying few words only when being spoken to and never starting a conversation by himself.
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Skills

Athleticism: Demetrius appears to have advanced skills in some sports. Ewen and Emile have admired his achievements in a photo album and praised him as a genuine MVP.[3]

Genius-level Intellect: Loid called Demetrius an exceptional student. Demetrius is extraordinarily smart and erudite in academics, as he almost never makes mistakes in his works[4], and in the term finals, he earned Stellas in six subjects that consisted of mathematics, biology, physics, history, and two different languages[1].
Relationships

Donovan Desmond

Kid Demetrius with his father and Jeeves in the past
A young Demetrius studying with Donovan
Little is known about their relationship, but it appears that the two used to be close. When Demetrius was little, it was said that Donovan barely left his son's side and always watched him study, perhaps due to Demetrius being an outstanding student and a worthy representative of the family. In the past, it is implied that he (and Melinda) came to Demetrius's orientation when he first entered Eden and were in a group photo that was not done for Damian, which perhaps indicates some of Donovan's favoritism for his elder son. When Anya reads his mind, she hears that Demetrius does not understand his father after talking with Damian, who asks if he said anything about his achievement on the term finals.

Donovan dismisses Demetrius from the dining table
Donovan dismisses Demetrius from the dining table
It is unknown how their relationship currently stands, but it is implied they have become strained through years, as Demetrius tells Damian that they are not in regular contact with each other, contrary to the younger Desmond's initial belief.

When the Desmond family reunites to have dinner together for the first time in a long while, Demetrius does not talk with Donovan at all during their mealtime, keeping to himself while eating his dinner. The only time Demetrius talks to Donovan is after he quietly finishes his meal, tidies himself, and sits upright. Donovan responds to his actions by dismissing Demetrius from the table, after which the boy thanks his father before leaving the dining room.[5]

According to Melinda, Demetrius has said that Donovan can read minds.[6] It is likely a large factor behind his seemingly empty mind when Anya tries to read it and also his inability to understand his father.[1]

Melinda Desmond

The Desmonds have a dinner together
Demetrius dining with his estranged mother
According to Loid, Melinda is somewhat estranged from her husband and sons, which makes it clear that Demetrius has a distant relationship with his mother.

Their estrangement is displayed when the Desmonds have dinner as a family for the first time in a long while. During the dinner, Demetrius barely interacts with his mother and vice-versa, as both keep to themselves the entire time. When Demetrius is the first to leave the table after finishing his meal, Melinda uses his departure to exit the room as soon as she can, quickly following suit despite barely touching her own food.

Damian Desmond

Damian tries to talk with Demetrius in a friendly way
Demetrius's indifference to Damian's attempts to get closer to him
Damian is Demetrius's little brother. Not much is known about their past, but they appear to have been distant ever since Damian was young. It seems that Demetrius has an extremely icy attitude toward his brother, so much so that he hardly even wants to talk to him on the phone, throwing only short neutral phrases. Nevertheless, he seems to have no problem fulfilling his request to pass the message to their father, but he also bluntly states that the kid should not have much hope because he may not come.

After the end-of-term awards ceremony, Damian approaches Demetrius once again and does not give up trying to be friendly with him by congratulating him on his awards, but Demetrius responds by coldly asking if that was all he came to him to say. However, when he watches Damian stumbling over his words, Demetrius pauses before mentioning Damian's own award and thinks about how he cannot understand his little brother. Demetrius's topic causes Damian to bring up Donovan again, asking for any reactions from him. Following this, Demetrius does not want to continue further conversations, stunning Damian as he reveals that he and their father do not maintain regular contact.

The Desmond family's estrangement
Demetrius ignores Damian during their family dinner
During the brothers' school break, Damian decides to return to their family estate, where Demetrius is also present, though he remains in his room for most of the day. Demetrius is visited by Damian, who knocks on his bedroom door in the hopes of receiving help for some homework. Without even opening the door to talk with his brother, Demetrius rejects him and directs him to their staff tutor. Later that day, when the family reunites for a rare family dinner, Demetrius does not interact with Damian at all, despite sitting across from him at the table, and quietly keeps to himself the entire time.

I'm Damian, scion of the Desmond family! I'll be a politician one day and protect this country! Father fought against all kinds of enemies during the war… and I… can fight too!
DAMIAN TO HIMSELF[1]

Damian Desmond (ダミアン・デズモンド, Damian Dezumondo?) is one of the recurring characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. He is the second son of Donovan and Melinda Desmond and is also the younger brother of Demetrius Desmond. He attends Eden Academy as a first-year student in Cecile Hall, Class 3, and is Anya Forger's classmate and rival.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


1/2


Damian is a young boy with short dark brown (sometimes blackish-brown) hair, hazel eyes, and light skin. Similar to his mother, Damian's eyes are narrowed and slightly drooping, with visibly long lower eyelashes and short, thin eyebrows above them. In the anime, his hair periodically has a greenish tinge. Damian often wears a condescending expression. In Anya's perspective, he gains a more stupider appearance with round, wide eyes.

Like other students, Damian is usually seen wearing Eden Academy's uniform. He also wears socks with vertical lines and black shoes.

One of Damian's casual clothing consists of him wearing a white vest with a golden "D" emblem imprinted on the top left side over a light blue or dark purple long-sleeved buttoned shirt of choice, blackish pants, and brown shoes. He still retains his striped socks in this outfit.
Personality

Due to his upbringing as the child of an important and powerful man, Damian gained a highly respected status among his peers by default, making him grow incredibly arrogant, assuming Anya gained a crush on him when he caught her staring at him. He is shown to prefer being called "Lord Damian" when spoken to. He gets angry when he is looked down upon by Anya's smug smile, quickly resorting to insulting her with his limited vocabulary and harassing Anya.

After taking a punch from Anya, he becomes very embarrassed around her. After Anya's tear-filled apology, Damian develops a crush on her that he does not want to acknowledge, denying it at every opportunity he gets.

Damian, Ewen, and Emile have a pillow fight
Damian getting into a pillow fight with his friends as they prevented him from studying
Later, it is hinted that a possible reason for Damian's behavior can be attributed to his brother's success as an Imperial Scholar and his father's influence which has set high expectations for him to strive and become part of the Imperial Scholars. Damian believes that getting a high status and achieving success will encourage his honored father to finally pay attention to him. These lofty ambitions very often encourage him to neglect others and even his own rest. Periodically, Damian allows himself to relax and be an ordinary child who likes to have fun and spend time with his friends. Although even in a playful manner, the boy may show signs of irritation or even anger if someone or something prevents him from achieving any merit.

The kids running to the cafeteria
Damian and his friends are determined to get ahead of Anya and Becky in getting the "Pastry of Knowledge"
The desire to become the pride of his father is the main motivator for Damian to make progress in various types of activities. This causes him to look down on others beneath his social class for if they are not a benefit to him, they only slow him down from becoming an Imperial Scholar and in turn, slow down his progress. Damian also has a fairly developed competitive spirit when he is ready to overcome not only himself but also intentionally step over others on the way to achieving his goals.

Despite his high ambitions, Damian is capable of self-sacrifice to the detriment of his interests. A rare exception is when he protects Anya from a ball in a dodgeball game, willingly getting himself eliminated. Though it did not help their class win the game, Anya recognized Damian's good nature. Another rare moment was in their classroom when a girl from their class was spreading a rude rumor about how Anya got her first Stella Star, Damian stood up for her, recognizing Anya's merit, although still mentally outraged that she was ahead of him in receiving the award. Damian would even offer his school supply case to George Glooman when he was told that he would be moving, though he would later demand George to return all the stuff he gave him after figuring out that this was not the case. During the bus hijacking by the Red Circus, he showed bravery and selflessness when he tried to save Anya, demanding that the terrorists give the bomb on her to him instead.

Damian tries to talk with Demetrius in a friendly way
Damian's futile attempts to have a casual chat with his brother
Behind his cocky, self-absorbed, snobby behavior is a sweet, insecure boy desperate for his parents' love and approval. After the bus hijacking incident, Damian is surprised and tearfully relieved that his mother came to pick him up. However, the boy tries to hide his weaknesses from his father and, not wanting to make him worry, asks his mother not to tell him that he cried. Despite the frequent neglect from his father, Damian continues to admire him and tries in every possible way to meet his expectations, especially after the unexpected praise that he received from him after meeting Loid. Periodically, Damian also tries to get closer to his estranged brother, once approaching Demetrius to congratulate him on his academic achievements, and becomes somewhat upset that his attempts to have a casual chat were met with cold indifference.
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Skills

Since Damian is still a child, most of his known abilities are limited.

Physical Ability: Although his strength as a child is limited, he is able to be one of the few that nearly survive to the end of the dodgeball match, despite having Bill Watkins as an opponent.

Endurance: Damian has shown to be quite tough, being able to block a shot from Bill Watkins, a kid who is much bigger than the size of an average 6-year-old.

Intelligence: As shown in his grades, Damian is a very studious and intelligent student, always striving for high grades and good scores. His discipline and responsibility made him have one of the highest grades in his class, and for this, he managed to get a Stella for being in the top 2 highest grades in the History midterm.
Special Moves

Special Move	Image	Description
Desmond-Style Rolling Sweep
(デズモンド 流 ローリングスイープ,
Dezumondo-Ryū Rōringu Suīpu?)	
Damian's Rolling Sweep Anime
Damian's cleaning move, in which he spins forward in a circular motion while sweeping away anything in his path. Those nearby will get caught up in the dust clouds it creates.[4]
Paradise Fist
(楽園の左手パラダイス・レフト,
Paradaisu Refuto?, lit. "Left Hand of Paradise")	
Damian's Paradise Fist
To deal with his buzzing feelings of jealousy toward Anya's new friends, Damian, with the help of Ewen and Emile, creates a "Paradise Fist" in his dream to acknowledge and make peace with his feelings. He later crafts a "physical manifestation" of the fist.[5]
Other special moves include:
Lightning Note-Taking (ライトニング 筆記, Raitoningu Hikki?)[2]
Imperial Scholar Cape Flap (インペリアル・スカラー ばさばさ, Inperiaru Sukarā Basabasa?)[2]
ADVERTISEMENT
Weaknesses

Scoleciphobia: Damian is terrified of worms. He runs away in a panic from Ewen and Emile when they chase him, holding these invertebrates in their hands.[6]

Insecurity: Behind his prideful behavior, Damian is actually very insecure about himself and has low self-esteem, mainly due to the estrangement between other family members. He secretly believes that his own family considers him a failure. Damian tries to hide it from others by acting arrogant and looking down on anyone who is beneath his social class.

Poor Vocabulary: Damian is stated to have poor vocabulary skills as his grade in Language Studies is very low. During his first term finals, he did not place in the top ten in the subject and was later assigned to Class F, a lower class, alongside Anya for the next term.
