BYRON TO BECKY BLACKBELL[1]

Byron Blackbell (バイロン・ブラックベル, Bairon Burakkuberu?) is the father of Becky Blackbell and the CEO of Blackbell Heavy Industries, a major military contractor in Ostania.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Byron appears to be a tall, middle-aged man. Similar to his daughter, he has short dark brown hair with uneven bangs that are swept to the side, narrow-shaped eyes with double eyelids, and thin and short eyebrows. He also has a walrus moustache.

Byron typically wears a dark brown suit with a tie that has many military aircrafts printed on it. He also wears a pin of a lit bomb on his left lapel.
Personality

Byron is a seemingly competent businessman and CEO for his company, but his switch can be completely flipped by his daughter Becky, whom he dotes on extremely. He is willing to summon the entirety of his company's arsenal to save her from danger, though his impulsive actions often earn him a reprimanding from his servant, Martha Marriott, and his own wife.
History

Young Becky refusing to go to Eden
Byron and Martha listen to a young Becky refusing to go to Eden
Not much is known about Byron's past. Still, he appears to have established himself as the patriarch of the Blackbell family and as the CEO of their family company, Blackbell Heavy Industries, in Ostania. At some point in his life, he took a wife, and six years before the beginning of Operation Strix, they had Becky, whom he quickly grew to adore. Martha Marriott, a long-term member of the Blackbell family's household staff, became Becky's steward and helped look after her. At a very young age, Becky developed a haughty and precocious attitude. When she learned she would be attending Eden Academy, Becky initially refused and stated she did not want to go to a school with "ill-bred kids," shocking Byron as he questioned where his daughter learned to say those words.[2]
ADVERTISEMENT

Synopsis

Eden Beginnings Arc

Byron is first mentioned when Loid recognizes Becky at Eden Academy's orientation ceremony, realizing she is his daughter and recognizing his high position. It is also implied that he was present at Cecile Hall's class photo at the end of the orientation.[3]

Stella Star Arc

After Anya gets her first Stella Star, she and Becky discuss getting rewards from their parents, prompting the latter to think about the many rewards Byron has gifted her, including her pet dog Wiesel.[4]

Imperial Scholars Mixer Arc

Blackbell Family Anime
Becky remembers her father's words
Sometime before the Imperial Scholars mixer, Becky rents the department store so she and Anya can go on a shopping trip together. Near the end of their outing, Anya buys them both sheep keychains as a souvenir of their trip together. Becky is initially hesitant to accept the gift as she remembers Byron stating that he only wants her to wear the finest things, Martha pushes her to accept Anya's gesture of friendship, saying that her father would tell her the same thing.[1]

Cruise Adventure Arc

After the midterm break, the students of Cecile Hall began bragging to each other about the trips the took during the break. Becky steals the spotlight as she talks about how she got her father to help her meet the Berlint in Love actress Rachel at a party.[5]

WISE Arc

When Becky visits the Forger home for a playdate with Anya, Loid takes the opportunity to get intel about Byron and his company through her. While talking with Becky, Loid asks about her activities with her father, though the lovesick girl mistakenly assumes he is trying to get closer to her.[6]

Red Circus Arc

When two of Eden Academy's buses get hijacked by the Red Circus, Cecile Hall and Wald Hall's bus are controlled by Billy Squire and two of his comrades. While Billy explains his group's intentions to use the young scions as hostages, he calls out the children of important parents, including Becky as Byron's daughter. As he tells them to pray that their parents will pressure the government to negotiate with his group, a teary-eyed Becky assures herself that Byron will never let her get hurt. Later, when Becky and Anya hatch a plan to reveal their situation to the public, Becky writes a note with her family's SOS code.[7]

Mr. Blackbell gets hit on the head by Martha
Martha urges Byron to stop acting impulsively
Thanks to Becky's note, the news of the bus hijacking reaches Blackbell Industries, causing Byron to go into a frenzy. Fearing for his daughter's life, he immediately calls for every tank and fighter jet in their storage to be dispatched and rescue his daughter. Martha quickly stops him by karate chopping the back of his head and asking him if he is trying to get Becky killed, telling him not to start a war. When Byron starts sobbing as he wants to save his daughter, Martha says she understands his feelings but reminds him that sending military vehicles after the kidnappers would only provoke them. She then tells him they need to act more calmly and that she will go to the scene by herself.[8]

Becky and Byron hug
Byron reunites with Becky after the hijacking
When the bus gets stopped by the police, Byron joins Martha as she drives to the scene. Despite her warnings that it is unsafe for him to leave the car, Byron rushes out and asks the police where his daughter is. An officer holds him back and tells him civilians are not allowed beyond their position, prompting Byron to reveal his position while childishly throwing his arms. Later, after the police negotiate with the Red Circus to bring the hostages food and water, Byron decides to have his family chef cook them the finest of meals, but Martha refuses, pointing out the ridiculousness of his statement, then tells the officers to bring out the field rations she brought.[9] After the hostages are freed from the bus following Billy Squire's surrender and the arrest of the Red Circus members, Byron rushes to Becky and has a tearful reunion with her. Becky asks about her mother, to which Byron says he would never bring her somewhere as dangerous as this. He then suggests they return home to put his wife's mind at ease, so they leave alongside Martha.[10]

Term Break Arc

Loid meets Becky's parents for the first time
Byron meets Loid for the first time
During Eden's end-of-term break, Byron attends Berlint's annual Winter Festival with his family and Martha. There, they meet the Forger family, and Byron greets Loid Forger, saying he has heard a lot about him from Becky. He then brings up hearing rumors that Loid is seducing Becky, which Loid quickly explains is a misunderstanding.

When Damian challenges Becky and Anya to a game of ring toss to make them leave the festival, Becky retorts that he is making up arbitrary rules and is not the owner of the festival. Byron chimes in to agree but not before saying that Becky is the true star of the festival, earning him a scolding from Martha. As the children prepare to play the game, Byron watches in shock as Becky asks Yor for advice on winning instead of him, and he tries to point out that he is also there to help. Byron later calms down and smiles as he watches Becky play with her schoolmates. After Damian wins the game, he decides to let the girls stay at the festival. His butler, Jeeves, tells the boy that a statesman's eyes should always observe the common folk, and Byron parrots him to emphasize the common folk.

Later, when Becky and Anya decide to visit a clairvoyant hall and get readings, Byron attempts to join them, wanting to see his compatibility with his daughter. However, he gets held back by his wife, who asks Martha to look after Becky in their stead.[11] After the girls return from their readings, the school friend group continues to stick together for the remainder of the festival at Anya's request, and Loid takes the opportunity to gather more intel from Byron and the other important men in the group. At the end of the festival, Byron returns home with his family and Martha.[12]

ADVERTISEMENT

Relationships

Becky Blackbell

Becky's Rewards Anime
Byron's many gifts for Becky
Byron greatly dotes on his daughter and often coddles her, frequently buying her expensive gifts such as a tiara with real gems, a pink tank, her own smaller house, and other such presents. He also taught her that, as a Blackbell, she should not wear anything less than the finest. While they do not appear to see each other often because of his work, Byron deeply cares for Becky and tries to spend time with her as much as he can. He can also be very defensive of her, as shown when he is willing to summon the entirety of his company's arsenal to save her from the hands of the Red Circus, and shows slightly veiled hostility toward Loid, whom Becky has a crush on.

Mrs. Blackbell

While not much has been shown between these two, Byron appears to care for his wife quite dearly, as he did not bring her to the Red Circus bus hijacking to keep her safe, saying he would "never bring her somewhere as dangerous as this." Later, when he was able to reunite with Becky, he suggested they go home and see her to put her mind at ease, knowing she was worried sick. Similar to Martha, Mrs. Blackbell is also aware of Byron's deep affection for their daughter and often keeps him in check.

Martha Marriott

Martha holds back Byron
Byron gets held back by Martha from acting irrationally
Martha is a long-term servant to Byron and his family. Years of servitude under the Blackbells have made Martha and Byron quite familiar with each other, as she once advised Becky not to decline Anya's gesture of friendship with her gift so she would not sully the Blackbell name, certain that the girl's father would say the same. While she may be his servant, Byron appears to be prone to acting immaturely, especially when it comes to Becky, so Martha is not afraid to act against him when he begins acting unreasonably, often needing to keep him grounded and remind him to act appropriately as not just the CEO of Blackbell Industries but as an adult. Sometimes, Byron's energy and military impulses encourage Martha to calm him physically in order to stop his reckless escapades.

SYLVIA TO A WISE ROOKIE[1]

Sylvia Sherwood (シルヴィア・シャーウッド, Shiruvuia Shāuddo?), also known as Handler (管理官ハンドラー, Handorā ?) or the "Fullmetal Lady" (鋼鉄の淑女フルメタル・レディ, Furumetaru Redi?), is one of the recurring characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. She is the commanding officer of WISE within Ostania and Twilight's main contact for Operation Strix.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Sylvia is a tall woman with a slim figure and narrow blue eyes. She has wavy red hair reaching the middle of her back. She is also sometimes seen having pink nail polish.

Though Sylvia disguises herself in public, she typically sports a pair of round-framed glasses and a black, wide-brimmed hat with a dark pink band that has a bow on the side. In her role as "Handler," Sylvia most frequently wears a fitted black dress with a low-cut square neckline over a white collared shirt and a large black ribbon tied under the collar like a loose bow, as well as square-shaped drop earrings in the shape of WISE's symbol. The back of her dress is long, reaching below her knees, while the front reaches mid-thigh. She also wears fishnets over black stockings with black high heels.

Sylvia briefly wore garish rings that were gifted to her by Loid and Fiona[3][4] as souvenir after the two won the Campbelldon tennis tournament for an infiltration mission[5].

Sylvia's age is unknown, but it is advanced enough to the point that it has become a concern for her in physical combat, and even Anya has commented on how old she looks.[6]

As Secretary Sherwood, Sylvia ties her hair in a ponytail and dons rectangular-shaped glasses. She also wears a dark coat over a black suit and skirt.
ADVERTISEMENT

Personality

Little has been revealed about Sylvia's personality. She is similar to Twilight in her commitment, skill, and logical approach to her endeavors. She is extremely dedicated to her given task; preserving peace between Westalis and Ostania by inserting Twilight into Donovan Desmond's inner circle. Like Twilight, she is willing to assist Anya's acquisition of Stella Stars by any means (including deception and espionage). Despite this, some of her plans for ensuring Operation Strix's success—such as bribing Anya or creating scenarios where Anya can be framed positively—have been dubious at best, and her suggestions for Operation Strix have posed unnecessary danger for the spies she manages. Dubbed the "Fullmetal Lady" by her agents, Sylvia has a fearsome reputation, as even her best agent, Twilight, would not even address the price tag she unknowingly left on her disguise out of fear and imagined that she would hold him at gunpoint to continue working if he asked for time off.

Sylvia reassuring Anya
Sylvia calming down Anya at the end of the Doggy Crisis
Sylvia is deeply compassionate and has a gentle and motherly side. Having been a mother herself, Sylvia said that she once had a daughter around Anya's age, who is implied to have been lost during the second East-West war. She demonstrates these strengths in allowing Anya to keep Bond after Minister Brantz's assassination attempt and placating the child's concerns about the welfare of the other bomb dogs. She also appears to have a soft spot for animals, as she took in one of the dogs as her own pet, naming him Aaron, who she bonds with and takes good care of.

As shown in her speech to the student terrorists, Sylvia has a deep-seated hatred of war. Her fervent disgust for—and knowledge of—the atrocities and horrors of war seem to indicate that she suffered a great deal in the last conflict.

Sylvia remembers her trainings with Twilight
Sylvia training Twilight's spy mindset
While training rookie agents, Sylvia expresses a strong distaste for ignorance and instructs them to act based on objective reasoning. As such, she orders them to keep an open mind and to search for truths themselves, stressing the value of information. Though she can be hard on her agents, Sylvia does care for them and their health—though Sylvia herself has admitted that she cherishes her most valuable workers and had to get told off by upper management about overworking them to ease up. She has allowed Loid to take time off to go on a vacation with his family and after he collapsed in his own home, and told Fiona to not push herself too hard and get herself killed.

Despite maintaining an immaculate public appearance, Sylvia's home is a complete mess, and she even tends to leave garbage in her office. Sylvia herself is indifferent to her mess and ignores her friend's loud complaints about it, although his duration eventually irritates her. She became unconcerned about tidiness due to the loss of her family during the war, believing that cleanliness does not matter when alone. However, Sylvia later changes her mind for the sake of her dog, who begins to suffer due to the mess in their apartment. It is also established that her age is a sensitive topic for Sylvia, as she once became slightly offended by Anya, who told her "even at your age."

Sylvia confesses to Fiona about her desire to disguise herself as a nurse
Fiona discovers Sylvia's playful side
Sylvia has surprisingly a childish side that she rarely shows to others. When changing her disguise to avoid the two SSS agents tailing her, she actually admires the new coat she wore.[7] While at a park with her dog, she immediately engages in a bet with Loid to see who has the best dog, wanting to prove her leadership skills are superior. In another instance, after Fiona was hospitalized, she disguised herself as a nurse and paid a visit to her subordinate, mostly because she wanted to wear the nurse's uniform, with Fiona accusing her of playing around. She also teases Fiona about not pushing herself too much, even for Twilight, implying her awareness of Fiona's feelings for her co-worker.
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Skills

Keen Intellect: As a spy handler, Sylvia has memorized and remembered the many agents and missions that she is in charge of.[8] She is also able to spot minute details, such as when she spotted Pance Karmer out of place in a crowd while disguised as a security officer, noting minor details like him missing a baton or appearing on the wrong patrol route.[1]

Disguise: Sylvia competently alters her appearance, as she often assumes various façades to shake off SSS pursuers in order to contact agents like Twilight outside the embassy and has disguised herself as a nurse to fill in for Twilight and Nightfall's jobs at Berlint General Hospital. However, she does appear to make occasional mistakes, as she once forgot to remove the price tag from the coat of he disguise.

Sylvia briefs Loid
Sylvia overseeing Loid's work in Operation Strix
Spy Handler: As a handler, Sylvia is the Westalian Intelligence agency's primary liaison with agents in Ostania and is responsible for managing them and their missions. Her primary duties include watching for signs of restlessness in Ostania and deploying her agents to prevent any potential incidents. Despite the strict surveillance from the nation's secret police, Sylvia manages to evade notice while competently handling her agents, earning her the nickname "Fullmetal Lady."

Expert Hand-to-Hand Combatant: Sylvia is skilled in unarmed combat and readily makes use of makeshift weapons as shown with her quick immobilization of Pance Karmer with a belt in thwarting his assassination attempt against Jonas Wellman.[1]

Weapons: During the terrorist bombing incident, Sylvia is seen loading a gun. However, her skills and capabilities with it remain to be unseen.
ADVERTISEMENT

Weaknesses

Age: Although her precise age is unknown, she is visibly disadvantaged by it with bouts of weakness and back and shoulder pain after combat, which secretly concerns her.

You're weak. You're afraid to die. You're afraid of being betrayed. You're incapable of trusting anyone. You have no one to believe in. No one to gaze at and intently scrutinize. You've given up on the world. Now you're just an empty man meddling in it for no reason greater than your own amusement. But I'm not afraid. I believe in that man. I think of him and think of him and think of him and think of him and think of him and think of him. It's what makes me strong!! It's why you have no hope of beating me!
FIONA TO WINSTON WHEELER[1]

Fiona Frost (フィオナ・フロスト, Fiona Furosuto?) is one of the recurring characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. She is a spy for WISE who acts under the codename "Nightfall" (〈夜帷とばり〉, <Tobari>?). She works undercover as an office worker at Berlint General Hospital to support Loid Forger's cover story.


Appearance

Fiona is a fairly tall and very attractive woman with a pale complexion and a slender figure. She has bobbed hair of a light lavender color and a long fringe covering much of the right side of her face, swept behind her left ear. Fiona has cold purple eyes framed by light-colored eyelashes and is most often seen wearing an emotionless expression. She is described as beautiful by Yor and has several admirers. Fiona's age is currently uncertain, but she appears to be younger than Loid.

Fiona is introduced wearing a yellow-buttoned dark blue pea coat with a purple turtleneck and black leather pants underneath, brown leather gloves, and ankle-high button boots with black heels when visiting the Forgers' apartment. Her stud earrings are black and take the shape of WISE's symbol.

When working in Berlint General Hospital as an office worker, Fiona typically wears a long-sleeved dark blue sweater, a gray vest with black stripes and buttons over a white long-sleeved shirt, a black knee-length office skirt, dark gray tights, and black shoes with heels.
Personality

Fiona's thoughts
Fiona mentally screams about her love for Loid
After being trained by Twilight to hide her true emotions, Fiona tends to remain emotionless on the surface—even when making a mental confession of love to him.[5] Fiona is deeply in love with Loid, to the point of being capable of compromising Operation Strix by visiting the Forgers' residence and even telling Sylvia Sherwood and Loid himself to replace Yor and let her take over the role of the Forger wife. Fiona thinks of herself as Loid's superior partner and wishes to separate him from Yor so they can be together. However, her desire and love for Loid make Fiona unable to comprehend the bigger picture, as fulfilling them would cause suspicions and compromise Operation Strix.

To others, like her co-workers, Fiona is seen as an unscrupulous and ambitious woman, capable of backstabbing her peers to build a reputation even bigger than Twilight's own. While this is true to an extent, her desire to build her reputation stems not from ambition or a lack of scruples per se but rather from her desire to impress Loid.

Fiona realizes Sylvia knows her feelings for Twilight
Fiona's embarrassment at Sylvia's awareness of her feelings for Twilight
Despite her usually reserved facade, Fiona has let her true feelings surface in rare instances. After Loid gets mocked by the Bolic Brothers during the Campbelldon tennis tournament, Fiona retaliates by beating them with tennis smashes. Later, when she challenges Yor to a tennis match with the intention of breaking her, Fiona is visibly in shock upon witnessing Yor's absurd strength and is crushed after losing to her. As she speeds away in her car, she breaks into tears and declares that she will never give up her ambition. Later, when she sees Loid defeated and his life endangered at the hands of Winston Wheeler, Fiona goes into a rage and openly speaks her feelings as she defeats the rogue spy. She is also capable of severe embarrassment, which happens to her after recognizing that Sylvia knows about her feelings for Twilight.

Fiona commissions Franky
Fiona visits Franky with a new commission
Fiona can act hastily in getting missions done, especially if Loid is involved. For example, when infiltrating the Campbelldon tennis tournament with Loid, Fiona pushed herself to complete their mission and impress him as much as she could, to the point of bruising her hands. Fiona is also very distrustful of others and is willing to use them as pawns to fulfill her goals, like when she gained the help of a counterfeiter by calling SSS agents on him and subsequently protecting him from them. Despite her methods, Fiona is a proficient spy and capable of partnering with others, like Franky, who she has grown to trust to some extent.
Abilities and Skills

Fiona training with a bear in the mountains
Fiona towing logs and a bear while training
Enhanced Strength and Stamina: While not as powerful compared to the stronger characters in the series, Fiona has impressive physical strength, shown when she took down the Bolic Brothers with her tennis smashes, who were strong enough to rip apart a steel fence with their bare hands, and, to some degree, even managed to rally a shot by Yor in a tennis match. After losing to Yor in said match, Fiona took to the mountains to train for her revenge match, which has improved her strength and endurance. She was able to pull a pile of tied-up logs with a bear sitting upon it and tame a mountain goat and an alligator.[6]

Fiona punches Winston
Fiona shows her powerful strength when she is enraged
When Fiona reaches a state of complete rage, her physical prowess becomes extraordinary, allowing her to deliver inhumanly powerful blows. During her confrontation with Winston, her intense anger enabled her to incapacitate him effortlessly, disabling both his arms and sending him flying. It is implied that Fiona's training in the mountains played a significant role in enhancing her strength to such extraordinary levels. This training also likely contributed to her exceptional combat abilities, granting her tremendous power when her emotions are unleashed. However, in this state, the strength and force of Fiona's blows are so great that they have serious effects on her body. Every limb she used to strike Winston with broke, and even a missed punch dislocated her arm.[1]

Fiona defeats Winston
Fiona's fast speed while enraged
Enhanced Speed and Agility: Fiona has demonstrated to be quite nimble and fast. She is capable of performing several acrobatic moves to avoid rubber bullets fired from multiple angles in the middle of an underground tennis match.[7] She was also able to dodge a bullet from an SSS agent while simultaneously throwing a knife at his hand to disable him.[8] When enraged, Fiona's speed gains a massive increase, as during her fight with Winston, her movements were so fast that the skilled spy was barely able to dodge her attacks.[1]

Enhanced Durability and Endurance: Fiona is shown to be quite resistant to injuries. As mentioned above, in her enraged state, every limb she used to strike Winston with broke, and even a missed punch dislocated her arm, Despite those injuries, Fiona continued the fight without any problem and was completely unfazed by any possible pain that came out of it until her adrenaline wore off.[1]

Fiona shows Loid her selection of prizes from Cavi's collection
Fiona's poker face
Poker Face: After training herself to show no emotions, Fiona is able to completely conceal them, making it impossible for anyone to tell what emotion she is feeling. At all times, she has a stone-cold look on her face, whether she is happy, upset, angry, or even while internally proposing her love. Anya is one of the few people who knows her true nature thanks to her psychic powers, with the other being Sylvia, who has been shown to see through Fiona's facade.

Enhanced Senses: Fiona has good eyesight and can spot things from far away, whether it be watching someone from across a hall, noticing SSS agents stalking from behind, or detecting the little movements of a person through binoculars.

Fiona defeats her enemy
Fiona defeats her enemy
Expert Hand-to-Hand Combatant: After being trained by Twilight, Fiona has proven to be a formidable combatant. During an urgent mission intended for her former mentor, she took on an entire enemy group by herself and is capable of slamming a man into the ground after lifting him over her head.[6]

Weapons: Fiona is very adept with weaponry. She has her own personal handgun. Also, in a mission where Fiona took Loid's place in exterminating an enemy group, she is seen equipped with a vast variety of weapons, which include, but are not limited to, an assault rifle and grenades.[6]

Loid and Fiona Tennis
Fiona and Loid working together
Twilight: Although this is not a skill as such, Fiona's unwavering dedication to keep fighting, her pursuit of strength, and her overall demeanor are profoundly influenced by her connection to Twilight. He serves as her primary motivation and driving force for almost everything she does. The deep attachment she feels towards him leads her to go to extraordinary lengths, even engaging in confrontations or causing harm to others if they obstruct Twilight and his ideals.

Fiona's abilities are significantly amplified when she believes she can satisfy Twilight, as demonstrated during the Campbelldon tournament, where both of them collaborated seamlessly, utilizing Loid's motivation as a driving force to achieve victory in a surprising manner, working in perfect coordination to defeat their rivals. Her devotion to him extends to an extreme level, as she would willingly make the ultimate sacrifice for his well-being. A clear example of this is seen when Winston incapacitates Twilight, and Fiona, fueled by her fierce protectiveness, delivers inhuman blows to Winston, disregarding her own safety, resulting in breaking most of her bones. Loid's presence and happiness form the foundation of Fiona's actions, pushing her to extraordinary measures to ensure his safety and fulfill his desires.

The unnamed WISE Agent is one of the supporting characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. He works as a senior spy for WISE in Ostania.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


1/2


The WISE Agent is an older man with a slicked back brown gray hair styled in a pompadour and Chevron-style mustache.

He wears a black jacket over a collared white shirt, with a striped tie and grey pants. Occasionally, in order to blend in with ordinary civilians, the Agent wears a white cap with the WISE logo on it. For the same purpose, he also has a false beard and another light cap with a dark letter "W" above the visor.
Personality

The Agent is a reliable ally to the agents of WISE. He is a light-hearted man, often making jokes and witty remarks around Sylvia and his fellow agents. However, he does show a more serious side, especially while on missions. When not on the field, the Agent can be seen lounging around on the couch of the safe house, but he carefully gathers intel from word-of-mouth to television news to share with Sylvia. Despite his experience, he sometimes acts impulsively, as during the terrorist plot to assassinate Minister Brantz, he was in a hurry to capture Keith Kepler, the group's leader, and almost opened a door which was rigged to detonate had Loid not stopped him.
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Skills

Disguise: The Agent can decently disguise himself while on missions or contacting other agents in public.

Expert Marksman: The Agent is able to conduct firefights even in moving vehicles.

Strength: The Agent appears to have decent strength, as he was able to carry Winston Wheeler, who was noted by Loid to be quite heavy, on his shoulder while escaping Shellbury, though he did show some strain while carrying him.
Relationships

Loid Forger

WISE Agent teases Loid
The Agent teases Loid
A fellow co-worker of Twilight, the Agent works alongside the master spy, assisting him in missions across Ostania. He often teases Loid about his double life, remarking that it must be hard for him to balance parenthood and his mission, joking that he showed up for nothing after the Red Circus bus hijacking crisis was resolved without the need for the SSS strike team that they infiltrated, and suggesting that Loid should comfort Anya as they watched her and Yor reunite.

Later, after their squad captured the rogue agent and mole Winston Wheeler, the exhausted Agent invites Loid to go out for some drinks. When he is turned down, he remarks that Loid is only a family man whenever he wants to get out of something.

Sylvia Sherwood

WISE Agent scolds Sylvia for her sloppiness
The Agent scolds Sylvia for her sloppiness
Unlike the rest of Sylvia's subordinates, the Agent does not fear her, as he tends to make jokes around and to her, despite her strict demeanor. When it comes to following the Handler's orders, the Agent diligently follows and makes sure they are seen through. Sometimes he even argues with her, as shown when he tried to defend Erik Zacharis's hobby and chastised her for her slovenliness around their office.

Fiona Frost

Fiona and Loid preparing for their match
Loid remembers the Agent's warning about Fiona during their mission
Both the Agent and Nightfall are field operatives who have been entrusted with several missions. While he does trust Fiona and her capabilities, the Agent, like the rest of his peers, sees Fiona as a cold-hearted woman trying to make a name for herself, to the point that he warns Loid to keep an eye on her when they are assigned to a joint operation together.

During the operation to apprehend Winston Wheeler, both Fiona and the Agent were assigned to it alongside Loid. While Loid aimed to divert the attention of the SSS, the two maintained close proximity to Winston, seizing any opportunity to catch him. After successfully capturing Winston, the Agent commented on Fiona's stubbornness and said it would eventually get her killed when she insisted on walking while injured.

Becky Blackbell (ベッキー・ブラックベル, Bekkī Burakkuberu?) is one of the recurring characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. She is the daughter of the CEO of Blackbell Heavy Industries, a major military manufacturer in Ostania.[6][7] She attends Eden Academy as a first-year student in Cecile Hall, Class 3, and is Anya Forger's best friend.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


1/2


Becky is a young girl with fair skin and shoulder-length dark brown hair with uneven bangs that are swept to the side. Her eyes are light brown (hazel in the cover of Volume 9), narrow-shaped with double eyelids, and have prominent upper and lower eyelashes. Her eyebrows are thin and short, and there is usually a slight blush on her face.

Like all other female students, Becky is usually seen wearing Eden Academy's uniform. She also wears black knee-high socks and black shoes and carries around a brown schoolbag with a sheep keychain attached. During the interclass dodgeball match, Becky ties her hair with red ribbons when she is wearing the school gym uniform, along with black socks and gym shoes.

Becky's hair is typically tied into two side ponytails, and they are tied up with pink scrunchies. Her bangs are also usually held up with a hairclip that resembles a lit bomb. Depending on the occasion, Becky lets her hair down, and her hairclips tend to change, especially when she is going out. So far, Becky has worn hairclips of a fighter jet, a flower, a butterfly, Yor's earring[8], a heart arrow[9], an ammonite fossil[10], and a rose[11].
ADVERTISEMENT

Personality

Episode 6-6
Becky is impressed by Anya's apparent maturity
Becky is a very kind child, but as the daughter of an elite, she is shown to be somewhat prideful and tries to act more mature than she is, initially attempting to take Anya under her wing when she sees her as a brat. Becky does not attempt to get close to Damian Desmond despite his social position, even looking down on their classmates who try to befriend him. She also looked down on Anya when she was getting bullied by Damian's group during their orientation, but Anya's smug smile and defiance toward Damian later won over Becky's admiration and respect, after which the two girls became friends.

Becky accepts the friendship keychain from Anya
Becky embarrassedly accepts a gift from Anya
Despite their difference in social status, Becky genuinely cares about Anya and supports her, although some of Anya's words seem absurd or incomprehensible to her. She also cares what Anya thinks of her own actions and sometimes worries she is just dragging her along with her antics. When Anya gifts her a matching keychain as a sign of their friendship, Becky is touched by her friend's gesture and accepts it, although the keychain would be considered a cheap trinket compared to the more expensive gifts she is accustomed to receiving.

Becky is also quite patient, going along with Anya's desire to be called "Starlight Anya" after her success at getting a Stella Star, even though she quickly got annoyed by it.[12] She is also a caring and protective girl as seen when she often confronts Damian whenever he bullies Anya, even promising to Anya that she will protect her no matter what.

Becky has proven to be fairly intelligent and academically gifted, ranking 42nd on her exam out of over 200 students, thus meeting Eden's overall standards. She also strives to be an idealized version of an adult by engaging in such hobbies as watching adult romance TV programs. However, this has made it difficult for her to associate with her peers, making her friendless for a while.

Anya surprises Becky and Martha with her cash
Becky does not think Anya has enough money
Becky is also seen to have a somewhat low outlook on monetary value, as seen when she shows little interest in mentioning how she gained presents such as a diamond-embedded doll and her own small house in her yard for doing well in school. At the same time, she is well aware of how rich she is. Her wealth often gives her what she wants, and periodically she willingly uses it to get what she desires. Becky is also capable of casually offending others by showing her surprise at their lower income, although sometimes she does not do this intentionally. She periodically demonstrates this trait with Anya. For example, Becky was not impressed with her friend's cash that her father gave her for their shopping trip, and when she visited Anya's home for a play date, Becky compared it with her larger home during the house tour, which prompted Anya to end it.

Episode 19-3
Becky's excitement for Anya and her "crush"
Becky is a romantic girl, being a big fan of romance movies and television shows like Berlint in Love, which she enjoys watching in her free time.[13] She even thinks that Anya's efforts to get along with Damian are because Anya has a crush on him, so she often tries to help her win his heart. Becky is also aware of Damian's crush on Anya and teases him for it, and while she does not like him, she enjoys the perceived romance between him and her friend, believing that seeing their drama is better than her TV romances.

Becky can be mean, though she rarely shows this side of herself. Whenever arguing with Damian and his friends, she throws back just as nasty insults when they insult her and Anya. When George Glooman arrived at school the day after he claimed that he would have to leave Eden due to his family company's apparent bankruptcy, Becky coldly told him to return the gifts their classmates gave to him, which she later brought up as leverage to get a macaron from him.

Becky teases the other kids
Becky teasing other kids before getting into Eden
Before meeting Anya, Becky used to act cocky and often engaged in fights with other kids after teasing them for their lower social position, which left her with no friends at all. The only bond she had besides her parents was with her butler Martha Marriott, who acts as a mother figure for Becky. Thanks to her friendship with Anya, Becky has changed her behavior toward others. Proof of this is when she invites Anya to go shopping together in order to help her friend get closer to Damian. While initially putting all of her efforts into helping Anya, Becky later focuses on buying dresses for herself to impress Anya's dad, Loid. After seeing Anya get exhausted from shopping, Becky worries she was dragging her friend along and nervously asks if she disliked their outing, but Anya answers that she had so much fun, which makes Becky feel genuinely happy. The girls then each get a sheep keychain as a memento of their trip and eventually forget the reason they went to buy clothes in the first place. Martha later points out that Anya is the first person Becky truly cares for.
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Skills

Becky is still a child, so most of her known abilities are limited.

Martha sees Yor training Becky
Becky trained by Yor
Strength: Becky strength is limited as she is a child, but she was taught some basic strength training and how to punch by Yor.[14] When Damian annoys her and Anya, she threatens to hit him with a knockout punch, referring to the punch Yor taught them.[15]

Intelligence: Despite Becky not being among the highest-grade students, she is very intelligent and studious since she has basic knowledge of many subjects. During her first term, Becky passed all of her midterm exams and ranked 42nd place overall. In the term finals, she passed all of her exams and moved up to 38th place overall.

Becky goes shopping with Wiesel and Martha
Becky chooses the right outfit
Sense of Style: Despite her young age, Becky is already well-versed in fashion and modern trends. It seems that in her free time, she is a favorite customer in many stores where she often buys a lot of elegant outfits, and sometimes she even orders them at her home for a long fitting. In addition, Becky is able to choose fashionable outfits not only for herself but also to give fashion advice to others.

Becky shows off her paper Loid model
Becky's paper Loid model
Crafting: Becky has been demonstrated to be quite competent at crafting. During an arts and crafts class, she created by herself a paper model of Loid and fashioned it with a paper combat suit replicating her father's company designs. She later created a paper model of a crocodile.

Maturity: Although at certain moments she becomes very self-centered and spoiled (which is understood by the environment in which she was raised), Becky comes to make decisions with maturity and responsibility as she is frequently advising and supporting of Anya, guiding and helping her in situations the girl does not understand. Even when Billy Squire and the Red Circus hijack their bus, despite being scared for Anya and herself, Becky devised a plan to let the people outside know about their current situation.

WILKER ABOUT YURI BRIAR[1]

Director Wilker (ウィルカー局長, Wirukā Kyokucho?) is the director of the State Security Service. He is the man who scouted Yuri Briar into the organization and dotes on him because he finds him adorable.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Wilker appears to be a middle-aged man with receding dirty blond hair and long sideburns to form a mutton chops beard.

Wilker is always seen at SSS headquarters and wears his standard SSS uniform. His distinguishing feature is his dark sunglasses that cover his intimidating eyes.
Personality

On the surface, Wilker appears to be a cheerful man and is always seen with a smile. He demeanor allows him to get along with many of his subordinates, whom he sometimes invites out for drinking parties after work. Hiding underneath his jovial demeanor is a man who takes his work very seriously and dislikes those in allegiance with WISE.
History

One year before the start of Operation Strix, Wilker recruited Yuri, who was initially working at the Ministry for Foreign Affairs, to the SSS. When asked by his other subordinates why he took on such a young man into their organization, Wilker claimed it was because he found Yuri to be "adorable" and like a "cute little puppy."
ADVERTISEMENT

Synopsis

Secret Police Arc

After one of the Lieutenant's subordinate asks why Wilker recruited Yuri, the Lieutenant recounts what the director told him in the past.[1]

Imperial Scholars Mixer Arc

After Yuri arrests journalist Franklin Perkin, Wilker congratulates the young man at headquarters and says he is proud of him. Having heard that Yuri has been working a lot despite being a new recruit, Wilker asks how he is doing. Yuri happily answers that this is the job for him and declares to one day catch Twilight. Wilker finds that "real swell" and promises to treat Yuri to a steak dinner sometime.[2]

Red Circus Arc

At headquarters, Wilker receives a report from Division 4 regarding the remnants of the Red Circus group and their leader Billy Squire, who has returned to Ostania.[3]

Mole Hunt Arc

Wilker sends out a message for an emergency summons, calling all officers to headquarters. Wilker announces to Yuri and the other agents about the return of Winston Wheeler, their intelligence agent from Westalis, who has stolen valuable intel from WISE. He orders them to cooperate with Wheeler's division to secure him once he crosses the border and not to let the pursuing WISE interfere.[4] Later, when the SSS officers arrive at the northwestern region of Shellbury to secure Wheeler, an officer in Yuri's group informs his teammates that Wilker said that their current operation is an unofficial one in order to avoid causing a stir with Westalis.[5]

Wilker reveals Jeffrey as the mole
Wilker exposes Jeffrey as a mole for WISE.
When Loid disguises himself as Winston to trick the SSS agents, he tells them that he had a yellow gemstone tiepin as his signal, so the agents make a call to Wilker at HQ. After receiving the message, Wilker goes to chat with one of their members, Jeffrey. Wilker reveals to Jeffrey that the agents never specified the gemstone's color, but told other agents different colors. This would reveal who was leaking their information, and Wilker proceeds to expose Jeffrey as a mole for WISE.[6]

Although the SSS's mission ended with a draw, Wilker congratulated Yuri for his fight against Twilight, saying that Yuri was the first ever to land a blow on the spy.[7]

Current Arc

After Yuri, the Lieutenant, and Chloe finish interrogating prisoners, Wilker happily approaches the three and invites them to get steak with him tonight. He says they still need to celebrate Yuri's fight with Twilight, especially with the calmer atmosphere, but the Lieutenant sees his words as an excuse to go drinking. Yuri declines to spend time with his sister, so Wilker and the rest of the SSS officers head out to a bar that night. Wilker eventually leaves to go home, after which the Lieutenant invites Yuri to drink with him and their fellow officers.[8]

Shopkeeper becomes interested in Wilker's third file
The Shopkeeper becomes interested in Wilker's third file
Wilker, accompanied by other officers, drives out to a mansion in the forest to meet with the Shopkeeper, the leader of Garden. When two officers protest after they are kept from accompanying Wilker to his meeting, he orders them to stand down as the members of Garden could kill them. After attempting to chat with the Shopkeeper, Wilker presents him with a briefcase filled with files for job requests, mostly from Ostania's prime minister. The first is about the left-right power struggle the prime minister is facing while the second is to have Garden's members represent Ostania in their soccer team for the upcoming East-West games. The Shopkeeper turns them both down until he reads the third file, a poaching case on Miteran elk in southwest Ostania. He accepts the job, explaining to Wilker the historical significance of those lands and how it is a demilitarized zone that could cause friction between East and West. Wilker asks him to consider the other files, but the Shopkeeper rejects him, reminding him that Garden acts in service to the nation, not to a politician. While leaving the mansion with his men, Wilker scoffs at the Shopkeeper, saying that his loyalty is to a dead empire.[9]

ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Skills

Tactician: Wilker appears to be a well-versed tactician, leading his agents with careful plans and directions. His notable plan was devising a strategy to weed out moles in their ranks by deploying a canary trap. During the mission to secure Winston Wheeler, Wilker had his men inform certain branches of their communications division that the signal to identify Winston Wheeler would be a green tie with a gemstone pin, then told each agent a different color. This way, whoever attempted to impersonate Wheeler with the gemstone color would reveal who the mole leaking their information was.
Relationships

Yuri Briar

Yuri and Wilker
Yuri declares to Wilker that he will capture Twilight.
Wilker is the man who scouted and recruited Yuri to the SSS. While the exact reasons are unknown, Wilker says that he did it because he found Yuri "adorable, like a cute little puppy." Yuri appears to be close with Wilker, who has even invited him out for a steak dinner. This has earned Yuri the reputation of being Wilker's "pet" among his peers.

After hearing about Yuri's long work hours, Wilker asks the young man if he is doing alright with his new job. Yuri exclaims that it is the job for him and that he will one day capture Twilight, which Wilker seems to appreciate.[2] After Yuri's fight with Twilight, Wilker praises him, claiming him to being the first person to land a blow on the spy.[7]

entries.name: SSS Superior
entries.content:
A higher-up in the SSS and Yuri Briar's superior. He is responsible for assigning Yuri to investigate and arrest Franklin Perkin, despite the First Lieutenant's worries that he is overworking Yuri. During the hijacking crisis with the Red Circus, he is remarkably callous, ordering his men to prioritize eliminating the resistance group over the safety of the hostages.

The SSS Superior shares his Japanese voice actor with Thomas Austin, the cow leader, the Denis Glooman, the orphanage owner, the unnamed WISE agent, and Vice Minister Brennan.

entries.name: SSS Captain
entries.content: A captain of SSS, he is in charge of the SSS forces during the bus hijacking crisis with the Red Circus. Like the superior, he has little patience for resistance groups and is unwilling to risk the country for the sake of some children, despite the high status of their parents. He expresses disdain at Division 1 for arguing against taking drastic measures, calling them "lapdogs of the political elite."

entries.name: Gascoigne
entries.content: Gascoigne is a State Security Service captain. He and other agents were tasked with securing Winston Wheeler and the files he stole from WISE upon reaching Ostania.

It's way past time you got over your sister thing. I need your head on the job. Our mission is to catch Western spies, and this "Twilight" character most of all. If you want to protect your sister, that's the way to do it.
THE LIEUTENANT TO YURI BRIAR[1]

The unnamed SSS Lieutenant is one of the supporting characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. He is a scarred man who is a lieutenant working with the State Security Service and Yuri Briar's senior officer.



ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

The Lieutenant is a tall man of intimidating stature. He has short blond hair in an undercut and rectangular-shaped blue eyes with a dark outline. He also has a slim face with defined cheekbones. His distinguishing feature is two stitched scars on the left side of his face, which go down from his forehead to under his eye.

He mainly appears wearing his standard SSS uniform. When going outside, he wears a dark jacket with a black turtleneck underneath, a flat cap, black gloves, and glasses.
Personality

The Lieutenant is stern and dedicated to the purpose of his job in the SSS: keeping the "peace" by catching traitors and spies from the West, most notoriously Twilight. While this may be the case, he also cares about his fellow officers, such as his junior, Yuri, whom he tends to get concerned about. When the superior orders him to cover up all information about the developing bus hijacking crisis, the Lieutenant remains silent and stone-faced while his subordinates look nervously.[2]
Abilities and Skills

Interrogation: As a counterintelligence agent, the Lieutenant works in interrogating those who are suspected of espionage. He shows no remorse in his methods and will beat and torture them in order to obtain the information he is seeking.
ADVERTISEMENT

Relationships

State Security Service

Yuri Briar

SSS Lieutenant brought tea for Yuri Anime
The Lieutenant brings tea to Yuri during his cold
Yuri is the Lieutenant's junior in the SSS. Working closely with the young man, the Lieutenant often finds himself looking after him as a mentor and making sure to keep him in check. The Lieutenant is aware of Yuri's bad habits and urges him to grow out of them: from his drinking, overworking, and sister complex. Despite these quirks, the Lieutenant acknowledges Yuri's efficiency as an intelligence agent and has been looking out for him. The Lieutenant often insists to Yuri that he should rest whenever he overworks himself, advising him to be careful after hearing about him getting injured, and even tended to Yuri's care after he caught a cold while pursuing a criminal.

WISE

Twilight

One of the Lieutenant's goals is to capture Twilight, the "great threat to the East." Unbeknownst to him, the master spy had once impersonated him to interrogate Yor.[1] During the mission to secure Winston Wheeler, the Lieutenant and Yuri follow Twilight's path down the sewers, with Yuri going ahead by himself while the Lieutenant calls for backup. The Lieutenant and Chloe later find Yuri beaten by Twilight, and he attempts to chase after him alone but fails.

CHLOE TO YURI BRIAR[1]

Chloe (クロエ, Kuroe?) is a State Security Service officer and Yuri Briar's junior officer.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Chloe is a young woman with medium-length dark magenta hair in a bob with bangs. Underneath her hair, she wears drop earrings that are in the shape of handcuffs. She has dark pink eyes which are slanted and narrow.

Chloe mainly wears the SSS standard uniform. When undercover in Shellbury, she wore a black cap with an eye at the brim, along with a black jacket and an orange scarf, a white undershirt, gray pants with a checkered pattern, and orange sneakers. In Berlint, while still having the same black cap and white undershirt, Chloe also wears a coat with fur on the collar, dark shorts, and dark boots.

When she was in college, Chloe appeared to have longer hair which she tied in a ponytail.
Personality

Chloe appears to be a relaxed and easy-going person, as shown when surrounded by her co-workers. Chloe also shows care for the people she respects and will try to reach out and help them if she sees them in a bad spot. As a Secret Police officer, Chloe takes her work seriously and with pride. During the mission to secure Winston Wheeler at Shellbury, she questioned why they had to be undercover, appearing to be uncomfortable with having to disguise herself in her own country.
ADVERTISEMENT

History

Six years before the start of Operation Strix, Chloe attended a college in Ostania. While she was there, she met the 14-year-old Yuri Briar, who suddenly appeared without even completing high school. Chloe would witness Yuri's eccentric personality, from his rudeness towards their classmates, his self-destructive work ethic, and his obsession with his older sister Yor. After college, Chloe heard that Yuri got into government work, and when she joined the SSS, she was surprised to learn that he had done the same and was now her superior officer.
Synopsis

Mole Hunt Arc

Yuri and the SSS
Chloe and other SSS officers receive a new mission from Wilker
Director Wilker orders an emergency summons to inform his officers of their mission to secure agent Winston Wheeler as he crosses the border to Ostania with valuable intel stolen from Westalian Intelligence. Chloe is present during this meeting, standing behind Yuri.[3]

Chloe, alongside Yuri, the Lieutenant, and another officer, arrive at Shellbury, where the rendezvous with Wheeler will take place. As the officers are dressed incognito, Chloe asks why they are disguising themselves in their own country, saying it is making her jittery. The other officer explains that this is an unofficial operation due to the current government not wanting to disturb their relationship with Westalis, among other concerns.[4]

Yuri mistakes Chloe for Yor
A delirious Yuri mistakes Chloe for Yor
After the meeting with "Wheeler" reveals that he is actually Twilight in disguise, all of the SSS officers immediately pursue the spy. Yuri goes down the sewers after getting a lead on Twilight but does not send out any signals, prompting the Lieutenant to search for him with Chloe. They find Yuri beaten and unconscious, and Chloe tries to wake him up. Upon awakening, a delirious Yuri mistakes Chloe for Yor and goes in for a hug. Surprised and flustered, Chloe chops at Yuri's head while yelling that she is not his sister, and the Lieutenant tells her not to injure him any further. As Yuri and the Lieutenant catch up on their current situation, Chloe wraps her arms around herself while huffing to herself. The Lieutenant decides to go after Twilight on his own and orders Chloe to bring Yuri back to the surface for medical treatment. As Chloe helps Yuri walk, she tells him that, for a moment, she thought he was really dead. Yuri curses Twilight and swears to continue chasing after him once he is out of the sewers, but Chloe refuses, saying he would only get in the way with his injuries.[5]

The SSS and Bobby
Chloe shows Yuri and the Lieutenant her potential Twilight suspect
The mission to secure Wheeler ultimately ends in a draw after he is captured by WISE while the SSS unveils WISE's mole in their ranks. However, thanks to Yuri's fight with Twilight, all of the SSS are actively searching for suspicious individuals in Ostania with the same arm wound as the spy. Chloe arrests Bobby Bockle of the Chicken Circle and takes him to headquarters for interrogation after believing he matches Twilight's arm injury. However, she is surprised when Yuri and the Lieutenant dismiss her suspect after she shows him to them. Before leaving, the Lieutenant orders Yuri to help Chloe with the interrogation.

While interrogating Bobby, Chloe notices Yuri taking out his frustrations on the suspect. After Bobby reveals the location of the Chicken Circle, Yuri and Chloe head out to investigate the base together, with the latter driving them there. During the drive, Chloe inquires Yuri about his recent mood. While they talk about Yuri's ongoing behavior since their college days, he suddenly hides himself in the car, having smelled Yor and heard her footsteps nearby. As they drive past a crosswalk, Chloe sees Yor and is creeped out by Yuri's ability to sense her. The two begin to argue about making up an excuse if Yor saw them, with Chloe suggesting that Yuri could have said that they were lovers. Yuri refuses the idea, saying that he could never do that to the woman who set aside her own happiness for him. Not having little brothers of her own, Chloe is confused and says that she would want Yuri to find happiness if she were Yor.

Chloe slaps Yuri
Chloe slaps Yuri
The pair arrive at the Chicken Circle's base. Before Chloe can attempt a reconnaissance trip, Yuri charges in alone, despite her protests. After listening to Yuri's fight with the men inside, Chloe enters the building just in time to save Yuri from being stabbed by disarming and defeating the attacker. Chloe slaps some sense into Yuri and admonishes him for his recklessness, reminding him that people like him can die. She asks Yuri how Yor would feel if he died and points out how everything he says he does is all for her, calling him a self-serving hypocrite. Chloe then expresses her admiration for Yuri's fortitude but says that it leaves him blind to too many things.

Yuri apologizes, and Chloe does the same, realizing she went a little overboard in getting her point across to him. Chloe tells Yuri that the way Yor supported him might seem normal due to their time together but says there are other ways people can support each other. She instructs him to take better care of himself and be able to prove it to Yor. To her astonishment, Yuri concludes that he must improve his defensive skills in evading and blocking.[1]

Current Arc

The Lieutenant, Chloe, and SSS officers at a bar
Chloe denies missing Yuri
As springtime approaches, Chloe, Yuri, and the Lieutenant are busy with interrogating a recent wave of extremist prisoners. After interrogations, Wilker invites the trio out to have steak together at night to celebrate Yuri's fight with Twilight. Much to Chloe's shock, Yuri declines the steak invitation as he has a date in the evening, though the Lieutenant correctly guesses that it will be with Yor. Later that night, the SSS officers go to a bar to go drinking. After Wilker leaves, the Lieutenant calls Yuri at his apartment to invite him out for bar hopping with their fellow officers. He also jokes that Chloe misses him, which she denies in embarrassment.[6]

ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Skills

Chloe saves Yuri
Chloe stops an ambush
Trained Hand-to-Hand Combatant: Chloe is well-trained in hand-to-hand combat. She was able to prevent Yuri from a surprise attack by quickly disarming and taking down the would-be attacker.
Weaknesses

Surveillance: Despite her occupation, Chloe seems to have rather poor surveillance skills, as she brought in Bobby Bockle, a short and plump man, as a possible Twilight suspect, based solely on the information that he had a gunshot wound on his arm.
Relationships

Yuri Briar

Chloe and Yuri in college
Chloe's memories of Yuri in college
Yuri is Chloe's superior officer in the SSS, and she refers to him as "Lieutenant" while they work together. She first met Yuri when he was 14 and attending the same college as her. As his college senior, Chloe is aware of Yuri's history of being despised by most people because of his impertinence, which she jokes about to him later on. She also admires his fortitude and toughness in both his heart and body, though she points out that it leaves him blind to too many things, including his own safety. Despite their difference in ranks, Chloe can be very casual with Yuri, as she is not afraid to speak her mind around him, nor is she against hitting him when he goes out of line.

With proper watering and pruning… and careful maintenance… the world can remain a beautiful place.
THE SHOPKEEPER TO YOR FORGER[1]

The Shopkeeper (店てん長ちょう, Tenchō?) is the leader of Garden, the assassin organization in Ostania which Yor Forger is a part of. While he seeks to "keep this world a beautiful place," his motives are largely unknown.

Appearance

The Shopkeeper appears to be a middle-aged man with dark skin, long white hair that reaches down to the waist, and sunken almond-shaped black eyes. Working in the garden, he is shown wearing a brown hat with a red string that has two golden figurines in the shape of small spikes attached at the ends, which are similar to Yor's own earrings and weapons. He also wears a beige long-sleeve shirt with rolled sleeves alongside a black apron, gloves, and boots.
Personality

The Shopkeeper is always seen maintaining his beautiful garden, tending to its plants and trees.[2] He seems to be a calm and patient person, often seen smiling calmly, and normally accepts any petition or favor Yor asks him.

He also shows a somewhat mischievous side, swiping at Yor with his shears, seemingly out of a mixture of amusement and testing her awareness. The Shopkeeper has also shown mysterious moments, such as when he remained silent when witnessing Yor worrying about her family and being intrigued when she later tells him about Loid's interest in Donovan Desmond.

While he is largely a mysterious man, his greatest ambition is to make sure the world remains a beautiful place, and he passes his ideal to his employees, particularly to Yor, whom he seems to trust deeply because he personally trained her. According to Yor, the Shopkeeper says that being an assassin is "a noble calling" and that his employees "should be proud as any soldier who has devoted their life to their homeland."

However he has little interest getting involved political affairs such as refusing jobs that appear politically motivated and declared they only serve the nation not a politician.
History

The Shopkeeper has known Yor since her youth, having taught her survival skills and trained her to be an assassin.[3] When assigning Yor with assassin contracts, Shopkeeper provides her with photos of her target, as well as information about their capabilities and defenses. The targets are given to the "Thorn Princess" because they are traitors to the nation of Ostania who he believes must be eliminated.

Not much is known about the Shopkeeper himself, but he has connections to the Ostanian underworld, as he states that he owed a personal debt to the former head of the Gretcher family.
Synopsis

Introduction Arc

Yor receives a mission
The Shopkeeper assigns Yor a new "client" over the phone
The Shopkeeper calls Yor to assign her a new job, but she mistakes him for her brother, Yuri; her tone makes him wonder if the siblings are having a fight, and he finds it unusual. After Yor apologizes for the confusion, the Shopkeeper moves on to inform "Thorn Princess" about a client at the Royal Hotel, Room Number 1307.[4]

Later, after Yor gets married to Loid Forger and moves to the Forger residence to help with her cover identity, she recalls to herself that she was able to get the Shopkeeper's permission for this decision.[5]

Campbelldon Tennis Arc

When Yor's daughter, Anya, picks her for a job investigation as part of her school project, Yor begins to imagine a scenario in which she explains her assassin job to Anya. She mentions the Shopkeeper, sharing his beliefs about being an assassin, and receives a call from him about a new client.[6]

Imperial Scholars Mixer Arc

Episode 26-2
The Shopkeeper talks with Yor on the phone
Yor is assigned to eliminate a faction of the Red Circus group in the northern district. After completing her task, she calls the Shopkeeper to inform him that the "customers have been served." During the call, Yor tells him she will be going straight home but remembers that she promised Loid that she would pick up eggs and milk on the way. As she finishes their call, Yor fails to notice a surviving member aiming his gun at her and shooting her butt, which causes her great pain for several days.[7]

Cruise Adventure Arc

The Shopkeeper informs Yor's manager, Matthew McMahon, to tell her that she has a phone call while they are working at Berlint City Hall. Yor goes to a private room in the building where she answers the phone, and the Shopkeeper greets the Thorn Princess and says she has a new "client."[8]

Shopkeeper tests Yor's instincts
The Shopkeeper tests Yor's instincts
The Thorn Princess and Matthew arrive at a garden maintained by the Shopkeeper. Yor compliments the garden, and he replies that with proper watering and careful maintenance, the world can remain a beautiful place. While Yor takes a moment to smell the flowers, the Shopkeeper decides to test her instincts with a surprise attack. After Yor successfully dodges it, the Shopkeeper apologizes for his sudden actions, saying it was to test her. Satisfied that Yor's skills have not dulled, he proceeds to brief her on her latest assignment, the protection of Olka Gretcher and her child aboard the cruise ship Princess Lorelei.

The Shopkeeper briefs Yor on what the assignment entails, including its background and his personal connection to it. He watches Yor hesitating to take on the job because of her worries about making an excuse for her cover job and family. He informs her that Matthew has already prepared a cover story of her being there as part of her work, which puts her mind at rest. The Shopkeeper then entrusts the assignment to the Thorn Princess, who gladly accepts.[9]

Friendship Schemes Arc

Shopkeeper learns about Loid's political interests
The Shopkeeper learns about Loid's political interests
Yor visits the Shopkeeper to inform him of her meeting with Melinda Desmond, who wishes to be friends with her. Because Melinda is an important person in the country, she asks for his permission. The Shopkeeper says he has no problem with it but tells Yor that because Melinda is a conservative, he would not recommend it if "anything" were to happen. He then instructs Yor to at least watch herself to prevent Loid from thinking she has one-sided political beliefs. Yor says it should not be a problem, bringing up how Loid met Donovan Desmond and his interest in the National Unity Party, which piques the Shopkeeper's attention.[10]

Mole Hunt Arc

Yor approaches the Shopkeeper to request permission to kill Loid in order to maintain her cover. The Shopkeeper approves, and Yor soon finds herself facing off against Loid and getting into a bloody fight with him, but it is revealed that it was all a fantasy by a drunken Yor.[11]

Current Arc

TBA[12]

Abilities and Skills

Master Combatant: Although not much has been showcased by him, the Shopkeeper appears to be a combat expert. He uses a giant pair of garden shears as a weapon and has good control over them, as he tries to attack Yor with them with a quick and skillful thrust. He is also the one responsible for training Yor all she knows about being an assassin, indicating he is of comparable if not a higher level of skill in the art.

Teaching: The Shopkeeper has personally taught and trained Yor to become a full-fledged assassin. Upon meeting her again in person after she joined the Forger family, he tried to attack her while she was distracted to test her reflexes.

Gardening: The Shopkeeper owns a large garden where he carefully grows, cultivates, and maintains a wide variety of flowers and plants.
Relationships

Yor Forger

The Shopkeeper is Yor's handler within Garden, similar to Loid and Sylvia in WISE, calling her when a "client" is available and dispatching her to complete assassination contracts. He is considered her mentor as he taught her survival skills in her youth and trained her to be the Thorn Princess.[3] Despite allowing her to enter the Forger family as part of her cover, the Shopkeeper appears to have concerns about them negatively impacting her abilities as an assassin, such as when he tested her skills to see if it had been dulled by her family life and quietly watched her worry about her family after assigning her with an important mission.

In a rare instance, he assigned her a mission whereby she would protect someone, that being Olka Gretcher and her son. He also allowed Yor to become friends with Melinda Desmond, but gave her a warning due to Melinda's political sidings and that something could happen.[10]

So long as people are the way they are, the fighting won't ever stop. We're soldiers. Whether people call it wartime or peacetime, we keep fighting for our country.
MATTHEW TO ZEB[1]

Matthew McMahon (マシュー・マクマホン, Mashū Makumahon?) is a member of Garden and is also the Director of Policy at Berlint City Hall. He assists Yor Forger during her mission aboard the Princess Lorelei.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Matthew is an elderly man of average build and height. He has narrow black eyes hidden under reflective glasses and gray hair parted down the middle. His outfit consists of a white shirt under a dark gray business suit and a dark teal tie. Matthew also has a ring on his left ring finger.
Personality

Matthew is a blunt and straightforward individual. He maintains an air of professionalism, even when presented with the risk of death. Similar to Yor, he remains relatively unfazed when fighting enemies. He has demonstrated mild exasperation with the latter for killing so messily, commenting on the effort it would take to clean up the scene. Matthew is dedicated to his job as an assassin, believing that they are soldiers and nothing more, even reminding Yor when he notices her emotions affecting her focus. Despite that, Matthew is more empathetic than he appears to be as he allows Yor to be family after noticing these emotions. Matthew also has a dislike for war and those who start it for financial gain, believing that Ostania would be better off without them.
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Skills

Despite his appearance as a frail old man, Matthew is still an active member of Garden, acting as a competent killer despite his advanced age.

Matthew displays his strength
Matthew displays his strength
Enhanced Strength: Matthew demonstrated his strength by effortlessly picking up and throwing the corpses of fully grown adults off the cruise ship using just one hand. He can also break an assassin's arms and legs with ease and was able to pierce Knockman's hands with throwing darts.

Enhanced Durability and Endurance: Despite his seemingly frail structure, Matthew has showcased great durability and endurance. He survived an intense blow from the Swordsman's hilt that sent him crashing into a wall. Though it left him temporarily unconscious and mildly wounded, he was able to recover and quickly land a shot on the Assassin Leader before he could shoot Yor.

Matthew dodges the assassin's attack
Matthew dodges an assassin's attack, leaving an afterimage of smoke where he stood
Enhanced Speed and Reflexes: Matthew displays great speed and reflexes. He was able to swiftly dodge a knife swung by an assassin and disabled him just as quickly, leaving a wind trail behind him as he did so. In addition to blocking an attack using a broom, he was able to dodge a close-up sword strike just as fast as Yor. Additionally, he was able to dodge a stab from behind while cleaning up blood.

He was fast enough to be able to disappear from his vantage point and reappear behind Yor, with the latter noticing only after he spoke, though this may have been for comedic effect and not a true reflection of his speed.

Matthew's Assassin Tools Anime
Matthew's arsenal
Weapons: It seems that Matthew prefers to use mostly firearms, including a sniper rifle which he wields with great proficiency. He was able to kill three opponents in quick succession without a reaction from any of them. In close-quarters combat, he relies on a silenced gun. However, it is assumed that he periodically uses cold weapons, such as throwing darts, as well as knives, which were seen in his briefcase. On one occasion, he also has used a broom to defend himself.

Cleaning: Like Yor, Matthew has expert cleaning skills. During their battle with the assassins, Matthew brought along a broom and bucket to clean up blood from Yor's fight and quickly managed to keep the deck of the ship clean after their kills. By the end of their fight with the assassins, Matthew was able to keep the deck spotless.
ADVERTISEMENT

Relationships

Yor Forger

Matthew lets Yor be with her family Anime
Matthew lets Yor be with her family
Matthew is Yor's supervisor in both Garden and at city hall. He and Yor have a professional relationship since they both work under the Shopkeeper and appear to regularly meet with him together. Despite that, they both care about each other in times of danger, as on several occasions, they looked out for each other while fighting the assassins on Princess Lorelei.

Throughout their mission to protect Olka Gretcher on the ship, Matthew acts as Yor's senior, giving her instructions and keeping her in check. He notices Yor losing focus on the job and emphasizes several times to her that they are nothing more than foot soldiers. However, at the end of their mission, as Matthew says they must remain vigilant, he sees Yor's sentimental expression and relays to her that her family requested to meet with her. Saying that he will stay on the lookout for more assassins, Matthew allows Yor to be with her family, telling her to think of it as a reward for completing her job.

HEMLOCK TO YOR FORGER[1]

Hemlock (弟切, Otogiri?) is a member of Garden from Ostania. He is introduced during the events of the Current Arc.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:02

41:20

Hemlock is a tall, imposing figure with long light hair and a distinctive appearance. He wears a black, large coat that contributes to his cold and aloof vibe. His face is marked by two distinct points under each of his eyes and two under his lips, with a black tie and long-sleeved shirt with a grid pattern. Hemlock also walks around with a cane with a curved handle.
Personality

Hemlock has a cold and detached personality. He is serious and unwavering, showing no hesitation when he almost killed a ladybug with a knife, even when it involves harm. His attitude towards Yor is particularly hostile, as he has no qualms about belittling her and pointing out when he thinks she has not been doing her job. Despite this, he remains focused on his role as a Garden operative, acting with calculated professionalism.
Synopsis

Current Arc

Shopkeeper interrupts the tension between Yor and Hemlock
Shopkeeper interrupts the tension between Hemlock and Yor
As he was entering the Garden, Hemlock throws a knife to a ladybug resting in Yor Forger's hand, referring to it as a "noxious pest." Matthew McMahon intervenes, stating that it is harmless. When Matthew questions Hemlock's presence at Garden, Hemlock replies that he is there to report his completed pruning task. Shortly after, Gympie arrives, and Hemlock coldly accuses Yor of slacking off, though Matthew defends her, explaining that their workload has decreased under the Shopkeeper's orders. Hemlock makes a suspicious movement toward Yor, as if ready to attack, but is interrupted by the Shopkeeper's arrival. During their meeting, the Shopkeeper assigns a mission to eliminate illegal elk hunters, instructing Yor and Matthew to choose either Hemlock or Gympie as a partner. Hemlock volunteers, promising not to harm any elk. When Yor nervously mentions her fear of bugs, Hemlock threatens her, warning that if she continues speaking like that around him, he will kill her.

ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Skills

Yor catches Hemlock's knife
Yor catches Hemlock's knife
Weapon proficiency: Hemlock is seen to master bladed weapons, notably his proficiency in throwing sharp objects at high speeds. While his full arsenal is not revealed yet, it is clear that he is adept in combat, and his demeanor suggests a lethal and efficient style of fighting.
Relationships

Shopkeeper

Hemlock's relationship with the Shopkeeper seems to be one of professional duty. He follows orders without question but is also highly critical of others in his group. His interactions with the Shopkeeper are formal, as he respects the Shopkeeper's authority.

Matthew McMahon

Matthew and Hemlock's relationship is tense. Matthew is more laid-back, while Hemlock has a more serious and confrontational attitude. Hemlock does not seem to be fond of Matthew's more relaxed approach to their work, often challenging his methods, seemingly disliking his way of defending Yor. However, the two share a professional connection, as both are operatives of the Garden, and their interactions are mostly centered around mission tasks and assignments.

Yor Forger

Hemlock threatens Yor
Hemlock threatens Yor
Hemlock and Yor share a hostile relationship. Hemlock openly criticizes Yor, even stating that she has not been working as hard lately. He is dismissive of her efforts and apparently seems to harbor a deep dislike for her. His interaction with Yor becomes even more tense when he threatens her life after she expresses concerns about encountering bugs during their mission. Despite his harsh demeanor, there is a clear professional dynamic, and they both follow orders from their superior.

His outfit consists of a large, loose-fitting long vest paired with raincoat-like trousers and black boots, giving him a slightly rugged and practical look.

Gympie seems to have a calm and gentle demeanor. He gives the impression of someone who prefers to avoid conflict, acting respectfully toward his comrades. Gympie appears thoughtful and considerate, intervening peacefully when tensions rise between Hemlock and Yor.

Current Arc

Yor greets Gympie

Gympie first appears when Matthew McMahon questions Hemlock about reporting in for his pruning task. Gympie suggests another Garden member for support, but Hemlock quickly offers himself to go with them. When Yor simply mentions that she wishes not to encounter any bugs, Hemlock threatens her, making Gympie intervene to de-escalate the situation.[1]

ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Skills

While Gympie's combat skills have not been shown yet, his membership in Garden suggests he is a highly capable operative. Like other members, he is likely skilled in assassination techniques, stealth, and combat, having earned his place in Garden.
Relationships

Yor Forger

Gympie seems to have a good relationship with Yor. He shows respect towards her, greeting her warmly upon arrival. Yor, in turn, reacts with a bit of excitement when seeing him, implying they share a friendly camaraderie. When Hemlock threatens Yor, Gympie immediately steps in saying they should not fight.
