HENRY TO THE EDEN TEACHERS[1]

Henry Henderson (ヘンリー・ヘンダーソン, Henrī Hendāson?) is one of the recurring characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. He is a History teacher and the housemaster of Dormitory 3, Cecile Hall at Eden Academy.

 
ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:01

41:20

Henry has long, straight, white hair pulled into a tight ponytail ending just below his shoulders. His hairline is beginning to recede. He has a lengthy, straight, white beard cut in the Imperial style, with no hair on the chin but along the mustache and beard area without connecting to the head hair[7] styled into two long points reaching his collarbone.

Taking into consideration his age, he has noticeable creases and wrinkles on his face, accompanied by small, thin eyes with thin eyebrows right above them. He is seen wearing a monocle on his left eye and usually has a stern expression, although significantly elegant things make him lose composure.[8]

He is normally seen wearing a three-piece suit consisting of a dark jacket with long coattails and striped pants. He accessorizes with a pocket square, a tricolor striped tie, and a cane.

When Henry was younger, he had short hair, which he ended up growing to shoulder-length over the years. After his arrest, Henry cut his hair back short and began wearing his monocle after it was injured during his arrest.
ADVERTISEMENT

Personality

Henry Elegant
Henry's overexcitation from an excess of elegance
Henry is a mature and noble person who places high importance on "elegance." To him, elegance seems to be the way a person conducts themselves and is not afraid to correct inelegant behavior in others.[9] This can be seen in his interview with the Forger family, as he remained calm and composed even after Loid smashed the table between them after Murdoch Swan goaded the family, after which Henry himself punched the man after he threatened to silence Henry with his influence.[10] In some cases, Henry will lose composure, usually when shocked or excited, like when he silently cursed to himself when Anya utterly failed to understand his words, or when he became elated by the Forgers' elegance and later frightened by how prepared they were during the first phase of the admissions.

Henry has an immense level of discipline, being able to exercise daily in the early morning and supervises the school's organization. When teaching and disciplining his students, Henry utilizes strict but sincere approach. He observes and assesses the "elegance" of the students, although he understands that the children occasionally need to frolic.[11]

Henry punches Murdoch Swan
Henry punches Murdoch, defending the Forgers and his own pride
In his youth, Henry was an introverted boy, but as noble and disciplined as he currently is. His father once told him to "Be ever a gentleman," words that Henry would follow to a fault. While acting gentlemanly, Henry was a strict follower of the school rules and was always formal with fellow students and teachers, which would earn the ire of some of his peers, who believed he had a stuck-up attitude. When it came to getting into conflicts, Henry was firm on having civil conversations and refused to fight back to not stoop to the levels of animalistic behavior. However, he was willing to resort to violence to protect those he cared about or to defend his beliefs. Later, Henry transferred this quality to his old age, when he could not restrain himself and punched Murdoch Swan for his rude and inappropriate behavior towards the Forgers.

Henry grew up during the tense time between Ostania and Westalis, with the former preparing for war. In his final year at Eden, Henry was attacked by some students who held a grudge against him for his attitude and was saved by his junior Martha Marriott, which caused a skirmish. While protecting Martha, Henry punched one of his attackers and was ashamed that he resorted to such means. As such, he attempted to convince his teacher to punish him and his attackers for their violence. His teacher brushed the incident aside to avoid causing trouble with one of the boy's family members, who held great importance, which made Henry come to the belief that the Eden teachers have been corrupted.

Eden Academy Henry Henderson's Graduation
A young Henry pulls away from everyone
After some thought, Henry concluded that by properly educating the youth into becoming proper characters, he could help end conflicts, whether it be petty fights or even global war, and decided that he would become a teacher. Henry became so obsessed with this ambition to radically change the world that he inadvertently pushed away not only his peers but also those close to him, particularly Martha. Two and a half years after his graduation from Eden, Henry returned to the school as a History teacher. During his first year as a teacher, Henry stubbornly believed that he could change the world if he stuck to his principles and chose to stay out of the ongoing war, which eventually drove a wedge between him and Martha, who left to join the war effort after graduating.

Henry denouncing the war
"You sacrificed their lives for this ridiculous war!"
As the first war continued, Henry began realizing how much he cared for Martha as they kept in touch through letters. After believing that Martha had died on the frontlines, Henry grew embittered toward Ostania, especially the military, for her "death." An outburst denouncing the war during a military speech caused him to get arrested, after which his father arrived and told him to pull himself together at the risk of his teaching career. Envisioning a peaceful future with the students that Martha once told him about in her letters, Henry decided to work toward making such a future happen, realizing it mattered more than his pride.
ADVERTISEMENT

Skills

Housemaster

Henry punishes Ewen and Emile
Henry punishes Ewen and Emile for their unkempt manners
Organization: As Cecile Hall's housemaster, Henry supervises both the students and the caretakers of the house. He is in charge of ensuring the students are completing chores and going to classes, as well as directing the other staff, such as the gardeners and cleaners.

Discipline: One of Henry's tasks is to maintain authority over the students and may take disciplinary action in the case of misconduct.

Teaching: Henry is a highly-respected educator, primarily teaching History. He does not compromise his standards when it comes to teaching, speaking with students, or grading them. Henry also gives supplementary lessons for students who are struggling in class. On some occasions, he even fills in for absent teachers, such as the gym teacher[12] and art teacher.[13]

Miscellaneous

Athleticism: Henry is remarkably fit for his age, as evidenced by his daily regimen of taking a jog early in the morning and the impact force he generated when he punched Murdoch Swan following the Forgers' interview at Eden.[14] It is also noted that he is good at horse riding.[4]

Emile Elman (エミール・エルマン, Emīru Eruman?) is one of the supporting characters of the SPY X FAMILY series. He is the heir of the Elman family who attends Eden Academy as a first-year student in Cecile Hall, Class 3, and is one of Damian Desmond's followers and friends.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Emile is a young boy with a square face and slanted eyes with small black irises (sometimes green in the anime). He has a round physique, an upturned nose, buckteeth, and blond hair that is styled into a bowl cut.

Like all other male students, Emile wears Eden Academy's uniform—a black button-up shirt with black shorts. He also wears white crew socks with black shoes.
Personality

As one of Damian's followers alongside Ewen, Emile frequently praises Damian's abilities and makes fun of Anya and Becky, but he is good at doing the right thing to save Damian. Emile is willing to sacrifice himself for Damian during the dodgeball tournament, throwing himself in the path of Bill Watkins's ball.[2] He also jumps into the river without hesitance when he assumes Damian is drowning.

Emile does not have any future aspirations when he grows up but has stated that it is his dream to eat a lot of candy[1], and he has also shown to be interested in getting Stella Stars and becoming Imperial Scholars with Damian and Ewen.
ADVERTISEMENT

Relationships

Damian Desmond

Damian impresses his friends
Damian impresses Emile and Ewen
Damian is Emile's friend and classmate in Cecile Hall. He has known him and Ewen since nursery school.[3] Emile displays great loyalty to Damian, even deciding not to join the other boys to watch a movie and have roast beef during the holiday to instead help Damian do chores around the dorm, willingly getting himself punished by Henry Henderson in order to do so. He also displays great admiration for Damian, always praising his abilities. This faith in Damian is so great that Emile has declared that if Damian ever gets a Tonitrus Bolt, the trio will go through Eden Academy in their underpants, much to Damian's reluctance to uphold that.[4]

Emile is a selfless boy and is even willing to sacrifice himself for Damian's sake, as shown when he jumps in the way of a dodgeball thrown by Bill to protect Damian from getting hit and allow him the chance of being the MVP of their dodgeball match. Later, when the boys go on a field research trip with Mr. Green, Emile quickly jumps in after Damian when he sees him fall overboard from their canoe, and when the boys believe they are drowning, Emile prioritizes Damian's safety over his own. During the Red Circus bus hijacking, in which Damian had a bomb attached to him (which most were unaware that it was actually fake), Emile did not even consider running away to protect his friend's life.

Ewen and Emile chase Damian with worms
Ewen and Emile chase Damian around with worms
Despite his fervent loyalty to Damian, Emile also shows a mischievous streak toward him, as he and Ewen gleefully chase him around with earthworms upon learning of Damian's fear of them. Emile is also not afraid to be humorous around Damian, even if it is at Damian's expense, such as when he and Ewen tease him for looking like Anya's "twin" after she accidentally spills a yakisoba burger on his head.[5]

Ewen and Emile come to terms with Mr. Buzz
Emile embraces Mr. Buzz, a manifestation of his jealousy
At the start of their second school term, Emile and Ewen come to believe that Damian has another, more important friend. As such, Emile decides to work hard to prove to Damian that he and Ewen are friends he can rely on by helping solve his problem. After Mr. Green gives the boys advice on dealing with their jealousy at not being Damian's most important friends, they visualize their jealousy as a "Mr. Buzz" character, whom Emile embraces. After the misunderstanding is resolved by Damian, Emile and Ewen are relieved to be his true friends.[6]

Ewen Egeburg

Ewen is Emile's friend and classmate in Cecile Hall and has known him and Damian since nursery school. Both of them work with Damian to become Imperial Scholars together and are always ready to support him, with both agreeing that their "hearts beat as one" with Damian.

Anya Forger

Anya and Becky argue with Damian, Emile, and Ewen at the start of class
Ewen and his friends arguing with Anya and Becky
Anya is Emile's classmate in Cecile Hall but currently does not get along with her because of Damian. When they first meet at the school orientation, Emile pushes Anya away from Damian so he does not catch her "peasant germs." After Anya punches Damian, Emile becomes defensive of Damian and tries to keep her away from hurting him again. Whenever they interact, Emile makes fun of her and calls her names, usually mocking her appearance and commoner status. However, in some instances when Anya would cry[7] or smile[8], Emile would react with a blush alongside Damian.

Becky Blackbell

Becky is also Emile's classmate in Cecile Hall and is currently on bad terms with her for being Anya's best friend and her snarky attitude toward him and his friends. Whenever the two interact, they are usually seen arguing.

Ewen Egeburg (ユーイン・エッジバーグ, Yūin Ejjibāgu?) is one of the supporting characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. He is the heir of the Egeburg family who attends Eden Academy as a first-year student in Cecile Hall, Class 3, and is one of Damian Desmond's followers and friends.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


1/2


Ewen is a young boy with light skin and an elongated head. He has relatively tiny, square-shaped eyes with small black pupils (sometimes blue in the anime). Ewen's hair is his unique feature, larger than his own head and blond and combed back. When his hair is down, it reaches about chin-length.

Like all other male students, Ewen wears Eden Academy's uniform—a black button-up shirt with black shorts. He also wears long white crew socks with black shoes. During their mornings on their way to Eden Academy, Ewen typically holds another bag in his arms along with his own bag on his back, the former likely to be Damian's bag.
Personality

Ewen first appears to be another arrogant child at Eden Academy and Damian's lackey, but he has shown that he is a loyal friend who has Damian's best interests at heart. Alongside Emile, Ewen is devoted to Damian and always follows him wherever he goes, even carrying his bag on their way to class. Ewen genuinely cares for Damian as a friend, getting concerned for him when he is hurt or pushing himself too hard.

Ewen has an affinity for space exploration, so much to the point that it is his dream to become a cosmonaut in the future.[2] He claims to have an appreciation for the romance of space exploration and is genuinely upset that his friends do not share the same passion, thus finding joy upon finding others who also like space adventures, even someone like Anya.
ADVERTISEMENT

Relationships

Damian Desmond

Damian burst into laughter
Ewen with Damian and Emile
Ewen shows great respect for Damian, who is the leader of their clique. He looks up to Damian and places lots of faith in him, believing that Damian will make their country a better place when he becomes a politician. Regarding this, they are shown to be good friends and spend a lot of time together. Ewen calls him Lord Damian and usually does everything he asks for, even holding his backpack when walking to class. Despite this, he and Emile also show a mischievous streak toward Damian, chasing him around with an earthworm upon learning of Damian's fear, and they are not afraid to make jokes at his expense. Ewen is oblivious to Damian's crush on Anya and believes the two are enemies.

Ewen and Emile come to terms with Mr. Buzz
Ewen comes to term with his jealousy
At the start of their second school term, Ewen and Emile come to believe that Damian has another, more important friend. Ewen, who values his friendship with Damian, feels hurt about the revelation and begins wondering why he and Emile continue to support him. After Mr. Green gives the boys advice on dealing with their jealousy at not being Damian's most important friends, they visualize their jealousy as a "Mr. Buzz" character, whom Ewen quietly acknowledges. After the misunderstanding is resolved by Damian, Ewen and Emile are relieved to be his true friends.[3]

Emile Elman

Emile is Ewen's friend. Both of them work with Damian and are his closest confidants, even saying that their hearts beat as one with his.

Anya Forger

Anya and Ewen are talking about space
Ewen and Anya's common craving for space adventures
Since their orientation, Ewen has been on bad terms with Anya after she punched Damian, wanting to protect his friend from what he believes is a violent person. Ewen also looks down on Anya because of her lower class status, calling her a peasant and taking any opportunity he can get to belittle her. After their term finals, Ewen is upset that Anya got a Stella Star for academics before he did.[4]

The two briefly shared a bonding moment when Ewen discovered that Anya also enjoys space adventure, prompting him to tell her all he knows about it and pretending to be an astronaut crew together.[5]

Becky Blackbell

As Becky is Anya's best friend, Ewen is also on bad terms with her, getting into heated arguments when their respective groups have their usual squabbles.

Bill Watkins (ビル・ワトキンス, Biru Watokinsu?) is one of the supporting characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. He is the son of a major in Ostania's national army who attends Eden Academy as a first-year student in Wald Hall, Class 4.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:02

41:20

Due to being an early bloomer, Bill is a young boy who is considerably taller and incredibly muscular for his age when compared to his peers. He has short brown hair, thick eyebrows, and blue eyes, which are hidden by reflective glasses.

Like all other male students, Bill wears Eden Academy's uniform—a black button-up shirt with black shorts. He also wears white crew socks with black shoes.
Personality

Bill playing in the dodgeball game
Bill's confidence and determination during the game
Befitting his more mature appearance and family profession, Bill is an extremely disciplined boy who approaches virtually all matters with utmost seriousness. Above all, Bill's main drive is to make his father proud, as he has an immense amount of respect and love for him. To this end, Bill regularly trains his body and mind to maximize his potential, even if it is for something as simple as a game of dodgeball. This results in him having a great deal of confidence in his skills, which will immediately falter should his normally well-calculated plans fail.

Bill tears up after failing to eliminate Anya
Bill tears up after failing to eliminate Anya
While he often tries to act more mature, Bill sometimes lets his demeanor slip and acts more his age, like when he began to cry after failing to eliminate Anya with his dodgeball throws or when spending time with his father. Outside of dodgeball competitions, Bill also appears to be a relaxed and kind boy. He seems to be well-liked by his classmates in Wald Hall and is also welcome to the idea of befriending others outside of his circle, such as when he attempted to befriend Damian at the start of their field trip to the museum and when he agreed with Anya's sentiments to stick with their friend group longer during the city's Winter Festival.

Bill talks to the crowd
Bill bravely calms down his classmates amidst a crisis
Bill is shown to be somewhat chivalrous, using far less force when competing against girls to avoid injuring them, though in extreme situations he will forsake this mindset for absolute victory. When Donna Schlag returned to Eden Academy and struck Wald Hall with Tonitruses, Bill went out of his way to warn his schoolmates in Cecile Hall about Lady Tonitrus and urged them to flee. Bill also displays immense courage, as during the bus hijacking by the Red Circus, he bravely stood up to announce to his schoolmates that help would come. Despite quickly cowering after being threatened by the group's leader, Billy Squire, Bill's words manage to get through to his peers and temporarily calm them down.
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Skills

Bill's training for the dodgeball match
Bill uses his mind and strength in his training
Enhanced Strength: Despite only being a child, Bill is incredibly strong after enduring lots of training from his father. He is able to throw a ball with enough force to demolish standard military training targets and even bend a metal lamp post.

Analytical Mind: Bill can make very complicated calculations very quickly after lots of studying. He uses this to his advantage during the inter-class dodgeball match where he is able to eliminate several opponents with a single throw.
Special Moves

Special Move	Image	Description
Homing Slider Shot
(ホーミングスライダーショット,
Hōmingu Suraidā Shotto?)	
Bill's Homing Slider Shot
Bill's secret move during the interclass dodgeball game. It is a throw that changes course in midair, best suited for opponents who move around while dodging. Bill attempts to use this move on Anya, who hears him explaining the technique in his thoughts and dodges it by staying still.[1]
ADVERTISEMENT

Relationships

Family

Wesley Watkins

Bill follows Wesley's commands
Bill follows his father's commands
Wesley is Bill's father, whom he has an immense amount of respect and love for, and he tries to live up to his expectations as the future of Ostania's army. When they are together, Bill drops his more serious demeanor and affectionately refers to his father as "daddy." However, Wesley's orders appear to sometimes intimidate Bill, as when he decides to join the game of ring toss against the girls, Wesley commands that Bill be withdrawn from Eden if he fails to win the game, which Bill reluctantly agrees to.

Eden Academy

Damian Desmond

Bill and Damian's rivalry
Bill challenges Damian in the bus
Damian is one of Bill's rivals aiming to earn a Stella Star at the interclass dodgeball match. At the start of the game, they briefly banter after Damian tries to eliminate him. Later, they meet again when he tries to warn Anya and the rest of her classmates that Donna Schlag is giving Tonitrus Bolts to everyone. When Wald Hall and Cecile Hall share a bus during a trip to the museum, Bill finds himself seated behind Damian. Bill proposes becoming friends, but Damian states their classes are rivals. In response, Bill challenges him to see which class can name the most dinosaurs in the museum. After the bus gets hijacked by the Red Circus, Bill and Damian do selfless acts to calm their classmates, earning each other's respect.

Anya Forger

Star Catch Arrow Animated
Bill gets scared of Anya's "killer move," only to be taken aback after she fails
They met on the day of the interclass dodgeball match. After whittling down most of Cecile Hall's team, Bill tries to hit Anya many times, but fails at every single attempt, as she is able to read his mind to predict where he would throw the ball. Anya scares Bill when she attempts to throw the ball at him with all her strength, but to no avail, as she only lets the ball bounce right to Bill's feet, allowing him to grab it and throw it back to her with little effort. Later, they meet again when he tries to warn Anya and the rest of her classmates that Donna Schlag is giving Tonitrus Bolts to everyone. During the bus hijacking, Bill and the rest of his peers are unnerved by Anya's unusual calmness despite getting a bomb attached to her neck. By the end of the hijacking, he appears to respect her bravery in the face of danger.

Be careful not to lie too much. Or you'll end up becoming an outcast like me.
GEORGE TO ANYA FORGER[1]

George Glooman (ジョージ・グルーマン, Jōji Gurūman?) is one of the supporting characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. He attends Eden Academy as a first-year student in Cecile Hall, Class 3.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:02

41:20

George is a young boy with a triangle-shaped head, short black hair, and black eyes.

Like all other male students, he wears Eden Academy's uniform—a black button-up shirt with black shorts. George also wears long white crew socks with black shoes.
Personality

Anya learns about George's failed insidious plan
George's mean side and his thoughts about his failed insidious plan
George is described as always being gloomy, causing him to be an outcast in his class. He appears to be jealous of Damian and his family for their reputation and accomplishments and developed a hatred for them after initially believing his father's company, Glooman Pharmaceuticals, was driven out of the market because of the Desmonds, going as far as hiring a spy with the help of his old butler to rig Damian and his brother's midterm answers.

Despite his negative traits, George is an ordinary, vulnerable child who is easily offended and upset when he feels injustice toward himself. He also has a sensitive side, which manifested itself when he said goodbye to his classmates who decided to support him when leaving school.

Anya gets advice from George Glooman
George advises Anya not to lie too much
George often silently observes others and seems to have some insight, at least when he sees that someone is lying. Although Anya's lies about her cruise trip quickly became apparent, George was one of the first to realize that she was tricking to make an impression, but he did not interfere, watching the development of events from afar. Later, when Anya is ridiculed by her classmates and leaves school together with Becky, George shows an unexpected interest in her fate and gives the girl valuable advice based on his bitter experience. George told Anya that she shouldn't lie a lot if she didn't want to become an outcast like him, thus showing that he is uncomfortable with the situation in which he found himself because of his own lie.
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Skills

Damian lets George wear his Stella after he mopes
George temporarily gets Damian's Stella with the help of his sad story
Manipulator: George appears to be particularly good at making people believe him, as shown when he almost achieves his goal of getting Damian in trouble with the teacher had Anya not intervened. Later, he manages to gain the sympathy of his classmates by telling them his story, making them grant his final requests before his presumed departure from Eden Academy, and, by the end of the day, he goes home with keepsakes from each of his classmates and a bouquet. However, most likely he did it so well because he sincerely believed that he would have to leave school and be sold into slavery in Westalis, until his father informed him of the true state of their affairs.[2]

He tried this tactic again when Becky and Damian demanded for his set of Pierre Pommier Macarons by claiming he used the little money he had on them, but it failed due to the fact he still owes them for the stuff they had given him.[3]
ADVERTISEMENT

Relationships

Damian Desmond

At first, George hated Damian for always being the perfect boy with good grades, to the point of going to great lengths to try to make Damian get a Tonitrus, and even tried to have him expelled. After George explained his jealousy towards him and his family status and claimed he would be leaving Eden, Damian and other Cecile Hall students helped him fulfill his wishes, with Damian even lending George his Stella Star. Afterward, Damian and the other students gave George their belongings so he could remember them. The next day George returns to school, having to endure an embarrassing moment as Damian and the other kids ask him to return all the things they gave him.

Damian yells at George
Damian scares George with his anger
After a long time, George never returned Damian's things. Later, when they were on the bus, George tacitly decided to demand sweets from Damian, believing that Damian owed him for the macaron he had once taken. However, Damian viciously disagrees with this statement, loudly reminding George that he did not receive anything, and his anger brings George to frightened tears.[4]

CAMILLA TO YOR FORGER[1]

Camilla (カミラ, Kamira?) is one of the supporting characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. She is one of Yor Forger's three co-workers at Berlint City Hall.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


1/2
Skip Ad


Camilla is a young woman with blonde hair, yellow eyes, light skin, and short eyebrows. Her hair appears smooth and carefully curled at the ends, reaching her shoulders. Occasionally, Camilla ties her hair in a low ponytail. Her eye color varies from yellow to green in illustrations and official art from the manga and anime, appearing yellow in the anime and colored manga, blue in chapter illustrations, and green in the cover for Volume 13. She also normally wears bright red lipstick except when she's home.

Camilla is seen wearing the Berlint City Hall uniform with a green vest over a white long-sleeved shirt, a green skirt, and black heels.

When she was at her party, Camilla wore a purple sleeveless mid-length dress with several accessories, such as a golden butterfly-shaped brooch on her chest, two golden bracelets of different sizes on her left arm, and a beaded bracelet on her right arm. She was also wearing blue heels.

When Yor visited her house to learn how to cook, Camilla wore a purple long-sleeved shirt, a white flowy skirt that reaches below her knees, and black heels.
ADVERTISEMENT

Personality

Camilla is initially shown to be snobbish and mean-spirited, especially toward Yor as she invited her to the party merely to make fun of her being single. She also appears to be petty and prone to jealously as after learning that Yor is married to Loid Forger, she attempts to humiliate her further by spilling hot gratin on Yor, thinking about falsely reporting her as a possible spy, and even making unsavory remarks about her old job. Despite her thorny exterior, she has a soft side and accedes to patiently teach Yor cooking when she pleads, despite her initial frustration.
Abilities and Skills

Cooking: Camilla appears to be a good cook, being able to recreate Yor and Yuri's childhood stew from just their memories. She is also knowledgeable about cooking variations from other parts of Ostania, as she adjusts the recipe after asking about Yor's hometown. It is quite likely that she cooked the dishes at her house party.
Relationships

Dominic

Dominic flirts with Camilla
Dominic flirts with Camilla
Dominic is Camilla's boyfriend and also works at Berlint City Hall. Despite Dominic not approving of her harsh remarks towards Yor, her still amours Camilla, being able to see her genuine nice side. The feeling appears to be mutual with Camilla as she seems to be defensive and possessive of him, pulling him back when he merely talked to Yor at her party. When Dominic called Camilla cute for patiently helping Yor in cooking, she easily gets embarrassed.

Yor Forger

Camilla talks about Yor's previous job
Camilla makes accusations about Yor's previous job in an attempt to humiliate her in front of Loid
Yor is Camilla's fellow co-worker among the female city hall clerks. Before getting to know Yor, Camilla was not on good terms with her, as she gossiped and made fun of her for not being normal. Camilla invites Yor to her party and tells her to bring a partner, despite believing that she could never bring a man over anyway. At the party, Camilla and Millie mock Yor for showing up alone, and she even declares to make sure Yor's brother knows that. Later, she gets jealous when Yor is revealed to be married to Loid, a refined and handsome man, and tries to spill hot gratin on her to "take her down a notch." After that fails, Camilla even goes as far as bringing up Yor's previous job to Loid and implies that she was doing obscene work. However, after Loid brings up Yor's difficult past growing up, Camilla backs off.[2]

After Yor's marriage to Loid is revealed, Camilla and the other girls begin having a lot more to talk about with her, with Yor often coming to them for advice regarding her marriage. Most times, Millie and Camilla would not offer much help and try to suggest that Yor break up with Loid.

Camilla helps Yor cook
Camilla teaches Yor how to cook
Despite Camilla continuing to behave condescendingly and harshly toward Yor, she says Camilla always seemed like a wonderful person. Their relationship appears to improve after Camilla reluctantly teaches Yor how to cook to improve her home cooking and finds out how bad she is in the kitchen. Despite getting fed up with Yor's clumsiness, she relents after seeing how serious Yor is about her marriage with Loid and remembering Yor's past, so she earnestly teaches her co-worker how to cook. She later notes that Yor appears to have changed after marrying Loid.[1]

One afternoon, when Millie and Camilla get stuck at city hall to finish their overtime work, Yor repays the favor for Camilla's cooking lessons and offers to help to finish their work alongside Sharon, much to Camilla's gratitude. Later that night, the ladies have their after-work dinner with Yor for the first time. As they chat about their partners and tease Yor about her marriage, Camilla and the others get to see a new side of Yor, which they all find cute and amusing.

Sharon

Sharon is one of Camilla's co-workers in Berlint City Hall. She appears to befriend her as they frequently talk and hang out together, even outside of work.

Millie Myers

Millie is another one of Camilla's co-workers in Berlint City Hall. They appear to get along with each other as they often talk and gossip together, even after work hours.

Yuri Briar

Camilla first meets Yuri when Dominic invites him over to taste test at Yor's cooking lesson, though she has already seen pictures of him through Yor. She is surprised at how different Yuri is from the photos when he thanks her for helping Yor. The two do not interact much, with Yuri only getting upset at her when she yells at Yor but decides she is okay after she tells Yor to divorce Loid.[1]

MILLIE TO LADY PATRIOTS SOCIETY[1]

Millie Myers (ミリー・マイヤーズ, Mirī Maiyāzu?) is one of the supporting characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. She is one of Yor Forger's three co-workers at Berlint City Hall.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Millie is a young woman with light skin and eyes that are slanted downwards with long eyelashes. Her chin-length strawberry blonde hair is styled into a bob curling inwards with her fringe swept to the right of her face. Millie's hair color varies from blonde to orange in illustrations and official art from the manga and anime, appearing orange or strawberry blonde in the anime and colored manga, while closer to a darker blonde in the cover for Volume 13. She also has green eyes in the colored manga and the cover for Volume 13, but they are light blue in chapter illustrations and the anime.

Millie is seen wearing the Berlint City Hall uniform with a green vest over a white long-sleeved shirt and a green skirt. Her skirt is noticeably shorter than her co-workers, with thigh-high black socks and black heels. She also wears a small red ribbon to the right side of her head and a pair of round earrings.

At Camilla's party, Millie wears a strapless red dress with frills along the top and a belt fitted below the bust. She sports a pearl necklace with her round earrings and the ribbon on the right side of her head is thinner. Her high heels are red and have flower decals along the back.
ADVERTISEMENT

Personality

Millie is shown to be lively and mischievous, suggesting to Yor that they put snot in their section chief's coffee as a joke and most often seen smiling or giggling. Even though she later breaks up with her boyfriend, she does not seem bothered and remains cheerful, even asking Yor to introduce her to Yuri, when she hears that he is attractive.

Millie talks about her father's death
"But not my dad. He didn't get to come home at all!"
Underneath Millie's lively behavior is a very emotional young woman. Due to losing her father to the second East-West war at a very young age, Millie developed a strong sense of loneliness from his absence. She blames this loneliness for things not going well for her and her anger. Additionally, Millie also developed a dislike of being alone, something that Camilla points out to her. In the past, Millie had a difficult time working at the charity bazaar for disabled veterans due to how it reminded her of her father, to the point that she did not attend the event the year prior, crying and refusing to come.

After meeting Melinda Desmond, Millie expresses her anger toward her and the Desmond family under the notion that Donovan Desmond is a monster who started the war that took her father from her. Millie's claim is corrected by Matthew McMahon and she receives an apology from Melinda, who empathizes with her resentment. After realizing her mistake, Millie apologizes to Melinda and thanks her co-workers, especially Yor, for being there for her, and decides to keep helping at the charity event.
ADVERTISEMENT

Relationships

Yor Forger

City Hall Kitchenette Anime
Yor asking Millie and the other girls for help with her marriage
Millie's fellow co-worker among the female city hall clerks. Before getting to know Yor, Millie was not on good terms with her, and while she appeared to act friendly, she threw in insults at Yor and even partook in nasty gossiping about her with Camilla and Sharon. After Yor's marriage to Loid is revealed at Camilla's party, Millie and the other girls begin having a lot more to talk about with her, with Yor often coming to them for advice regarding her marriage. Most times, Millie and Camilla would not offer much help and try to suggest that Yor break up with Loid.

One afternoon, when Millie and Camilla get stuck at city hall to finish their overtime work, Yor and Sharon decide to help them, much to their gratitude. Later that night, the ladies have their after-work dinner with Yor for the first time. As they chat about their partners and tease Yor about her marriage, Millie and the others get to see a new side of Yor, which they all find cute and amusing.

Millie thanks Yor
Millie's newfound appreciation for Yor
Later, while working together at the charity bazaar, Millie is touched when Yor defends her from members of the Lady Patriots Society verbally attacking her for feeling down about her father's death during the event. When she learns that Yor is friends with Melinda Desmond, she feels betrayed that someone could be friends with the wife of a "monster" who started the war that took her father and has an outburst. After her history is corrected by Matthew McMahon and talking with Melinda, Millie thanks Yor, grateful for her support. Now seeing her in a newer light, Millie changes her view of Yor from a "weird, clueless robot" to a "kindly gorilla," something that a clueless Yor does not take offense to.

Camilla

Camilla is one of Millie's co-workers in Berlint City Hall. They are often seen talking and gossiping together, even after work. And the two would also frequently tease Yor together.

Sharon

Sharon is another one of Millie's co-workers in Berlint City Hall. Despite the different amount of energy they each give off, they appear to get along enough to hang out together, though Sharon would occasionally demand her to dial it down a bit.

ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

41:20

Sharon is a young woman with light skin and long black hair combed back. Her eyes are usually obscured by her glasses but are shown to be narrowed with a disinterested expression when visible. Sharon has purple eyes in the anime, the colored manga, and the cover for Volume 13, but they are black in chapter illustrations.

Sharon wears a large plain barrette at the back of her head, pulling back her hair, and half-rim glasses. She is seen wearing the Berlint City Hall uniform with a vest over a long-sleeved shirt and knee-length skirt, along with a pair of dangling earrings.

At Camilla's party, Sharon wears a long-sleeved blouse with shin-length black pants. She sports a hairpiece on the right side of her head and black heels.
Personality

Sharon is shown to be largely indifferent or disinterested, not actively making fun of Yor like her co-workers nor preventing them, though she tells Millie to cool it when she suggests Yor may be able to find a man if she stopped being airheaded.
Relationships

Yor Forger

Yor's fellow co-worker among the female city hall clerks. Like her co-workers, they were initially not on good terms with Yor, with Sharon acting very indifferent when it came to her. When Camilla invites Yor to her party and tells her to bring a partner, Sharon jabs that it might be too much for her. On the night of the party, after Yor fails to arrive with a partner, Sharon does not partake in Camilla and Millie's suggestions to report her to the SSS and tells them to leave her alone, simply chalking Yor up to being weird. After Yor's "marriage" with Loid is revealed, Sharon begins finding a lot more to talk to her about, especially when Yor goes to her to ask for advice about her marriage.

Sharon invites Yor to dinner for the first time
Sharon invites Yor to her dinner with Camilla and Millie
They also find more in common as they both have children attending Eden Academy in the same year. As such, when Yor gets worried about Anya coming home late from a field trip (unaware that the bus got hijacked), she calls Sharon to confirm Anya's whereabouts.[1] As Yor continues to talk with her co-workers more, Sharon eventually invites her to her, Camilla, and Millie's usual after-work dinner. During this dinner, the ladies discover a new side of Yor that they find pure and adorable as they tease her about her marriage with Loid.[2]

Camilla

Camilla is one of Sharon's co-workers in Berlint City Hall. They are frequently seen together. When Sharon and Camilla are not working, they are usually talking or hanging out, with Yor's marriage being a popular topic.

Millie Myers

Millie is another of Sharon's co-workers in Berlint City Hall. Despite their varying levels of energy, they get along well enough to hang out together

DOMINIC TO CAMILLA[1]

Dominic (ドミニク, Dominiku?) is one of the supporting characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. He is part of the staff at Berlint City Hall. He is a friend of Yuri Briar and is dating Camilla, Yor Forger's co-worker.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


1/2


Dominic is a man of average height with fair skin and appears to be quite built. He has dirty blond hair styled into a pompadour with a small strand of hair hanging loose on his forehead and some stubble on his chin.

At the party, he wears a green sweater over a white collared shirt with a brown coat, along with black trousers and brown shoes.

At Berlint City Hall, he is seen wearing a white button-up shirt with a striped tie and dark trousers.
Personality

Dominic is a polite and friendly man, in contrast to his girlfriend's usually brash and thorny personality. He always tries to calm her down and stop her from picking on Yor, and is the first to ask Loid about his condition when he arrives to the party injured.
Synopsis

Introduction Arc

After Yuri calls Yor to check up on her and learns that she is bringing a date to Camilla's party, he asks Dominic to see what sort of boyfriend Yor has.

Yor meets Dominic
Dominic talks with Yor at the party
At the party, Yor shows up alone, and Dominic expresses his regrets for not being able to meet her boyfriend. He also mentions how Yuri is always worried about her, and Yor requests that he tell Yuri that she brought someone nice. However, a jealous Camilla joins their conversation and rudely rejects her plea, mocking her for wanting to look good in front of her brother and declaring that Dominic will be sure to tell Yuri that she came alone. Dominic quickly apologizes to Yor for Camilla's attitude before pulling her away.

When Loid suddenly enters the party, injured and bleeding, Dominic expresses concern for his state. He later has to pull Camilla away in an attempt to stop her when she exposes suggestive rumors about Yor's previous career to Loid.[2]

Eden Beginnings Arc

Yuri meets Dominic
Dominic reunites with Yuri
At their apartment building, Dominic crosses paths with Yuri and comments that they have not seen each other for a while due to Yuri's job keeping him busy. Remembering his previous request, Yuri asks him about Yor and her date at the party. Dominic is a bit surprised that he has not had the chance to meet Yor's husband, but hearing Yor has gotten married shocks Yuri.[3]

Secret Police Arc

Dominic tells Camilla about his meeting with Yuri and how he was unaware of Yor's marriage. The next day, Camilla relays this to Yor, who panics after remembering that she forgot to tell him.[4]

Midterm Exams Arc

When Yor asks her co-workers for help on how to cook, Dominic overhears the conversation and suggests Yor learn how to cook at Camilla's house. When Camilla attempts to refuse, he insists.

Camilla and Dominic eat Yor's cooking Anime
Dominic and Camilla collapse after eating Yor's cooking
On the second day of their cooking classes, Dominic invites Yuri over to act as Yor's taste tester after Camilla's complaints about having to taste Yor's poisonous cooking. After watching Yuri happily eat one of Yor's dishes and claim it is delicious while throwing it up, the couple takes a cautious bite but collapses immediately after. Dominic later has to stop Yuri from almost dying as he eagerly devours another one of Yor's dishes. Hearing Yor's memories of her cooking for her brother, Dominic tearfully thanks the heavens that Yuri managed to survive to adulthood.[1] After the Briar siblings leave, Camilla says she is exhausted. Dominic stares at her, and after she asks what he is doing, he tells her that he was just admiring how cute she was. Camilla becomes flustered by his remark and tells him to shut up.[5]

Mole Hunt Arc

When the city hall girls hang out for dinner, Camilla talks about Dominic, having told him to: "be more cutthroat if you want to get ahead." After Yor tells the others that she has no gripes with Loid, Camilla and the girls complain about their partners, with Camilla saying that whenever she and Dominic go on a date and he shows up 20 minutes late and goofily laughs it off, it makes her want to kill him.[6]

Term Finals Arc

Berlint City Hall Workers at the charity bazaar
Dominic working with his co-workers at the charity bazaar
The city hall workers are assigned to help at the charity bazaar for disabled veterans. Camilla, in particular, is excited to be there as the actor, Kevin, will be attending, and Camilla hopes to befriend him. Dominic discourages her from doing that, thinking that he cannot compete with a hunk like Kevin, and Camilla teases him for being jealous. As Millie tells them to stop flirting, Matthew McMahon tells them to stay on the job as they are being watched by the Wounded Veteran Alliance and the Lady Patriots Society. Yor says that she knows the chairwoman of the group, Melinda Desmond, but Camilla and the others do not believe her. Camilla says that former First Ladies do not associate with municipal employees, which gets Dominic to bring up her wanting to befriend Kevin. Yor wonders if Melinda will make an appearance at the event, but Dominic tells her that it is unheard of due to Melinda having many enemies.

When Millie becomes emotionally overwhelmed and decides to head back to the office, Dominic is shocked and refuses as they are already shorthanded. He and Yor are confused as they watch Camilla and Sharon console Millie, and before Sharon can explain Millie's situation, she gets interrupted by women from the Lady Patriots Society, who tell the city hall workers to get back to work. As the women from the group insult the younger adults for being ignorant of the soldiers' suffering, Millie talks back to them and says that even though those soldiers survived and returned home, her dad was not one of them, and Dominic is surprised by this revelation.

Dominic notices that Yor, Camilla, Millie, and Sharon have become friendly
The girls surprise Dominic with their friendliness
The women from the Lady Patriots Society verbally attack Millie, but Yor and her other co-workers defend her. During the exchange, Dominic simply watches and tries to dissuade his co-workers from escalating the situation. Melinda Desmond herself arrives, and after talking with Millie, is able to de-escalate things. After Melinda leaves, Dominic comments that she really seems nothing like her husband. Dominic then walks with the girls, and as he listens to their conversation, he wonders aloud when they started getting so friendly.[7]

ADVERTISEMENT

Relationships

Camilla

Dominic flirts with Camilla
Dominic flirts with Camilla
Dominic is Camilla's boyfriend. He is the opposite pole of Camilla, as he is friendly and polite while she is thorny. Despite this, he seems to truly like her. Dominic says that despite her manners, Camilla is a noble person. He even felt proud seeing his girlfriend being patient at teaching Yor how to cook.

Yuri Briar

Dominic is Yuri's apartment neighbor and friend. Since he works at city hall with Yor, Yuri is able to ask him for updates on her life. He is also genuinely relieved that Yuri lived to adulthood when he hears how he ate Yor's terrible cooking as a child.[8] Despite their friendship, Dominic is unaware of Yuri's true job as a member of the State Security Service, only knowing him as a diplomat for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.[9]

Yor Forger

Although they are co-workers at city hall, Dominic and Yor do not appear to see each other often nor communicate closely. However, he treats her well and is ready to offer help since she is Yuri's sister. He was also the one who advised her to ask Camilla for help in cooking and pushed for it to happen, even agreeing to be a test taster. With their help, Yor learned to cook a dish from her childhood.

Not this time, Forger! You'll be a pariah in this hospital once I'm through with you!
GERALD'S PLAN AGAINST LOID FORGER[1]

Gerald Gorey (ジェラルド・ゴーリー, Jerarudo Gōrī?) is the Chief Medical Director of Berlint General Hospital. He is jealous of Loid Forger's rising popularity in the hospital and connection to Fiona Frost, for whom he has a crush on.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Gerald appears to be a middle-aged man of average height with light gray hair and brown eyes. He wears the hospital's standard lab coat over dark-colored clothes.
Personality

Gerald is an irritable man who greatly values status and reputation over anything else. As such, he has grown jealous of Loid and is bothered by his unnatural rise in popularity within the hospital. Initially wanting the public adoration that Loid has, Gerald attempted to make him a pariah in the hospital through underhanded schemes, even resorting to reporting him to SSS and accusing him as a spy. However, Gerald is not without his own misdeeds, as he is guilty of improperly accepting political donations and falsifying reimbursement requests. When backed into a corner, Gerald becomes a cowardly mess who tearfully begs for mercy. After being saved from arrest by Loid, Gerald acts slightly more politer, though he still appears to harbor jealousy toward his colleague.
History

Loid's past attempts to flatter Gerald
Loid's past attempts to flatter Gerald
Through careful networking, Gerald Gorey achieved the position as Chief Medical Director of Berlint General Hospital. Using his position, he has improperly accepted political donations and falsified reimbursement requests. According to Loid's intel, he once used his friend's luxury car to go on joyrides, misrepresented himself as the hospital's CEO during dates, ate all the break room doughnuts and blamed it on a chubby subordinate, and even stole medical supplies from the hospital to sell them to other hospitals. When Loid began working at the hospital, he took many lengths to get on Gerald's good side with gifts and compliments. However, those efforts would prove fruitless as Gerald was jealous of Loid's rising popularity among the hospital's staff and patients, not to mention his closeness to Fiona Frost, whom Gerald has a crush on. As a result, Gerald refused to hand any VIP patients to Loid out of spite.[1]
ADVERTISEMENT

Synopsis

WISE Arc

Gerald Gorey watches and eavesdrops on Loid and Fiona at work
Gerald listens in on Loid's conversation with the staff
The day before Loid's vacation on Princess Lorelei, he speaks with his co-workers about the trip, with Fiona watching him from her desk while Gerald watches them both from behind a corner.[2]

Friendship Schemes Arc

While Loid continues to receive adoration from the hospital's staff and patients, Gerald watches from afar while gnashing his teeth in envy. He later sees Fiona entering and leaving Loid's office and assumes he is also pursuing her. Reaching his limit, Gerald schemes to make Loid a pariah within the hospital.

Gerald starts by changing their staff meeting time on Loid's whiteboard to make him arrive half an hour late. Gerald expects their co-workers to admonish Loid, but to his surprise, they assume Loid has been overworking and give him their approval to rest. Gerald is shocked by their treatment, as they called him a lazy fat cat behind his back when he was one minute late for a meeting. For his next plot, Gerald gives Loid coffee filled with powerful laxatives before his afternoon exams. While Loid secretly takes an antidote, he still feels the effects of the laxatives and excuses himself to the bathroom during an examination. His endurance against his stomach pains inspires his young patient to fight on. Watching from a corner, Gerald is in disbelief as he once received a malpractice suit under the same circumstances. Later, when Loid leaves the bathroom, he accidentally leaves toilet paper hanging from his pants, which the staff finds endearing. Gerald watches their reactions in shock and believes they only act that way because of Loid's attractiveness.

Gerald reports Loid to the SSS
Gerald reports Loid to the SSS
Gerald then forges a fake letter requesting a rendezvous with Fiona, hoping to slander Loid as a cheater and court Fiona at the same time. To his shock, Fiona crumples the note and seemingly meets with Loid to confirm its contents. Fed up with everyone's adoration of Loid, Gerald decides to use his last resort to remove Loid once and for all by reporting him to the SSS, claiming he is a spy. After making the call, Gerald meets with two incognito officers. The officers explain that their appearance is to stop their suspect from fleeing and they demand Gerald's silence about their identity to prevent damaging the hospital's reputation. Gerald agrees but is slightly disappointed at being unable to humiliate Loid by having him arrested in front of the staff, having only considered himself. Unbeknownst to Gerald the two officers are actually Fiona and Franky in disguise, as they intercepted Gerald's call and are colluding with Loid for his counterattack on Gerald.

Gerald leads the officers to Loid, whom he claims has been rummaging through the records room at night and is selling the hospital's information to the West. He then takes them to Loid's desk, where he planted a file filled with fake evidence for them to find. The officers look through the file and promptly arrest Loid, much to Gerald's joy as he watches nearby. However, when Loid is questioned about the file, Fiona removes Gerald from his hiding spot and reveals that he was the one who accused him. After Gerald desperately tries to explain himself saying that he assumed Loid's rising popularity was because of a spy technique, which Franky confirms in his thoughts. Loid analyzes the files and points out that they were typed on a uniquely old typewriter, which everyone pinpoints back to Gerald, the only person in the hospital who owns one.

Loid is thanked by Gerald
Gerald thanks Loid for saving him
The situation quickly turns on Gerald, who tries to deny that he framed Loid, but Franky holds him at gunpoint and forces him to name himself. Fiona says Gerald is on the hospital's surveillance list and, using her and Loid's intel, they reveal all of his misdeeds, much to Gerald's shock. Fiona then cuffs Gerald, who calls out for her to save him, much to her confusion. Before Gerald gets taken away, Loid makes an impassioned speech about Gerald with false bravado, hailing him as "the hospital's greatest treasure" and asking to be arrested in his place. Gerald is touched by this act, while Franky pretends to be moved and lets them go. Gerald tearfully thanks Loid for saving him, and Loid offers to help lighten his load with things such as the VIP exams, which he agrees to.[1]

Red Circus Arc

When Anya and her fellow first graders at Eden Academy are on their way to the museum for their field trip, Anya thinks about copying Loid's trick on Gerald to achieve a more positive relationship with Damian, having learned about it after reading his mind. However, Anya's plan utterly fails when she attempts it.[3]

Mole Hunt Arc

Berlint General Hospital Private Room 507
Gerald gives Fiona the medical files for Loid's VIP patients
After completing the mission to capture Ostanian agent Winston Wheeler in Shellbury, Fiona is admitted to Berlint General Hospital to recover from the injuries she sustained from her fight with Wheeler under the pretense that she clumsily fell down four floors at the hospital stairs. Unaware of the true nature of her injuries, Gerald secures a private room for Fiona while hoping to spend more time with her. Contrary to his expectations, Fiona completely brushes him off. Before being escorted out of the room by a nurse (who is actually Fiona's handler, Sylvia Sherwood in disguise), Gerald gives Fiona the medical files for the VIP patients being assigned to Loid. [4]

Term Break Arc

Sometime after Berlint's annual winter festival, Gerald greets Loid at the psychiatry department and asks if he has grown accustomed to treating VIP patients. After Loid replies that he has, Gerald informs him of a surprise drop-in patient: Melinda Desmond, Ostania's former First Lady. Gerald fills Loid in on the situation, mentioning her aversion to getting kicked and assuming she is suffering from an intense persecution complex, so he advises Loid to show extreme care and discretion with her. Gerald asks if Loid can handle Melinda and assures him that he will not be under the current government's watchlist for doing so, though he plans to blame it all on him if it goes wrong.[5]

ADVERTISEMENT

Relationships

Loid Forger

Gerald initially despised Loid out of jealousy for his popularity with the hospital's staff and patients, believing that it was stolen from him. Despite Loid's attempts to flatter Gerald, he would remain jealous of him, especially due to his apparent closeness with Fiona, whom he has a crush on. Gerald eventually gets fed up with Loid and attempts to make him a pariah in the hospital using all the tricks he knows, though they all backfire on him immensely. After Loid stages Gerald's arrest and consequently saves him from it, Gerald is grateful to Loid for saving his life, though he still harbors some animosity toward him for the same reasons.

When Fiona calls in sick, Gerald decides to pay her a get-well visit and invites Loid along so he can talk with her. On the way there, Gerald notices Loid tapping his feet and assumes they are both excited to see Fiona's home, unaware that Loid was sending secret signals to notify Fiona of their arrival. After checking on Fiona, Loid stops Gerald from making more advances toward her and leaves so she can rest, later telling him that leaving when they did is the sign of a truly caring boss.[6]

While he has suspected Loid to be using spy persuasion techniques to gain his popularity and falsely accused him of being a spy, Gerald is unaware of Loid's true identity as a spy.

Fiona Frost

Gerald has a huge crush on Fiona, likely attracted by her beauty. Despite her many rejections and Gerald being aware of her fondness for Loid, he continues his attempts to court her and uses many methods to do so, from writing fake love letters from Loid to her to even giving her a private hospital room when she was injured so he could spend more time with her. When Fiona calls in sick, Gerald decides to pay her a get-well visit, bringing Loid along so he can talk with her. Upon meeting with Fiona, Gerald attempts to invite himself in, only to be harshly rejected. Gerald persists and tries to make some small talk, but Loid hurries their departure to let Fiona rest.[6]

Gerald is unaware of Fiona's true identity as a spy

I already told you once—you gotta keep your emotions out of this. If you value your life, never trust anyone. That's just how people like you and me gotta live.
FRANKY TO LOID FORGER[1]

Franky Franklin (フランキー・フランクリン, Furankī Furankurin?) is one of the recurring characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. While he appears to be a tobacco store clerk, he is secretly an informant who is an associate of Loid Forger and provides him with intel, having got him information regarding Eden Academy's exam and Anya's past records.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:06

41:20

Franky is a man with a square face, round eyes, and an upturned nose. He has big, curly dark brown hair and a short goatee.

Franky usually wears a white dress shirt with the sleeves rolled up, an orange tie, purple dress pants with black suspenders, orange and white striped socks, and brown shoes. He also sports glasses with a thick red frame and an earring on his left earlobe.
Personality

Franky learns the truth about Kacey
Franky is heartbroken when he finds out his love interest has a boyfriend
Franky is an affable person willing to help Loid out whenever he is in a pinch, even though the danger is high. He frequently warns Loid not to get too close to other people in their line of work. Despite this advice, Franky frequently falls in love with other women, but his love life typically fails due to a lack of mutual interest or because they are already with someone else. In contrast, Franky is more successful with friends, as he knows many people and is popular enough to be greeted by many visitors at a club.

Franky is a rather money-driven person, as he is willing to perform favors for Loid if the spy promises to give him material goods, even if he was previously reluctant to do so or the situation was extremely dangerous.

Franky tells Loid about his eliminated contact
One of Franky's secret talks with Loid
Having participated in the second East-West war, Franky came to understand that the war was a result of a diplomatic failure and deemed it stupid and pointless for regular people to kill each other on their respective nation's orders, which led him to defect from the Ostanian army. While he lives in Ostania, Franky dislikes the government's oppressive nature and is willing to collaborate with Westalian agents like Loid and Fiona by secretly passing them intel, which Franky considers his way of fighting back.
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Skills

As an informant, Franky's primary skills are information gathering and making contacts.

Intelligence Gathering: Franky is an extraordinarily impressive informant, being able to access a vast amount of highly secure information without getting caught or noticed by the SSS, from accessing and copying a large pile of personal documents regarding info on unmarried women in the city to getting the answers to an exam from Eden Academy. He also has access to a large network of contacts and fellow informants, allowing him to quickly gather information and borrow a large variety of skills as needed, as well as go around the city unnoticed.

Inventing: Being one of his passions, Franky can build a variety of gadgets, though they are often niche or extremely limited in use.[3] While he has made many inventions to show off to Loid, very few are practical enough to be used by him.

Wide Circle of Acquaintances: Franky has a very large circle of acquaintances. He knows many people doing different jobs in different places and uses these connections to provide information to WISE agents such as Loid and Fiona and sometimes for his own interests. It seems that Franky has good and even friendly relations with some of his acquaintances

MARTHA TO BECKY BLACKBELL[1]

Martha Marriott (マーサ・マリオット , Māsa Mariotto?) is one of the supporting characters of the SPY x FAMILY series. She is a longtime servant of the Blackbell Family and typically acts as Becky's caretaker.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:01

41:20

Martha is a fairly tall old lady with blue eyes and straight, gray hair styled in a low bun. She typically wears a black suit with a white undershirt, tied by a red bolo tie with a golden clasp in the shape of a bell with the letters "BB" on it, likely standing for Blackbell and representing her servitude toward the family. For jewelry, she wears two gold ball earrings.[1]

In her youth, Martha had light brown hair. When she transferred to Eden Academy, Martha had a short bob that she grew out long enough over time to make two low braids. In her final year at the school, Martha had shoulder-length hair that she occasionally styled into a low ponytail.

After joining the military during the first East-West war, Martha cut her hair short. Over the months, when her hair grew a little longer, she cut it even shorter to disguise herself as a man during her journey from Westalis to Ostania.
Personality

Martha carries herself in a very dignified manner, not showing signs of anger when she is disappointed in someone. Despite working for a very wealthy family, she seems to show no care about class herself. In serious moments, she can become very strict and even protective over people she cares about, even scolding and reproaching them if they try something inappropriate or unexpected.[3]

Young Martha tells her fellow soldiers about her desire to fight
Martha's wish to fight the enemy
In her younger years, Martha was more impulsive and presumptuous. She got into fights with bullies and was not afraid to express her own opinion, even if it sounded too straightforward, which led to her quarrel with Henry Henderson, for whom she had unspoken romantic feelings. She also had a strong sense of patriotism and a desire to defend her country; however, due to the loss of her dream of becoming a ballerina, she also had a strong rage towards the West and was ready to fight even at the cost of her own life if it would allow her to take at least one enemy with her. But when Martha was faced with the care of an elderly Westalian woman, she slightly changed her mind about Westerners, realizing that there are kindhearted people among them too. Also, having been on the verge of death, she lost her zeal to fight with anyone and just wanted to return home to those she loved.
ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Skills

Fighting Skills: Being a former soldier that served in the two East-West wars, Martha has basic combat skills. However, unlike an average solider, Martha has notable high speed, once leaping into the air, shocking Vadim holding a captive Anya with a taser, and catching the little girl before she hit the ground in quick succession. During her youth, Martha was quite agile and was strong enough to fight three older students, taking down two using just her ballet techniques.

Young Martha Ballet
Martha's talent as a ballerina
Dance Skills: In her youth, Martha was quite skilled in ballet—so much so that she used it to transfer to Eden Academy through a scholarship. At Eden, she focused on her ballet and entered the high school ballet program, even considering pursuing a ballet career. Martha was also able to use her ballet moves to fight three older students with great effect.
Special Moves

As a teenager, Martha used her ballet moves to fight three older boys at once while having the element of surprise.

"Be a giver, not a taker." "Help each other up, don't hold each other down." You're the one who's always teaching me that stuff! And you know what? I'm proud to be the person I've become.
BIDDY TO BILLY SQUIRE[1]

Bridget Squire (ビディ・スクワイア, Bidi Sukuwaia?), better known as Biddy Squire (ビディ・スクワイア, Bidi Sukuwaia?), was the daughter of Billy Squire and a member of the Red Circus.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:01

41:20

Biddy was a young girl with shoulder-length hair and messy bangs. She also had freckles across her nose and cheek, and her eyes were narrowed and drooped slightly, with visibly long lower eyelashes and short thin eyebrows above.
Personality

Biddy feeding the neighborhood cats
Biddy feeding the neighborhood cats
Thanks to Billy's raising of her, Biddy was a very kind-hearted person with noble goals to help those who needed it most, even if it did not directly benefit. She would even go as far as to feed the neighborhood cats and make sure that they all got equal shares. Although Biddy acknowledged that she was meddling in their world, she said she could not bear to see anyone cry.

Biddy's strive to help others led her to join the Red Circus, as she sought to protest against the government for their negligence, which was negatively affecting the people. She did get a little rough when others tried to stop her from going to claim her rights, like when she got mad at her father for trying to stop her from going to a Red Circus student demonstration. However, she did feel some conflict as Billy reasoned that he was only looking out for her and only wanted her safety. Biddy was a selfless girl and willing to do anything so that she and others could live a happy and fearless life.
ADVERTISEMENT

History

Biddy was born to Billy Squire and her mother in Ostania. While Biddy's mother appeared to be present in her childhood as shown in a family photo, at some point, she disappeared from the family for unknown reasons, leaving Billy to raise Biddy on his own. Billy would teach her good morals and to be a caring and helpful young woman. As Biddy grew older, she became an active member of the Red Circus, which was still a student movement at the time, and partook in their student demonstrations, though Billy disapproved of her involvement with the group, fearing that they were shady.

Billy and Biddy's last conversation
Biddy's last conversation with Billy before her death
Before Biddy left home for another protest, Billy tried to stop her out of worry, reiterating his wariness of the Red Circus and fearing the government's dangerous strictness with protesting. Biddy declared that while she was not scared to die for what she knows is right, she was scared of living in a world where no one is allowed to criticize what is wrong, pointing out how people are suffering because of the government's negligence. Billy tried to tell her the real world was not that simple, but Biddy brushed him off, even calling him "the enemy." Billy stated that he only wanted to keep their family safe, making Biddy a little bit upset before she left.

Biddy was killed during that protest, and her corpse was later found in the aftermath and shown to Billy. As her father, Billy became marked by the SSS and later joined the Red Circus as they helped him flee Ostania.[2]
ADVERTISEMENT

Synopsis

Red Circus Arc

Biddy is mentioned by Billy when Henry Henderson asks him if he has any children after seeing him watch the child hostages with a tender look. Billy tells Henry about Biddy and how she was murdered by the state. He explains how Biddy was part of the Red Circus and how the state turned violent against them. Resolving to see that the state reaps what they have sown, Billy refuses to take Henry's criticism for using child hostages.[3] Later, as Billy sees the tired children in the school bus, he recalls his final moments with Biddy before and after her death.[4]

Billy sees his daughter in Anya
Billy sees Biddy in Anya
Billy thinks of Biddy again when Anya Forger approaches him and unexpectedly starts mirroring her words, saying that while she is not afraid of them, she is of dying without being able to speak for the ones in need. Hearing this and remembering more of Biddy's words, Billy begins losing his resolve to go through with his plan. Billy's partner Vadim interjects and asks if he has forgotten his daughter, telling Billy that if he wants equality, he should let the upper-class understand his pain of losing a child.

Saying he could never forget Biddy, Billy flashes back to a past memory of when Biddy got scratched while feeding the neighborhood cats. Biddy explains how she was trying to equally distribute the food between the cats, and though she knows she is meddling in the animal's world, she could not bear to hear anyone cry. While Billy is proud of his daughter, he quickly realizes she has once again used the food from their pantry to feed the cats. Biddy giggles and reminds him that he is always teaching her to "Be a giver, not a taker. Help each other up, don't hold each other down." Biddy then says that she is proud to be the person she has become.

In the present, Billy realizes that he has never forgotten about Biddy, but pretended that he did to keep his anger and not to lose his reason to live. He admits to being aware that the Red Circus's methods are wrong, yet did nothing to stop them. However, after seeing Biddy in Anya, he refuses to let his daughter die a second time, as he still wants to be able to call himself Biddy's dad. As such, Billy ultimately decides to give up on his plan and surrenders to the authorities while taking full blame for the operation.[1]

ADVERTISEMENT

Relationships

Billy Squire

"I'm proud to be the person I've become"
Biddy expresses pride of the person she has become thanks to Billy's teachings
Like any father, Billy loved his daughter dearly and always did his best to keep her safe. He raised her with the mindset of helping and supporting those who need it most, as he wanted his daughter to become a person with great values. Biddy was always following her father's steps, so she became a kind person who always tried to help others (even if she ended up harmed).

However, some time before her death, Biddy's relationship with Billy was strained due to her participation in student demonstrations. When he tried to dissuade her from engaging in dangerous activities, she only brushed him off and even went so far as to call her father "enemy."

When Billy learned Biddy died, he was devastated and decided to avenge his daughter's death, leading him to join the Red Circus and later become its leader. During the Eden bus hijackings, the student hostages, especially Anya, cause Billy to realize that his methods were wrong and that he only faked all that anger as he was afraid of forgetting his daughter, who was his reason for living. But in truth, he realizes he will never forget Biddy, so he decides to surrender to the police and deal with the consequences because he still wants to be called her dad. Thanks to Anya, Billy remembers again the words he taught to his daughter, "Be a giver, not a taker. Help each other up, don't hold each other down," and how Biddy, during her lifetime, showed him gratitude for helping her be the person she became.
