Today is the day. If this plan succeeds, it'll put an end to the collusion between East and West. Minister Brantz's death will be the catalyst of the war that restores Ostania to its former glory… and sends those arrogant Western pigs to their knees!
KEITH TO HIS CRIME PARTNERS[1]

Keith Kepler (キース・ケプラー, Kīsu Kepurā?) is a student from Berlint University who was the leader of a terrorist group in Berlint, Ostania, and the main antagonist of the Doggy Crisis Arc.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Keith is a tall and slim young man with messy black hair and a tall build. He wears a coat with a vest, a regular white shirt tucked inside, and black pants.
Personality

He is rather cruel and callous, willing to use bomb dogs as part of his assassination plan, ordering his followers to kill Anya when she overhears his plans, and willing to kill other Ostanian citizens as collateral damage from his explosive trap. Keith can be described as a xenophobe who views his nation superior than its neighboring country Westalis and has no hesitation to start a war alongside his other conspirators.

Keith also has an intense tenacity, doing everything he could to ensure that his assassination plot and overall goal to return Ostania to its "former glory" succeeded, no matter how many obstacles stood in his path. Even after all of his comrades were captured and he himself was almost caught by agents, he continued on with his plans, even if he had to do it alone.
ADVERTISEMENT

History

Keith was the leader of a terrorist group, consisting of isolationist college students from Berlint University, intending to assassinate Minister Brantz to start a war between Westalis and Ostania. After going to the black market, the group gained access to military-trained lab dogs, who they intended to use as suicide bombers for their plan.
Synopsis

Doggy Crisis Arc

Keith draws his blade
Keith decides to get rid of Anya
Keith and his group begin loading caged dogs inside a van. Upon seeing the preparations complete, Keith says they will get started.[2] Later in their hideout, Keith and the other students talk about their assassination plot and his plan to assassinate Minister Brantz to start a war and bring Ostania back to its former glory. Kurt walks in to alert Keith that he caught Anya listening to their conversation. As the other students ask Keith what they should do, he pulls out a switchblade, telling them they just need to take care of it.[1]

As Kurt holds the little girl in place, Keith gets ready to kill her. One of the other students tries to dissuade him, but Keith tells them they need to silence her so she does not rat them out. However, they are interrupted by Bond, who attacks Kurt and stands between them and Anya. One of the students prepares to attack Bond, but Keith tells them they need to keep this dog safe. As Keith prepares to kill the girl, everyone is surprised when they are suddenly called by Kim, one of their co-conspirators, who informs them that their hideouts have been raided.

Terrorists overtake Anya and Bond
Keith and Kurt catch up with Anya and Bond
Realizing that they have been outed by their fellow member Kris, Keith says they now have to switch to Plan B. Afterward, Keith quickly notices that Anya and Bond are nowhere to be seen. Keith yells at the rest of the group for letting her escape and orders them to tear all the maps off the wall as they will be abandoning the hideout. He then grabs a German shepherd and chases after the escapees with Kurt. To their surprise, however, the chase is a short one as the pair end up running in a circle and straight to Keith and Kurt.

After restraining Bond, Keith directs Kurt to kill Anya, but Anya's mother Yor appears from behind and knocks Kurt to the ground, shocking Keith.[3] Keith sends the German shepherd after Yor, who scares it away with a scary face. As a crowd starts gathering at the alleyway, Keith decides to try to run away. He tries to bring Bond, pulling on his leash, but the white dog refuses to move, so Keith kicks him away and runs away. He later tries going to one of his hideouts, only to find it under investigation by WISE agents, who have also captured all of his comrades. As the conference draws near, Keith realizes he must carry out the assassination himself.

Keith attaches a bomb to Aaron
Keith attaches a bomb to the German shepherd
After retrieving the German shepherd, Keith straps a bomb to him and orders him to lock on to Minister Brantz's scent. Keith believes that now his Plan B positions have been compromised, the clock tower will be swarming with security. However, he decides to use this to his advantage so he can attack the "Western pigs."[4] Keith arrives at the clock tower plaza and notices the German shepherd catching a scent. However, he pulls the dog back and returns to his car, then thinks about how he hopes the bomb he planted works. While he acknowledges that innocents will die in the explosion, he justifies their deaths for the greater good of Ostania.

Keith later goes to the hotel Minister Brantz is staying at and immediately gives chase once the German shepherd catches his scent. Keith is initially confused by Brantz's erratic driving but realizes they are heading towards the river, something he appreciates as it is away from the crowds. Suddenly, he is caught off guard by the appearance of WISE agents, and an agent begins shooting at him. However, Keith slams his car into theirs before throwing a stick hand grenade at them, flipping over the car. As he resumes driving after the minister, Keith looks to be on a high after this victory.

Keith shocked by the minister's moves
Keith shocked by "Minister Brantz's" agility
Keith catches up to the minister's car and sees the vehicle abandoned. However, he sees Brantz running off in the distance, so he sends the German shepherd after him. Brantz tries to shoot at the dog, but the German shepherd expertly dodges all his bullets. The minister then continues running and parkours over a wall. As he follows after him, Keith is shocked by this movement, knowing that Brantz is 60 years old.[5] When the dog finally pounces on the Minister in an alleyway, Keith quickly detonates the bomb. To his surprise, Keith sees the bomb exploding in the river. As smoke gathers in the alley, Keith sees that the man in the distance is not Minister Brantz.

Keith Car Crash
Keith defeated by Yor
Keith realizes that his plan is in ruins and attempts to drive away. During his escape, however, Yor suddenly jumps down in front of his path. Keith tries to go forward, but the woman kicks his car off the road, causing him to crash into a pole and fall unconscious. Yor then reports the incident to the police, claiming that he had a car accident. Later, during the meeting between the WISE agents, it is revealed that the SSS took care of the rest.[6]

ADVERTISEMENT

Skills

Keith blows up WISE's car
Keith flips over the WISE Agent's car with an explosive
Explosive Expert: Keith has good control over bombs and explosives, since he led a group of terrorists in order to send bomb dogs to assassinate Minister Brantz with an almost flawless plan, managed to set up a bomb in the clock tower that could have killed Loid, and even threw a grenade while he was driving that flipped over the WISE Agent's car.

Intelligence: Keith is quite intelligent, as he devised many plans to ensure his assassination succeeded, had many secret hideouts, and was able to throw together a rigged explosive trap that would have taken Loid Forger's life if not for Anya's intervention. Even after all of his team got captured, he still had one last strategy that could have succeeded had WISE not intervened. In the end, his plans failed due to the Forger family playing a part in stopping him.

Knife Skills: Keith always has a knife with him, which he uses in his attempt to kill Anya.
ADVERTISEMENT
Relationships

Kris

Keith and Kris seem to have had a good relationship as both attended the same university and worked to make their assassination plot a success. After Kris was captured and deceived by Loid Forger disguised as Keith, he sold out the other members of their group and told WISE about their plans. Even after Keith realized Kris got caught and found agents at one of their lairs, he found it difficult to believe that Kris sold them out.

Listen! My name is Daybreak! I'm a supertalented, supercool spy who just espionaged the crap outta this place like it was no big deal! You tell everyone about this, and you make it sound good! Spice it up a little if you want!
DAYBREAK TO TWILIGHT[1]

Daybreak (〈東雲しののめ〉, <Shinonome>?) is an Ostanian spy looking to make a name for himself as a "rival" to Twilight. He was hired by an unknown client, later revealed to be George Glooman, to modify the Damian and Demetrius Desmond's midterm answers to give them failing scores. He is a highly untalented, yet lucky, spy.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance

Daybreak is a tall and well-built man who appears to be Loid's age. He has short, worn-loose brown hair and green eyes (blue in the manga).

Daybreak wears a beige pork pie hat with a black ban, a navy blue turtleneck under a black jacket, black pants, and brown shoes. At both of the shoulders of his jacket sleeves is a symbol of a half-sun, a symbol for his code name.
Personality

Daybreak is an overconfident and vain individual. Declaring himself an elite spy despite appearing to have little to no background in the profession, Daybreak has complete faith in his abilities and performs almost every one of his actions with great bravado, doing rolls and finishing with a pose during his first infiltration mission. Daybreak's confidence is matched by his incompetence as a spy, as he fumbled around Eden Academy during his mission and was only able to evade getting caught by the school's security through his own luck and with Loid's interventions to clean up his mess.

Daybreak introduces himself to Loid
Daybreak making efforts to become a famous spy
Daybreak desires to make himself known as a spy as famous as Twilight, which conflicts with how a spy would normally stay hidden. In a rare moment, Daybreak acknowledges that as a spy, people will never know who he is, which he then decides to solve by signing his name on the tests he doctored. When he is caught in the act by a professor (a disguised Twilight) who offers to keep his actions a secret, Daybreak instead demands that the world know of his deeds, even requesting the man to embellish them a little to make his name known.
ADVERTISEMENT

Synopsis

Midterm Exams Arc

Daybreak infiltrates Eden Academy
Daybreak infiltrates Eden Academy
After the midterm exams at Eden Academy finish, Daybreak is given his first mission when he is hired by George Glooman and his butler using the boy's three months of allowance money. Daybreak is tasked with changing the Desmond brothers' midterm answers to failing ones. Going in with only the information he was given, even writing the details of his mission on his hand, Daybreak somehow manages to infiltrate the elite private school. While he sneaks around the school grounds, Daybreak has an inner monologue explaining who he is and why he became a spy and picked his code name: to one day confront the famous Westalian agent Twilight and see who the true spy is between the two. Daybreak heads to the school vault where the exams are, and, despite his efforts to stay hidden, he is quickly spotted by Loid, who is disguised as an Eden professor and also at Eden for a similar goal.

Daybreak moves towards the north hall where the vault is but almost gets caught by some security guards. However, he manages to avoid getting caught by holding himself sideways and high off the ground on a signpost, which shocks Loid. Daybreak continues to the building but finds that the door is locked. Instead of trying to pick the lock like Loid was planning to do, he blatantly breaks a window on the door and opens it from the inside. Not wanting unwanted attention, Loid plants a soccer ball by the door to make it look like an accident caused by the soccer team.

Daybreak knocking out Loid
Daybreak "knocks out" the disguised Loid
Daybreak reaches the vault, and when the guard there questions him, he pretends to be an Information Sciences professor but has no I.D. prepared to prove his identity. Just as the guard gets suspicious of him, Loid steps in to give Daybreak the fake I.D. of an Information Sciences professor. After the men are given clearance to enter, Daybreak thanks the professor for helping him. Outside the vault holding the exams, Daybreak attempts to open the door with the passcode he copied onto his hand but quickly realizes he incorrectly copied it. After an awkward silence, he pretends to leave and lets Loid open it. After the vault is opened, Daybreak knocks Loid to the ground (although clumsily) and drags him inside the vault.

Once inside, Daybreak finds the box with the first-years' test answers but momentarily struggles to open it. After successfully altering Damian and Demetrius's test scores, he gloats for a bit, believing he will get more jobs after this mission. After mentioning being on the papers, Daybreak reminds himself that it will not happen as he is a spy and no one will know who he is. He then solves this problem by deciding to sign his name on the tests to gain exposure. Hearing all this, a shocked Loid jumps up and shouts that spies are not supposed to leave a trace.

Daybreak gets fired
Daybreak gets fired for failing his mission
Instead of being mad that he was discovered, Daybreak follows his desires and insists that Loid tell everyone about him. Daybreak introduces himself to Loid and requests him to exaggerate his feats and not reveal his mission details. He then bids goodbye and rolls away with a laugh, leaving the master spy dumbfounded. Loid then restores the Desmond brothers' test answers, foiling Daybreak's efforts. After George finds out that the Desmond brothers' test scores were not changed, Daybreak is called to learn that he failed his mission and is promptly fired, much to the man's confusion and dismay.[1] Later, when hearing George's thoughts at school, Anya learns that Daybreak was the spy that Loid had previously mentioned in his thoughts.[2]

Campbelldon Tennis Arc

Daybreak and Fiona at Campbelldon
Daybreak defeated by Nightfall
Daybreak makes a brief appearance at Cavi Campbell's Campbelldon tennis tournament as a participant. During the tournament, he unknowingly reunites with Loid when he faces off against him and his spy colleague Fiona Frost, aka Nightfall, who have disguised themselves as the "Foney couple" as part of their infiltration. In her efforts to impress Twilight, Nightfall defeats Daybreak and his partner with unnecessarily bold and flashy plays.[3]

Term Finals Arc

Since Daybreak's infiltration of Eden after the midterm exams, the school discovered evidence of it and significantly strengthened its security procedures. As such, by the time of Anya's first term finals, Loid has lost the option of changing her test answers if she fails her exams, much to his frustration. Loid briefly ponders if the foolish Daybreak was actually a master spy whose true goal was to undermine Operation Strix, but he quickly comes to his senses and disregards the thought.[4]

ADVERTISEMENT

Abilities and Skills

Daybreak hanging on a signpost
Daybreak hanging on a signpost
Stealth: Daybreak does not appear to have much sense for stealth, performing his infiltration with little preparation and actively making efforts to make himself known. Despite this, he was able to remain mostly undetected from Eden's security.

Strength: Daybreak appears to have above-average strength, as he was able to quickly hold himself to a signpost sideways, showcasing great grip strength and agility, which impressed even Loid. He was also able to knock Loid to the ground with a sneak attack.
Relationships

Twilight

After hearing rumors that Twilight has infiltrated Ostania, Daybreak decides that he will be the one to go against and defeat him, thus giving himself his code name. Daybreak unknowingly meets his "rival" during his first mission, and his actions cause the spy to gain a low opinion of him. Despite that, Loid appears to sympathize with Daybreak's brief moment of knowing that his actions will not be publicly known, something that he himself has been told by his superiors at WISE.

You all go ahead and waste what time you have left fighting up there. This whole boat… to the sea floor… soon… Farewell to you, Princess Lorelei. As you sink beneath the waves… serenade me with your screams.
SNOOPS TO HIMSELF[1]

Snoops (聞き耳ーくん, Kikimimi-kun?), also known as Eavesdropper (盗聴役, Tōchō-yaku?), was one of the assassins hired by Leonardo Hapoon to kill Olka Gretcher and her son, and is the main antagonist of the Cruise Adventure Arc.

He was the informant of the Assassin Leader and received his nickname due to his unique skill of listening to multiple listening devices at the same time and obtaining clues about his targets.

Appearance

Snoops is a tall and slim middle-aged man with messy black hair reaching his shoulders and a small goatee on his face. He has a short moustache, a small goatee on his chin, and red eyes that have multiple dark rings within them. His outfit consists of a white shirt under a black business suit and a navy blue tie with white stripes.
Personality

Snoops is shown to be a sadistic man who lacks empathy for others, as he decides to wait to see the entire ship blow up while the passengers are still on it since he wants to see the victims slowly dying and is quick to betray his assassin allies for his own benefit. He is also calm and collected, and expressed confidence that his plan to bomb the ship would be a success until he was hit by one of his own bombs and left for dead in the ocean.
History

Snoops was known to provide information regarding Olka's location and identity to the other assassins and was hired by Leonardo Hapoon. He placed a multitude of listening devices all over Princess Lorelei and was capable of listening to every single conversation through these bugs in order to obtain information.
Synopsis

Cruise Adventure Arc

Snoops listening to conversations in the ship
Snoops listening to all conversations in the cruise ship
Snoops is in an unknown dark room from the ship listening to all conversations around the ship, until he captures one where he hears Olka, going under the alias "Shaty," talking about her son Gram, who shares the same name as her father. He then looks through the passengers' list to find the rooms of people named Shaty, he pinpoints it down to "Shaty Grey."[3]

After sharing this information with the other assassins, he loses contact with Knockman after he goes to Olka's room alone. He deduces that they have found their target and relays this to the Assassin Leader. He adds that Olka is being accompanied by a man and a woman and that the group has changed rooms. The Assassin Leader later asks Snoops if he will share any information he finds, reminding him that they paid a considerable amount for his services. Snoops replies that he sells information equally and wishes the Leader good luck in getting ahead of everyone.[4]

After Olka's group evades the assassins, the Assassin Leader radios to Snoops, asking if he picked up their trail. Snoops says he has not but surmises they might be hiding in a second or third-class cabin. He then overhears two bugged assassins speaking ill of him and plotting to take back the money they paid him. Hearing this, Snoops decides to make some contingencies.[5] The next evening, Snoops intercepts a coded transmission and predicts it might be from Olka's allies. Hearing this, the Leader makes an order to get their team into position for an ambush.[6]

Snoops is preparing to escape
Snoops prepares to make his exit
Upon realizing the assassins' ambush failed, Snoops plants explosives around Princess Lorelei, planning to sink it. Anya overhears his thoughts, which leads her to Yor's location.[1] Snoops prepares to exit on a raft tied to the ship while he tunes in to the listening devices and learns that all the other assassins have been wiped out. The Leader appears and confronts Snoops about the bombs, holding him at knifepoint. Snoops states his goal to not only finish off Olka and her guards but also start another war with Westalis, revealing that he made the bombs look like they were from the West. The exhausted Leader tells Snoops to get the raft moving, but they quickly turn on each other when Snoops says he only brought enough supplies for one person.

Snoops and the Assassin Leader meet their end
Snoops and the Assassin Leader in the circle of sharks
The Leader lunges his blade at Snoops, but Snoops catches his arm, restraining him while he points his gun at his head. Snoops says he will give the Leader a parting gift: the true fireworks show as Princess Lorelei explodes, and they can listen to the passengers' screams through the bugs he planted throughout the ship. Suddenly, one of his bombs gets thrown overboard by Loid and explodes over the assassins, knocking them off the raft. The men are last seen stranded in the ocean as sharks circle them.[7]

Abilities and Skills

Enhanced Hearing: Snoops received his nickname due to his unique and incredible skill of listening, as he was capable of listening to multiple listening devices at the same time and obtaining clues about his target in mere seconds.

Surveillance: He was seen to have a great sense of patience, as it is unknown how long he took to plant all the bugs in the whole ship, or how long he was listening to the conversations of the passengers inside.
Relationships

Assassin Leader

The Assassin Leader vs. Snoops
Snoops and the Leader trying to kill each other
As both of them were hired by Leonardo Hapoon to assassinate Olka and Gram, they kept a professional relationship, as Snoops immediately reported anything unusual to the Leader, which was relayed to the other assassins. Despite this, Snoops held a great mistrust in the Leader and the assassins when he suspected they would betray him. When the Assassin Leader finds and confronts Snoops during his escape, he is surprised to see he has survived. Snoops tries to remove the Leader as he had planned his getaway for just one person. Although Snoops had the upper hand, they both failed in their attempt to flee after Loid throws a bomb over them, and the explosion leaves them stranded in the ocean as sharks circle the assassins.

She'll rain Tonitrus Bolts down on any student for any infraction, no matter how minor! They say she single-handedly expelled over 100 students! And that wherever she steps, not so much as a single blade of grass will grow there again! They call her... Old Lady Tonitrus!
BILL WATKINS ABOUT DONNA[1]

Donna Schlag (ドナ・シュラーグ, Dona Shurāgu?) is a teacher and a member of Eden Academy's disciplinary committee. She takes pleasure in giving as many students as she can Tonitrus Bolts for whatever small reason, which has earned her the nickname "Old Lady Tonitrus" (トニトおばさん, Tonito Obasan?) by the students.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Donna is a stout, middle-aged woman. She has short, bobbed hair, and her hairline has a lightning-shaped pattern. Donna also wears sharp cat eyeglasses and dark lipstick.

Donna's outfit consists of a tiger-print dress under a black collarless coat, a large belt fashioned with a square buckle with the shape of the letter "R" in the middle, and black heels. She is accessorized with squared earrings and a large necklace, both engraved with the letter "R" on it. Donna also wears white gloves, each fitted with two rings on the middle and index finger. From left to right, the rings have the letters "E" and "C," the initials for Eden College.

When Donna was in her late teens, she had a similar hairstyle to her current one and wore round eyeglasses. As she was also an Eden Academy student and an Imperial Scholar at the time, Donna wore the school's uniform and the Imperial Scholar's signature cape.
Personality

Anya reads Donna's thoughts
Donna's enjoyment in punishing students
As a member of the disciplinary committee, Donna is extremely strict when it comes to following the rules, as she will punish any Eden student for any infraction, no matter how minor. When carrying out her punishments, Donna shows no remorse and even does it with bravado. This has resulted in her becoming one of the least-favorite teachers to the students, though Donna does not appear to mind what they think of her. Henry Henderson tries to justify her acts as an attempt to refocus the student body, but when Anya reads her mind, it is revealed that Donna takes pleasure in these punishments, even calling them a "Tonitrus party."

Despite how she may act, Donna does show care for the students, as when the bus hijacking by the Red Circus was made aware to the Eden staff, she showed visible concern for the endangered children.[3]
ADVERTISEMENT

History

Young Donna Schlag as an Imperial Scholar
A young Donna
Donna studied at Eden Academy and was in the same year as Martha Marriott. They both were in the ranks of the Imperial Scholars, but it is unknown if they communicated closely. Donna planned to go to Berlint University of Education after her graduation, but six months before the event, the first war between Ostania and Westalis took a significant turn, and it is unknown whether she managed to carry out her plans.[2]

Years later, Donna joined Eden's staff as a member of the disciplinary committee. She became feared among Eden's students as "Old Lady Tonitrus" and is rumored to have single-handedly expelled over 100 students. Before the start of Anya's first school year, Donna was hospitalized for unknown reasons.[4]
ADVERTISEMENT
Synopsis

WISE Arc

Donna Schlag punishes a smoking student
Donna stuns a smoker
As the cloudy skies cover Eden Academy, Donna Schlag walks through the school grounds. Upon noticing a student smoking behind a wall, she gestures to her secretary, Rahden, to hand her a box. With a loud clap of thunder, the student suddenly faints to the ground with a Tonitrus Bolt on his forehead as Donna walks away.

Later, outside Cecile Hall's classroom, Bill Watkins runs to Anya and her classmates to warn them about Donna. Outside, a pair of messily dressed older students complain about the noisy first-years and suggest "shutting them up." Donna is behind them, and upon hearing this, she reaches into the box, which is filled with Tonitrus Bolts, before penalizing the boys for their unkempt uniforms, uncouth speech, and conspiring to commit acts of violence, placing Tonitrus Bolts on their foreheads. After this, she turns and poses, having hit them with her "Tonitrus Strike." Rahden compliments Donna on her bestowal of Tonitrus Bolts as she disparages the students of Murdoch Swan's Cline Hall.

Bill warns Cecile Hall of Donna Schlag
Bill warns Cecile Hall of "Old Lady Tonitrus"
Henry arrives and greets her on her return as he looks at the fainted students. As they chat, Donna sees that Henry has grown soft after teaching the first-year students and suggests visiting them next before walking away. Back at Cecile Hall's class, Bill explains Donna's prior absence and her fearsome reputation for handing out Tonitrus Bolts for any infraction, rumored to have single-handedly expelled over a hundred students. He warns them to run away as his classroom has already fallen victim to "Old Lady Tonitrus" before fainting. Before the students can escape, Donna is already in front of them and introduces herself.

Donna instructs the children to line up and prepare for a bag inspection. As she checks their bags, she gives out Tonitrus Bolts for infractions like having snacks, playing cards, and even not knowing the rules. Reading her thoughts with her telepathy, Anya becomes terrified as she discovers that Donna is gleefully having fun with punishing the students. When Donna punishes a student for not bringing his handkerchief, the others question her, prompting Donna to recount the tale of "Mr. Pee Pants." The boy was an honor student who wiped his wet hands on his pants because he forgot his handkerchief, making his peers believe he peed his pants and humiliating him for it. Donna then says Mr. Pee Pants went on to become a delinquent and troublemaker, eventually getting expelled from Eden and joining an antigovernment resistance, where he was later caught by the Secret Police and his fate left unknown, and her story scares the students.

Donna Gives Anya A Tonitrus Bolt
Donna gives Anya a Tonitrus
During Damian's turn for the bag inspection, Donna sees his handkerchief has the letter "A" on it and questions if it really is his. Damian explains it is for the "A" in his name, which she accepts. Anya is next, and Donna gives her a Tonitrus since she did not bring a handkerchief. Damian attempts to speak up for Anya, as the handkerchief he presented was actually hers, but Anya stops him. Donna suspects the children are colluding and intends to give them two bolts each if she finds out they tricked her, but she is disappointed when nothing happens. After finishing the bag inspection, Donna departs from Cecile Hall, finally giving the students a moment of peace.[1]

Red Circus Arc

At Eden Academy, some teachers learn that two of their school buses carrying their first-years got hijacked. As they gather to discuss the situation, Donna is seen to be worried as Henry says he will inform the principal and instructs the teachers to prevent the news from reaching the other students or the media.[5] After the bus hijacking crisis is resolved, Donna is present at Eden's awarding ceremony for Anya, Becky, Damian, and Bill.[6]

Love and War Arc

While Martha recounts her school years to Becky, she remembers that during her final year, she attended an assembly and overheard Donna's conversation, in which she planned to enroll at Berlint U of E after their graduation.[2]

ADVERTISEMENT

Skills

Disciplinarian

Discipline: As the title of her occupation suggests, Donna maintains authority over the students and takes disciplinary action in the case of misconduct, though she punishes even the most trivial of offenses with Tonitrus Bolts.
Special Moves

Special Move	Image	Description
Tonitrus Strike
(雷トニト 閃,
Tonito Issen?)	
Donna's Tonitrus Strike
Donna's special move in which she hands out a Tonitrus Bolt to students by throwing it onto their foreheads. Most times afterward, students remain stunned or even unconscious for a while.
Relationships

Henry Henderson

As fellow teachers, Donna and Henry are familiar with each other. When she returns to Eden, she believes that he has gotten soft due to the influence of his first-year students. While her methods are strict, Henderson hopes they are her way of refocusing the student body as they acclimate to school life.

We were a respectable movement that fought for our cause with respectable means. It was the state that turned violent against us. So I'm not taking criticism from a member of the establishment. I'm gonna see to it that they reap what they've sown.
BILLY TO HENRY HENDERSON[1]


Billy Squire (ビリー・スクワイア, Birī Sukuwaia?) is the former leader of the Red Circus and the main antagonist of the Red Circus Arc.

Seeking to free their imprisoned comrades and find refuge in the nation of Nortica, he and the remnants of the Red Circus hijacked two Eden Academy buses and took the students inside hostage, using their lives to negotiate with the Ostanian government.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Billy is a tall man with medium-length hair and narrow eyes. He wears a black knit cap, a black shirt, and a jacket with the initials of the Red Circus on its left shoulder. He seems to have pale skin with some stubble on his chin.

Before joining the Red Circus, Billy had much shorter hair and was a clean-shaven man.
Personality

Billy is a cold and hardened man bent on punishing the state for wronging the people and his allies. He is willing to do anything for his goals, even taking young students as hostages. In addition to his hatred of the state, Billy has a disdain for the elite upper class, seeing them as selfish and spoiled people, and believed that trait was carried on to their children. Despite his demeanor, Billy has a soft spot for children, as they remind him of his late daughter, Biddy, who was also a member of the Red Circus and killed in a protest.

Billy's dark changes due to Biddy's death
Billy's turning point following Biddy's death
It is later revealed that Billy was once an upstanding man who taught Biddy how to be a good person and instilled in her the importance of helping others. After Biddy's death, Billy became distraught, and after joining the Red Circus, pretended to forget about her to keep his anger and reason for living from melting away. While being aware that the group's methods were wrong, Billy chose to do nothing about it.

During the hijacking of the Eden Academy buses, Billy witnesses Anya Forger and the other student hostages fearlessly standing up for each other, despite their situation. Their acts make Billy recall his memories with his daughter and the lessons he taught her, causing Billy to have a change of heart. Wanting to redeem himself as a father, he decides to turn himself in to the police, taking full responsibility for the kidnappings.[2]
ADVERTISEMENT

History

Squire family portrait
Billy pictured with his family
As shown in a photograph, Billy was an Ostanian soldier before settling down to live with his wife and daughter, Biddy. At some point, Billy's wife disappeared from the family for unknown reasons, leaving Billy to raise Biddy on his own. As her father, Billy taught her good morals and to be a caring and helpful young woman.[3]

Because of her desire to help others, Biddy became an active member of the Red Circus (which was still a student movement at the time) and prepared to leave for one of their protests. Fearing that the group was shady and the government's strictness with protests, Billy worried his daughter would get hurt, or worse, and attempted to talk her out of going. Intending to be there, Biddy declared that while she is not scared to die for what she knows is right, she is of living in a world where no one is allowed to criticize what is wrong. After Biddy continued to ignore his pleas, Billy stated that he only wanted to keep their family safe. Later, Billy was devastated to find Biddy's corpse in the aftermath of the protest, which had gone violent. Due to their connection, Billy became marked by the SSS and was offered help by the Red Circus to get out of Ostania.[4]

Over time, Billy eventually became the leader of the Red Circus, which changed to be more extreme in their methods. After most of the group was eliminated by both the SSS and the assassin group, Garden, Billy hid outside Ostania. He would later return to command a faction in Berlint in order to realize the Red Circus's goal of retrieving their captive members and finding refuge in a neutral country.
ADVERTISEMENT

Synopsis

Red Circus Arc

Billy boards an Eden Academy school bus with a fellow member and immobilizes the dorm tutor chaperoning the students. He learns that a car is going after them, so he heads to the back of the bus with a shotgun, opens the window, then shoots at the car. The shells hit the car's front tire, causing it to crash. One of the students screams out in fear, but Billy points his gun at her to shut her up. Billy then turns to the rest of the students and introduces himself and his group as the Red Circus, and that their bus is now hijacked.[5]

Billy Squire threatens Bill Watkins with his rifle
Billy threatens Bill
Billy walks back to the driver's seat with the shotgun, scaring all the children. Bill Watkins suddenly stands up to tell his fellow students that their parents are important and powerful people and help is on the way, and Billy points the gun at him to shut him up. Billy begins to tell them that he knows how important their parents are, calling out students from influential families. Billy then states his goal to use the children's lives to negotiate with the government and tells them to pray that their parents use the power they have to rescue them.

Later, Billy hears Anya randomly shouting that she has to go to the bathroom and cannot hold it any longer, and he tells her to hold it in. A while after, Damian Desmond approaches Billy and tells him he has to poo, and that his eyelashes twitch whenever he gets an upset stomach, making Billy wonder if Eden is "a moron factory." As Billy grabs the boy by his collar, he notices Anya and Becky Blackbell opening the window and throwing something outside. Billy confronts the girls about what they just did, but they attempt to feign innocence. Billy grabs a device from his bag and puts it on Anya's neck, then tells all the students that it is a bomb, and if anyone on the bus tries to act against them, he will detonate it along with the girl.[6]

Anya learns the bomb is fake
Anya learns that the bomb is fake
After watching Anya worrying for her life, he thinks to himself that the bomb is fake but he will use his last resort plan if they decide to plan anything else, but still warns her to stay put. Sometime later, Billy sees Damian get up and asks for the bomb to be attached to him instead. Billy acknowledges his courage, so he decides to put another bomb on him instead of changing it. Moments later, they are interrupted by a loud pop, and the bus starts to swerve around. The bus makes a stop, and the police surround the bus shortly after.[7]

Billy forces the kids to darken the bus windows
Billy forces the children to cover the windows
Billy and his squad are surprised to see that the Berlint City Police found them and wonder how this happened. The children, noticing the police cars outside, excitedly get up from their seats, but Billy stops them by shooting his pistol at the ceiling, threatening to shoot them if they try to leave. Over a megaphone, the police chief tells the Red Circus members to surrender. Billy asks Vadim if they can break through, but he replies that it will be impossible with their flat tires. The woman then warns Billy that the SSS is coming from the other side, so with no other choice, he grabs black sheets from his bag and orders the students to cover the windows.

Billy uses Damian to threat the police
Billy uses Damian to threaten the police
Billy exits the bus with Damian and threatens to kill all the children in the stolen buses if the police plan on doing anything. Billy states his two demands: to free all seventeen of his comrades in prison and be granted safe passage to the country of Nortica, saying that he will release five students for each comrade the police free. Billy ends his discussion with the police and returns to the bus, where Vadim scolds him for not making a bigger threat to the kids. Billy responds that as soon as they give the police a deadline, the SSS will start storming the bus. In their predicament, their only option is to stall for time, which would cause parents to start putting pressure on the government.

As they wait, Billy notices some of the students squirming. He decides to let them go the bathroom, saying that one child each will go outside to do their business at the shrubs, and orders whoever needs to go to raise their hand. Emile Elman quickly raises his hand, and Billy reminds him not to run away. After Emile relieves himself, he admits being embarrassed at having to do it outside like this. Billy tells the boy that he has led a charmed life and to thank his parents for that.

The children relieved to see Henry
Billy escorts Henry to the bus
At dusk, Billy leaves the bus to ask the police for the council's answer, to which they reply that they are still in the process of releasing three prisoners, and then request to bring the hostages food and water. Billy agrees as long as a teacher is the one who delivers the food. Eden housemaster Henry Henderson volunteers to do it and is escorted to the bus, where he notices the seriously injured tutor. Henry tells Billy that the man needs to go to a hospital, but Billy declines. After Henry negotiates to keep him in custody in exchange for releasing the dorm tutor, Billy agrees.

As the children chat and eat the rations, Billy stares at the children with a tender look. Henry notices this and asks him if he has children, to which he replies a daughter. Henry tries to appeal to Billy's parental side to convince him to free the students, but Billy interrupts that his daughter was murdered by the state, as she was also a member of the group. He explains how the Red Circus was originally a student movement asking for peace and equality, but the state went violent against them. He tells Henry that he will not take any criticism from a member of the establishment, and will make sure the state will reap what they have sown.[1]

Billy and Biddy's last conversation
Billy remembers his last conversation with Biddy
Looking at the children reminds Billy of his daughter and his final moments with her before her death. Tired of waiting like sitting ducks, Vadim suggests to Billy that they get their partner, Bruce, to get moving with the second bus. Because they are avoiding radio contact to prevent giving away his location, Bruce's hostages are their trump card.[8] However, shortly after, the SSS captain announces to the Red Circus members that their comrades from the second bus are all dead. He tells them to surrender if they do not wish to meet the same fate as them, giving them until dawn to make their choice.

Billy is shaken and simply says they failed, but Vadim and their partner tell him not to give up already, with the former reminding Billy of their friends, goals, and his daughter, so Billy agrees to keep going with the plan.[9] Anya approaches Billy, who asks if she needs to use the bathroom and tells her to hold it in. Unexpectedly, Anya says she is hungry and asks for more rations, shocking everyone. Billy yells at her and threatens to detonate her bomb. Anya is undeterred and says she is not afraid, mirroring one of Biddy's speeches. This unnerves Billy as he begins to see his daughter in the little girl. He begins to think about Biddy's words, some of which Anya begins repeating.

Billy snaps and removes the bomb from Anya, telling her to leave, as the girl is making him lose his resolve. However, Anya refuses, to everyone's shock once again. Billy yells at her, saying that the Eden students are selfish elites, but recalls Damian and Emile's courage for their classmates. Anya demands more of the rations, making Billy believe that the children are not eating enough at home. Billy's misunderstanding continues, thinking that even Donovan Desmond has fallen low since losing power and that Ostania's economy has collapsed with a food shortage while he was out of the country.

Biddy reminded Billy that he raised her well
Billy remembers again that he raised Biddy to be a good person
Astonished by Anya's selflessness, Billy asks why she is so concerned about the food and if she is being forced to do this. Anya replies that she wants to make a world where kids don't need to cry, and Billy is shocked by this noble goal. Even more shaken, Billy starts contemplating that by labeling the students as elites, he is furthering inequality. However, Vadim asks if he has forgotten about his daughter and tells him that if he wants equality, he must make their enemies know the pain of losing a child, aiming his gun at Anya. Billy flashes back to the past, to the time when Biddy got scratched while trying to equally distribute food amongst the neighborhood cats because she could not bear to hear anyone cry. Billy is proud of his daughter but realizes she used their food from the pantry to feed the cats again. Biddy giggles and reminds him that he taught her to "Be a giver, not a taker. Help each other up, don't hold each other down." Because Billy has always been teaching her these ideals, Biddy is proud to be the person she has become.

Billy looks at the rescued children during his arrest
Billy looks at the rescued children during his arrest
Back in the present, Billy realizes that he had never forgotten about his daughter but pretended to keep his anger, his reason to live, from melting away. Vadim says there is no time to waver, but Billy takes their guns and bags and then steps outside the bus. Billy knows that the Red Circus's methods are wrong but never did anything to stop them. However, he refuses to let his daughter die again, as he still wants to be able to call himself a dad. Billy puts down the weapons and surrenders, shocking everyone. Vadim yells at him to get back inside, but Billy continues to tell the forces that he is the sole planner of the operation and to be lenient with his comrades, claiming that he coerced them into joining him. As his partner reluctantly steps out of the bus, Vadim attempts to take off with the bus, and Billy yells at him to stop. Vadim is quickly apprehended by the police and Martha Marriott. As the Red Circus members get taken away, Billy takes a quick look back to see a smiling Anya waving to a crying Becky, who rushes to her and Martha.[2]

Current Arc

After the bus hijacking incident, some rumors about Anya are spread among Eden's first-years, one of which claims that she stopped the Red Circus by slaughtering them and biting their heads off. When Tertius gets targeted by Anya, he believes the rumors are true and imagines Anya standing over a defeated and bloody Billy.[10]

ADVERTISEMENT

Skills

Weapon Proficiency: Billy has good aim and handling of guns, as he was able to shoot the tire of the car that was chasing them while the bus was moving.[11] He also brought a variety of weapons with him when he got on the bus, like the taser he used to knock out the dorm tutor, or the two fake collar bombs he put on Anya and Damian.
Relationships

Biddy Squire

Billy Squire surrenders
Billy chooses to redeem himself as Biddy's father
Like any father, Billy loved his daughter dearly and always did his best to keep her safe. He raised her with the mindset of helping and supporting those who need it most, as he wanted his daughter to become a person with great values. Before Biddy's death, Billy pleaded with her to not go, but was ignored. Upon learning of her death, he was devastated and decided to avenge her, causing him to join the Red Circus.

During the events of the hijacking, the selfless actions of the student hostages, especially Anya, remind him of Biddy as he even sees her in the little girl. He later realizes that his methods were wrong and that he really faked all that anger as he was afraid of forgetting his daughter. But in truth, he realizes he will never forget his Biddy, so he decides to surrender to the police and deal with the consequences because he still wants to be called her dad.

Anya Forger

Anya is going to confront Billy
Billy's clash with Anya's determination
At first, Billy shows little interest in Anya, as his priority is to have under vigilance the children with the elite parents. However, when after he catches her throwing something outside the school bus window, he gets angered and decides to scare the rest of the kids into submission by putting a fake bomb on Anya and threatening to detonate it.

Even after this attempt, Anya does not hesitate to stand up to Billy, and her tenacity makes him remember Biddy, whose death was his reason for joining the Red Circus in the first place. Seeing Biddy in Anya, he tries to set her free out of guilt, but Anya refuses again. After she tells him her motivation for acting this way, Billy is shocked by her noble goal. Billy begins to realize that he never forgot about Biddy and surrenders to the authorities, thinking to himself that he cannot allow his daughter to die a second time, referring to Anya.

Henry Henderson

Billy thought of Henderson merely as a hostage, and when Henry attempted to reason with him by appealing to his parental side, Billy told the housemaster that he would not take any criticism from a member of the establishment.[12]

entries.content:

SPOILER WARNING!
This article may contain major plot details for the SPY x FAMILY manga.
This article may contain unmarked spoilers.
Read at your own risk.
Overview
Image Gallery
So you're WISE, right? That's a really good disguise. Could you actually be him? Could you be Twilight? We did an op together, remember? But I never got to see your face. So… Let's take a look at that illustrious face of yours. Couldn't hurt to have one more gift for the SSS...
WINSTON TO TWILIGHT[1]

Winston Wheeler (ウィンストン・ウィーラー, Winsuton Wīrā?) is an Ostanian Intelligence agent working with the State Security Service and the main antagonist of the Mole Hunt Arc.

Winston acted as a mole in Westalian Intelligence and later stole top-secret files regarding their operations in Ostania, including Operation Strix, which he planned to hand over to the SSS.


ADVERTISEMENT
Appearance


00:00

41:20

Winston is a tall man with short blond hair, blue eyes, and light skin. His hair is seen slicked back with a few loose strands hanging at his face. His build is almost similar to Twilight's, but Winston is slightly taller and more muscular than him.

While on the run from WISE operatives, he had grown a beard, which he shaved off upon returning to Ostania. In Ostania, Winston dons a black suit under a trench coat. His distinguishing feature for SSS operatives to identify him with is a gemstone tiepin on his green tie.
Personality

Winston evokes the impression of a cold and staunch man with iron nerves. He remains calm in extreme situations and even makes time to shoot remarks at his enemies.

Aware that spies should not have any attachments, Winston makes it his rule to never trust anyone or invest anything into anyone. Because of this, he believes it is what gives him strength and deems spies who have attachments weaker than him.
ADVERTISEMENT

History

WISE's files on Winston
WISE's files on Winston
Originally from Ostania's intelligence apparatus Division 4, Winston went over to Westalis to infiltrate their intelligence agency, WISE, joining their communications division to act as a mole. There, he would repeatedly pass the West's secrets to the East, and he is implied to have been behind the recent spy purge which damaged many WISE operations[3]. Before Twilight began doing missions in Ostania, he and Winston shared a brief partnership while working on a mission together. Although they worked together, Winston never got to see his co-worker's true face.

Some time after Operation Strix began, WISE HQ eventually became aware of a mole in their ranks and sought to ferret them out. However, by the time Winston was identified as the mole, he had already gone underground. Around the same time, he took several of the agency's top-secret documents with him, one of them being a coded map indicating areas of operational activity by WISE agents in Ostania, including those related to Operation Strix. Winston quickly left for Ostania to be received by the SSS and hand over the files to them, but WISE quickly took chase and sent their agents to stop him from reaching the East-West border.[4]
ADVERTISEMENT

Synopsis

Mole Hunt Arc

Winston defeating his pursuers
Winston defeats his WISE pursuers
Holding only a briefcase, Winston persists in his escape from several WISE agents, who attempt to corner him in an alleyway. As one of the agents turn through a corner, Winston attacks from above, bashing the man's head with his briefcase. As a second agent prepares to shoot him, Winston shields himself using the first and takes the opportunity to use their pistol to gun down the second man while he is distracted, then finishes off the first afterward. As he exits the alleyway, an agent attempts to ram him with his car, but Winston leaps over the car while shooting the agent. As the car crashes behind him, Winston discards the gun while letting out a sigh of relief.

According to WISE's sources, Winston has already crossed the Ostanian border in the north and is planning to meet with the SSS at the Shellbury Hotel in Shellbury, Ostania's northwest region. Winston stops at a motel, where he cleans himself up and shaves off his beard. Shortly after, he receives a call with orders to meet at the hotel.[5]

Winston arrives at Shellbury. Heading to the top floor of a building nearby the hotel, Winston waits to receive a signal from SSS captain Gascoigne, but never gets one. Observing the streets outside the window, Winston spots Gascoigne being followed by WISE agents. Wondering where Gascoigne is going and if the meetup location is getting changed, Winston decides to stay cautious and follow him.

Fiona discovers Winston
Winston senses that he has been spotted
Little does Winston know that Gascoigne is actually a WISE Agent in disguise, who attempts to lure out Winston on the streets. He and other agents stage a car accident, which will allow him to identify any agents if any of the bystanders look away faster to focus on their target. Winston, in a civilian disguise, notices the crash but pauses to move his head as he quickly turns his eyes to a nearby window reflection to observe the Agent. Because his eye movement could be seen due to his hastily picked sunglasses, Fiona Frost is able to pinpoint him out in the crowd. Winston senses that he has been found out and runs, and Fiona gives chase. With the help of another agent, Red 4, Fiona corners Winston, declaring their 'game of hide-and-seek' over.[6]

With nowhere to run, Winston surrenders. Fiona has Red 4 secure Winston by tying his hands behind his back and cutting open his jacket. After retrieving the stolen files, the agents are concerned that Winston has memorized the intel and begin moving him. However, in that instant, he jumps up, pulls Red 4 down, moves his arms back in front, and puts the agent into a chokehold, holding him hostage. Winston proceeds to tell Fiona to drop the gun and threatens to kill Red 4, but Fiona ignores his threat, saying they are all prepared to die. The WISE Agent disguised as Gascoigne suddenly arrives at the scene, and, using this to his advantage, Winston throws Red 4 at Fiona and jumps down the railing to the level below. After freeing himself with the knife Red 4 dropped, Winston escapes into a nearby sewage pipe.

Winston attacks Loid
Winston attacks Twilight
Inside the sewer, Winston finds SSS agent Yuri Briar and attacks him from behind. Winston knows "Yuri" is actually another WISE agent and sees through his lies as his hasty footsteps gave it away. Looking at the disguise, Winston realizes he has encountered Twilight. He then makes it his goal to reveal Twilight's face and relay it to the SSS, and the two start to fight. While facing resistance from Twilight, Winston comes out on top just as Fiona catches up with them. Before Winston can unmask an unconscious Twilight, a rage-filled Fiona unleashes a forceful stamp of her foot, surprising Winston.[1]

Winston pulls up Loid toward him and holds his head in a position to snap his neck. He orders Fiona to throw away the gun, to which she angrily complies, crushing the gun with her foot. Winston realizes that Twilight holds some importance to Fiona and reminds her that they cannot have any attachments in their work. He then says that he has a rule to never trust or invest anything in anyone, which is what gives him a clear view of everything and makes him strong. Winston tells Fiona that she has no hope of beating him, but Fiona jumps at him with blind rage. Winston can read her attack, but the speed of her punch is so fast that it confuses him and leaves little time for him to properly react, only managing to block it with his arm.

Fiona defeats Winston
Fiona defeats Winston
Fiona lands her punch on Winston, punching his forearm into his face and breaking it and her right arm. Rattled, Winston struggles to get back on his feet. Fiona declares that Winston is weak for his inability to trust anyone, deeming him an empty man meddling with the world for his own amusement. She then says that her belief and thoughts of Twilight make her strong and is why she will not be beaten. Fiona throws a punch at Winston with her left arm but dislocates it when he dodges. However, Fiona twirls from the miss and kicks a powerful blow at Winston with her leg, breaking it and Winston's other arm in the process. Winston is shocked but believes that with Fiona's injuries, he can try making a safe distance away from her. To his surprise, Fiona swings a hook at Winston with her dislocated arm, defeating him.[7]

Fiona almost kills Winston, but Loid stops her. They have the unconscious Winston tied up, and after the WISE Agent arrives, he is carried out of the sewers and taken back to Berlint. The agents discuss how once Winston is in prison, he will make for a good bargaining chip and that they managed to protect their assets in Ostania with his capture.[8]

ADVERTISEMENT

Skills

Resourceful Intellectual: Winston is smart enough to infiltrate enemy reconnaissance, as well as develop escape routes in case of detection and pursuit.

Speed: Winston is fast enough to take down multiple agents without much trouble and run away from persecution by performing various parkour maneuvers.

Trained Combatant: Winston is an exceptionally well-trained spy, able to dispatch a group of armed agents by himself. He is capable of fighting against Twilight, WISE's top field agent and combatant (albeit Twilight was injured from a previous fight).

Winston leaps over Red 4
Winston's athletic ability
Strength: Winston has impressive strength, able to pull a WISE agent in front of him while restrained by grabbing him, leaping over him, then putting him in a chokehold. In another instance, he tried to attack a disguised Twilight by hitting him with a brick. Although Winston missed, he broke the brick from the strong impact against the wall. He later battled against Twilight and emerged victorious, leaving the master spy unconscious and injured (although Twilight was already at a disadvantage due to his physical condition).

Expert Marksman: Winston can shoot several WISE agents while fighting off others in close range. He is also able to throw a knife into a gun muzzle with precise accuracy.

Master of Disguise: Winston is a master of disguise, with his ability to pass off as other people.

Senses and Intuition: Winston is able to detect if he is being observed and can also distinguish the situation of a person by the sound of their footsteps.
ADVERTISEMENT

Relationships

Loid Forger

Having worked together on a mission in the past, Winston has earned the respect of Twilight, but he has never seen the master spy's true face. When Winston reunites with Twilight during the SSS/WISE hunt for him, Winston declares to take off his mask as another "gift" for the SSS and mercilessly defeats him.[1]

Fiona Frost

Fiona and other agents were sent to capture Winston, who was identified as WISE's mole. During a brief moment they managed to corner him, Winston makes a remark to Fiona, expressing his affinity for cold-hearted women. A little later, he began merrily mocking her and the beaten Loid, but his gaiety quickly passed and was replaced by wariness when Fiona showed a furious rage from his actions. This feeling worsened when he was surprised to see Fiona breaking her own body while pummeling him and was eventually defeated by her.[7]

entries.name: Westalian Intelligence
entries.content:
In Spy x Family, WISE is a fictional spy organization that stands for the Westalian Intelligence Services' Eastern-Focused Division. It operates as a covert intelligence agency under the government of Westalis, one of the two rival nations in the series.

Here's a breakdown of what WISE is and what it does:
Country: WISE serves Westalis, a democratic country locked in a tense cold-war-like conflict with Ostania, an authoritarian state.
Mission: Its primary objective is to prevent war between Westalis and Ostania. The agency works behind the scenes to gather intelligence, conduct espionage, and maintain peace.
Focus: The "Eastern-Focused Division" implies that WISE is focused on operations within or concerning Ostania (the Eastern rival country).
Twilight (Loid Forger): The protagonist, Twilight, is WISE’s top agent. His mission, “Operation Strix,” is designed to place him close to a key Ostanian political figure, Donovan Desmond, by creating a fake family and infiltrating an elite school.
In essence, WISE is a Westalian equivalent of a Cold War-era CIA or MI6, operating secretly to neutralize threats and ensure geopolitical stability, particularly through espionage inside enemy territory.

INFORMATION

You and your fellow agents do great deeds that never see the light of day. You are heroes without shadows. You'll earn no medals. Your name will never make it into the papers. But despite that... never forget that everyone else's day-to-day lives are possible because of your blood and sweat.
WISE TO TWILIGHT[1]

Westalian Intelligence is an intelligence agency in Westalis devoted to keeping the peace between it and Ostania. Their main division is the Westalian Intelligence Services' Eastern-Focused Division <WISE> (西国情報局対東課ウェスタリス ジョーホーキョクタイヒガシカ, Wesutarisu Jōhōkyoku Taihigashika?) which "Twilight" works for.


ADVERTISEMENT
Overview


00:00

41:20

Little is known about the organization besides its main goal to maintain the thin veneer of peace between Westalis and Ostania. Some time after the second East-West war, WISE was formed by the Westalian government.[2] Most of what has currently been shown of WISE takes place in Ostania. Whether through espionage, sabotage, wiretapping, and possibly assassinations, the WISE agents work to keep up the peace between the nations by removing anything that could threaten it. As observed from their headquarters in Westalis, they seem to have wide surveillance of various places with their cutting-edge technology.
Presence in Ostania

Episode 14-4
Sylvia Sherwood, WISE's commanding officer in Ostania
WISE has agents embedded throughout Ostania to identify and neutralize any threats that threaten to worsen relations with Westalis. This can range from recovering stolen antiquities from Westalis to stopping unlawful export restrictions. All agents are commanded by a handler, who briefs them on current and future assignments to prevent incidents and watches for signs of restlessness. Within Ostania, Sylvia Sherwood serves as the commanding officer of WISE.

Other tasks that agents also have are gathering intel on their enemies to use against them or confuse them with misinformation.[3] The gathered intel is sent to WISE's headquarters in Westalis, where it is then processed. To gather more information from their enemies, WISE has moles planted in Ostanian intelligence bureaus, where they feed the West with information and secrets. Individuals that also help agents with obtaining intel are informants. Not all informants that work with WISE are strictly affiliated with the agency, with some like Franky Franklin taking a more neutral alignment.

Loid uses the secret elevator to Safe House D
Loid taking a secret elevator to a safe house
Located across Ostania are WISE safe houses, with their headquarters being the Westalis Embassy in the capital city of Berlint. Inside the safe houses are intelligence agents that obtain data and information, which they submit to their handlers. Safe houses are always kept hidden, from underneath a photobooth to inside building interiors, and are often locked behind secret passcodes[4] and facial recognition technology[5]. There are also other places in Ostania that are secretly affiliated with WISE, like the pet shop Kemono Park in Berlint.

Due to a recent spy purge, implied to be the work of the mole Winston Wheeler,[6] a large number of spies have been exposed and captured by Ostania's counter-intelligence agency, the State Security Service, with many of those captees being female agents. As a result, WISE's manpower in Ostania has become short-staffed while operations are damaged, leaving remaining agents like Twilight to take on many extra missions and getting overworked by Sylvia.
Communication

Loid gets an extra mission
Loid reading mission details inside a coin
Meeting with other agents in public is a dangerous task, as doing so carries the risk of both agents being exposed and captured, which is why it is a policy for agents to avoid unnecessary contact.[7] When they do have to make contact, agents use many methods to communicate intel, such as hand signs, Morse code, and lipreading. Intel and secret messages can even be hidden inside coins[8] on food sauce[9]. In the event of an incident, secret codes are shared between agents. For example, "Code 1399" suggests a serious incident.[10]

Twilight hears C Cipher
Example using a cipher by agents
Another way to communicate information is through ciphers. The names of these ciphers are mostly animal-based, with the intended cipher to be used indicated by the sound the animal makes. For example, a cat's meow indicates the use of "C Cipher"[1], and a frog's ribbit indicates "F Cipher." However, because of their similar sounds, it is possible to confuse "F Cipher" for "T Cipher," which stands for toad.[8] In another instance, a cipher can be indicated by the repetition of the first syllable, this cipher being "P Cipher," which uses the "po" syllable.[9]

Operation Strix

Main article: Operation Strix
Following the suspicious death of a Westalian diplomat in Ostania, WISE's higher-ups turn their attention to the National Unity Party's chairman, Donovan Desmond, who they suspect is planning a war. To probe him for any seditious activity, they create Operation "Strix" and assign it to their best agent: Twilight.

Trivia

The logo for WISE features an eye facing east, symbolizing that they are watching the eastern country of Ostania.[11]
The exterior of WISE HQ is based on the SIS Building, which houses the United Kingdom's Secret Intelligence Service (MI6).[12]
To make sure Loid's identity is clear to readers while he is in disguise, Tatsuya Endo usually draws the WISE logo on him to make the distinction.[13] In what appears to be a running joke, in most scenarios, other WISE agents also have the logo somewhere on their outfits, whether it be on earrings, hats, or sunglasses. Even during Loid and Fiona's infiltration of the Campbelldon, their rackets had "WISE" written on them.[14]
In SPY x FAMILY CODE: White, Major Depple was compromised on a photo with a certain woman. She is a disguised agent who appears earlier in the movie during Sylvia's briefing with her agents
