The State Security Service <SSS> (国家保安局こっかほあんきょく, Kokka Hoankyoku?) is a counterintelligence agency in Ostania established to maintain domestic order and which Yor's brother Yuri Briar is a member of.

Their primary objective includes hunting down spies and surveilling the public. Some tactics they use include violence, wiretapping, intimidation, and torture. Due to their reputation, they are widely feared by the public and called the Secret Police (秘密警察ひみつけいさつ, Himitsu Keisatsu?).


ADVERTISEMENT
Overview


00:00

41:20

The organization works as secret police, much like agencies in totalitarian regimes. They view the Westalian Intelligence, journalists, and spies like "Twilight" as their greatest enemies. They are effective at surveilling and capturing enemies, as seen with Franklin Perkin being captured in a matter of days after becoming one of their targets. With the rise of spies in Ostania, citizens can have people they deem suspicious arrested by reporting them to the Secret Police.

Yuri tortures Jim Hayward
Torturing of a suspect
Upon being arrested by the Secret Police, suspects will be subjected to torturous methods in order to reveal any information they might have. Afterward, some suspects are released but kept under close surveillance, blackmailed into becoming their informants, or, if unfortunate enough, will never be seen again.[1]

Officers are typically scouted from other agencies and are expected to keep their membership in the organization a secret, even from their family members.[2] Within the SSS are currently four known divisions from Divisions 1[3] to 4[4].

According to Loid, there are many members in the National Unity Party within the SSS and Ostania's Justice Department.[5] The SSS also appears to have a working relationship with Garden, Ostania's secret assassin organization. However, knowledge of their existence is limited to certain people, particularly Director Wilker and other higher-ups. The SSS offers jobs to Garden by sending them directly to the Shopkeeper, the organization's leader. These jobs can be requests from themselves or political leaders like the prime minister. Although they work together, Garden seems to hold more power compared to the SSS, as they are interested in serving only Ostania and can freely turn down any requests the agency gives them.[6]
ADVERTISEMENT

History

SSS agents violently stop a Red Circus protest
Attack on the Red Circus
The SSS are feared by the public for their work to maintain order within Ostania. When Biddy Squire was killed during a Red Circus protest that went violent, her father, Billy Squire, became marked by the SSS due to his relation to her and fled the country with the help of the Red Circus to escape them.[7]

A year before the first phase of Operation Strix was put in motion, Director Wilker recruited Yuri Briar, who was working at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. When the other members questioned why Wilker brought such a young man into their ranks, he simply stated that he found Yuri "adorable" and "like a cute little puppy."
Introduction Arc

SSS agents arrest a suspicious bachelorette
Arrest of a suspicious woman
During a gossip session between the Berlint City Hall clerks, Camilla tells Yor Briar of an event in which a 30-year-old bachelorette was turned in by her neighbors for being "suspicious" when Yor's age and single status are brought up. Later that day, Yor gets a call from Yuri, who tells her that he might receive a job promotion, but he is unsure about accepting it as he worries that Yor will be left alone. This spurs Yor to find a partner to avoid these suspicions, ease Yuri's mind so he can accept his work promotion, and continue her contract-killing work for Garden.[8]

Secret Police Arc

The Secret Police get word of city hall employee Jim Hayward stealing files from the office and selling them. The Lieutenant and two fellow members arrest him at city hall under suspicion of espionage, and when Jim tries to resist, they knock him unconscious and drag him to their headquarters for questioning. Despite beating and torturing Jim to get his confession, the man refuses to budge. At Wilker's request, Second Lieutenant Yuri Briar takes over the interrogation.

Yuri interrogating Jim
Yuri interrogates Jim about Twilight
Yuri immediately reveals photos of Jim selling the documents (which he forgot to submit), which gets him to talk. Jim reveals that he knows nothing about his dealer, aside from that he was from the West, prompting Yuri to ask if Jim knows anything about the Westalian spy Twilight. The interrogation goes south when Jim triggers Yuri about being disloyal to his family, causing Yuri to beat the man and be late for his visit to the Forgers. On his way to the Forgers' apartment, Yuri gets suspicious of the nature behind Yor's marriage and declares to imprison her husband, Loid, if he harms her.[9]

During Yuri's visit, Loid (who is secretly Twilight) discovers Yuri's true occupation as a member of the SSS after Yuri talks about his work trip, in which he perfectly recites a script from the manual that Ostanian Intelligence agents use for learning deception.[10] Meanwhile, Yuri remains suspicious of Loid and almost threatens to have him executed before leaving. The next morning, Yuri arrives at headquarters and laments not placing bugs in the Forgers' apartment, but quickly retracts the thought after his thoughts run wild. The Lieutenant urges Yuri to get over his sister complex for Yor and focus on their job.[11]

Doggy Crisis Arc

Yuri at Brantz's hotel
Yuri at Minister Brantz's hotel as his escort to the summit
On the day of the East-West ministerial-level summit for peace talks, rumors of a plot to assassinate Westalis's Foreign Minister Brantz spread amongst the intelligence agencies, prompting the SSS to place the conspirators, a group of isolationist students from Berlint University, under their surveillance.[12] As the SSS agents keep an eye on the group, they catch wind of a bomb in the clock tower in the city and investigate it. Meanwhile, to protect Brantz, Yuri and other agents are sent to his hotel as a part of a contingent from the Foreign Ministry to escort him to the summit. Unbeknownst to them, Twilight swapped places with Brantz beforehand, leaving the real minister at the hotel. By the time the SSS realizes Twilight's deceit, they are left to deal with the aftermath of the assassination plot being foiled and the terrorist leader's arrest.[13]

Midterm Exams Arc

The SSS take note of Sylvia Sherwood, a secretary at the Westalis Embassy, and have several agents regularly tail her to check for any suspicious activity. However, they gradually become relaxed by her seemingly mundane schedule, allowing the WISE handler to move freely around Berlint without them noticing.[14]

Campbelldon Tennis Arc

SSS and the fake Lady in the Sun
The SSS unintentionally retrieve a forgery of the Lady in the Sun
The late Ostanian Colonel Erik Zacharis is said to possess the "Zacharis Dossier," a collection of intelligence rumored to "reignite the flames of war" with supposed contents being records of human experimentation performed by Ostania and evidence of P.O.W. massacres by Westalis. The SSS get their hands on intel that the key to finding the dossier is within the Lady in the Sun painting previously owned by Zacharis, as it is rumored to have a secret code. Seeking to obtain the painting and the dossier, the SSS contacts its current owner, Cavi Campbell, who happily relinquishes it to them. However, the actual painting was taken by WISE agents Twilight and Nightfall, who infiltrated Cavi's estate and swapped the original with a forgery that has no secret code shortly before the SSS agents arrived to collect it.[15]

Imperial Scholars Mixer Arc

Checking the guests in the Tower of Wisdom
Checking the guests
With the biannual Imperial Scholars mixer in session at Eden Academy, SSS officers go to the school as security for the event. In addition to the state-of-the-art detection devices and the nature of the venue, the mixer is impossible to be infiltrated by spies.[16]

Some time after the mixer, Yuri and the Lieutenant successfully bust an illicit dealing of MNG data and arrest everyone there after closely surveilling them. Shortly afterward, Yuri is assigned by his superior to investigate Franklin Perkin, who has been writing books and articles being released in Westalis that mock and slander Ostania. Yuri is instructed to secure evidence of Franklin's crime and the identity of his publisher. After a week of surveilling Franklin, Yuri thoroughly completes his assignment and has him and his publisher arrested after catching Franklin sending his manuscript through his workplace at the post office.

Yuri and other SSS agents arrest Franklin
Yuri arrests Franklin Perkin outside his apartment
However, during his investigation, Yuri ends up sympathizing with Franklin's desire to support his family through his work and decides to have Franklin arrested away from the eyes of his father, whom Yuri arranges to receive financial assistance. As he gets taken away, Franklin poses the question of who is the true disgrace to their country between him and Yuri, to which Yuri answers that he would never do anything to cause his family pain. Yuri is later approached by Wilker, who asks if the workload is stressing him, but Yuri assures him that this is the perfect job for him. Yuri visits the Forgers that night and is reassured by Yor's smile that he dutifully works to protect.[17]

Cruise Adventure Arc

SSS and the bomb on the cruise
SSS agents helplessly watch the crew attempt to disarm the bomb
When the cruise ship Princess Lorelei takes off for a three-day, two-night trip, several SSS agents board the ship to monitor the many celebrities and political elites there. On the second night of the trip, the agents are informed by the crew that a bomb has been found in the ship's bilge. While some agents discuss evacuating the ship, others are at the bilge, pleading with the crew to disarm the bomb. A crew member reveals himself to be a former marine and bomb disposal technician (who is actually a disguised Twilight) and offers his help. Despite successfully disarming the bomb, Twilight surmises that there may be more bombs to sink the ship and suggests evacuating the passengers as a precaution. The lead agent rejects this, not wanting to cause a panic and to save face within the organization. He then orders every free agent and the crew to scour the ship for more bombs, starting a covert mission to disarm all the bombs within the ship. After completing their task, Twilight requests that the agents stay on high alert for the remainder of the voyage.[18]

The agents follow these orders and keep watch for any suspicious activity when Princess Lorelei arrives at the resort island on its third and final day. After the voyage, the SSS keeps the failed bombing incident on the ship hidden from the public. Surmising that the bomber's goal was to instigate more conflict between Ostania and Westalis, they suspect that a third country was involved. Despite the organization's suspicions, Sylvia believes that they will inevitably bury the incident to save face.[19]

WISE Arc

Fiona kicks an SSS agent
Nightfall thwarts the SSS's attempt to capture "The Quill"
"The Quill" is a skilled counterfeiter in Berlint. However, his identity was exposed by the SSS in the past, forcing him to stay at home to avoid getting caught by them. One night, the SSS receives a tip that the counterfeiter left his home to visit a club and begin tailing him. When "The Quill" leaves the club, he is made aware of their presence and begins fleeing. The SSS agents attempt to capture him, but they are all defeated by Nightfall, who tipped the SSS as part of her scheme to get "The Quill" to gain her trust and accept her job request.[20]

Red Circus Arc

At headquarters, Wilker receives a report from Division 4 that the current leader of the remnants of the Red Circus, Billy Squire, is commanding a faction in Berlint. Shortly after, the Red Circus makes their move as they kidnap two school buses full of Eden Academy first-graders as hostages.[21] One of the students, Becky Blackbell, has an S.O.S. note thrown out of her bus, which is discovered by passersby and reported to her family at the Blackbell Company.[22] The Blackbells share the details of Becky's note with the SSS, who determine that the Red Circus is behind the kidnappings. The Lieutenant's superior officer orders that the suspects be oppressed and to cover up any information about the incident from the public.[23]

SSS Captain and Police Commander
The SSS Captain at odds with Berlint City Police's commander
The main bus hijacked by Billy Squire is stopped by the Berlint City Police, who attempt to negotiate with the Red Circus for the hostages' safety. An SSS captain and his squad arrive at the crime scene to take over the situation, intending to storm the bus immediately. The police commander is against it and states that they are under orders from the ministry to wait, much to the Captain's irritation. Yuri, whose niece Anya Forger is among the hostages, is forbidden from going by the Lieutenant to prevent being recognized. Yuri insists on going anyway, which leads to him getting tied to a pillar at headquarters. As the SSS tries to locate the second bus, they receive an anonymous tip that a bus possibly containing the other students was seen in the Demforest district. Yuri overhears this and convinces his fellow officers to let him investigate the lead since he has good informants in that area. With this lead, headquarters orders the Captain and his men to be on standby until "Bus B" is found. While they wait, snipers carefully watch the bus and also await orders.

While gathering information and scouring the district, Yuri finds Bus B stashed in a warehouse.[24] After confirming the bus's location, Yuri calls a small team of SSS agents to raid the warehouse. The agents swiftly execute all of the Red Circus members inside and secure the hostages while unscathed, except Yuri, who is shot in the shoulder. With Bus B secured, the Captain is given command of the situation. The Captain proceeds to inform Billy's bus that their comrades are dead and gives them until dawn to surrender. After making his announcement, the Captain prepares a guard regiment to storm the bus at night, tired of playing games with the group.[7]

The hostages rescued from the bus
The SSS and police free the hostages from the bus
To the surprise of everyone, Billy Squire steps out of the bus and surrenders. Billy's comrade Vadim makes a desperate attempt to flee with the bus but is stopped by the police's armored vehicles. When he exits the bus with Anya as his hostage, the Captain orders his men to shoot to kill, but Blackbell family servant Martha Marriott interrupts them by immobilizing Vadim with a taser, after which she rescues Anya.[25] After the Red Circus members are arrested and the safety of all the hostages is confirmed, the Captain orders the information blackout to be lifted.[26] Days after the hijacking, Eden Academy holds a parents' briefing, which does not go well as the SSS is also in attendance, and their presence stops the parents from speaking freely.[27]

Mole Hunt Arc

Yuri and SSS agents arrive at Shellbury
Disguised SSS agents at Shellbury
Winston Wheeler, an Ostanian Intelligence operative embedded in WISE HQ in Westalis as a mole, steals numerous top secret documents from their files before fleeing the agency. To ensure Winston is secured when he returns to Ostania, Wilker holds an emergency summons to order his subordinates to cooperate with Division 4 during this process and to not let WISE interfere.[28] To avoid causing trouble with Westalis due to the stolen files, the government decides not to approve of the operation, forcing the agents to go undercover in Shellbury, where they are to meet with Winston at the local hotel.

The SSS informs Winston and the agents that their signal is a "green tie with a gemstone tiepin." To single out any moles in their ranks, they tell certain branches of their communications division a color for the tiepin but tell each agent a different color. While surveilling the streets, Yuri encounters what he believes to be Winston, who requests to change the meeting location to a park.[29] At the park, "Winston" meets with Captain Gascoigne and his squad and states that their signal was a "green tie with a yellow gemstone tiepin" to confirm his identity. Gascoigne reports the color to Wilker, who quickly identifies Officer Jeffrey as the mole for WISE. The agents then expose the faux Winston as Twilight, who is also after real Winston and the files.

Yuri fights Loid
Yuri fights Twilight
The agents attempt to capture Twilight, but he evades them as he reveals hidden traps around the park. The agents seal off the park's exits but are once again duped by Twilight, who diverts them to the east gate while disguised as Yuri. Meanwhile, the real Yuri is with the Lieutenant and sees his footprint in an area that he has never stepped on. Seeing a sewer just ahead of the footprint, Yuri reports that Twilight may have gone to the sewers. Yuri insists on catching Twilight and descends to the sewers to chase after him while the Lieutenant sends backup to guard the sewer exits. In the sewers, Yuri finds Twilight disguised as him, leading to a fight when he tries to arrest him.[30] Twilight wins the fight but is injured from a gunshot to his right arm by Yuri. He also leaves Yuri alive due to his connection with Yor.

On the surface, Winston is already at the hotel but is suspicious due to never receiving Gascoigne's signal. He then notices Gascoigne leaving the hotel and realizes that WISE has beat them there. Wary of Gascoigne's movements, Winston shadows him in disguise. Unbeknownst to Winston, the Gascoigne he sees is actually a WISE Agent who seeks to lure him out and capture him. The WISE Agent calls his allies to stage a car accident to identify bystanders in the area who are agents. Winston notices the crash but keeps his eyes on "Gascoigne" by moving his eyes to the building across the street to watch him through the reflection of the windows. Nightfall notices this movement and immediately singles out Winston, who begins running upon realizing he has been caught.[31]

Fiona defeats Winston
Winston is defeated by Nightfall
Winston is eventually cornered by Nightfall and another agent, and they retrieve the files from him. As they prepare to have him taken in as he may have memorized its contents, Winston forces himself free and escapes into the sewers with Nightfall in pursuit. In the sewers, Winston finds Twilight and sees through his attempt to trick him. Determined to unmask Twilight, Winston defeats him in combat but is stopped by Nightfall, who overpowers and defeats him. On the other hand, Yuri is found by the Lieutenant and fellow agent Chloe, the latter returning him to the surface for treatment while the former attempts to go after Twilight.[32] However, Twilight and the other WISE agents evade their detection and take the captured Winston to WISE.

While the operation to secure Winston was a failure, both agencies lost a mole, so the SSS decides to consider things a draw with WISE. Upon returning to Berlint, Yuri visits Yor at the Forger home. There, he sees that Loid has also been injured and shares a similar wound with Twilight after observing a slight twitch in his arm. Suspecting that Twilight could be someone close to him, Yuri confronts Loid and checks his arm, only to find nothing.[33]

Chloe saves Yuri
Yuri and Chloe take down the Chicken Circle
While the SSS searches for individuals matching Twilight's injury, Yuri's mood worsens as he laments his losses to Twilight and question his ability to protect his sister. Yuri takes out his frustrations on suspect Bobby Bockle during an interrogation, which worries Chloe. Yuri and Chloe investigate the hideout of Bobby's anti-government group, the Chicken Circle, where Yuri takes down most of the members on his own. Chloe saves Yuri from the final member and literally slaps sense into him to make him realize that he should prove to Yor that he can protect himself. Yuri misunderstands that he must work on his defensive skills and begins to train, much to Chloe's confusion.[34]

Term Break Arc

Franky punches one of the SSS agents
Franky punches an SSS agent
During the winter, the SSS begins cracking down on an information network within Berlint. They capture the informant Latchkey Lachy, who gives them a lead on a fellow informant, a racetrack teller. The officers raid the teller's home and manage to round up more informants from the network, detaining them in a truck. While trying to interrogate the teller, Franky Franklin appears to rescue him. Despite the SSS calling in reinforcements, Franky uses his quick wit, gadgets, and knowledge of the city to fight back against and escape the agents while freeing his fellow informants.[35]

Current Arc

The Lieutenant, Chloe, and SSS officers at a bar
The Lieutenant calls Yuri to drink with his fellow officers
As springtime approaches, Yuri, Chloe, and the Lieutenant are busy interrogating a recent wave of prisoners at headquarters, much to the former's exhaustion. After work, Wilker invites the trio to have steak together to celebrate Yuri's fight with Twilight. Yuri declines, saying he has a date tonight, shocking Chloe, though the Lieutenant correctly guesses it will be with Yor. Later that night, the SSS officers go drinking at a bar. After Wilker leaves, the Lieutenant calls Yuri, who just returned home from his hangout with Yor, to invite him out for bar hopping with their fellow officers. He also jokes that Chloe misses him, which she denies in embarrassment. Yuri accepts the offer and prepares to meet with his co-workers at their usual meeting spot.[36]

Shopkeeper becomes interested in Wilker's third file
The Shopkeeper becomes interested in Wilker's third file
Wilker, accompanied by other officers, drives out to a mansion in the forest to meet with the Shopkeeper. When two officers protest after they are kept from accompanying Wilker to his meeting, he orders them to stand down as the members of Garden could kill them. After attempting to chat with the Shopkeeper, Wilker presents him with a briefcase filled with files for job requests, mostly from Ostania's prime minister. The first two files disinterest the Shopkeeper as they have political agendas. However, he accepts a job to stop poachers from hunting Miteran elk in the southwest forests of Ostania, explaining the historical significance of those lands and how it is a demilitarized zone that could cause friction between East and West. Wilker asks him to consider the other files, but the Shopkeeper rejects him, reminding him that Garden acts in service to the nation, not to a politician. While leaving the mansion with his men, Wilker scoffs at the Shopkeeper, saying that his loyalty is to a dead empire.[6]

The standard uniform of the SSS consists of a dark green peaked visor cap with a glossed black visor, a collared white shirt with a black tie under a dark green jacket, which is fastened with a black belt, dark green pants, and black gloves and boots. The symbol of the SSS is seen as a badge on the cap, while the jackets have marks on its shoulders and notch lapels that indicate their rank. Members also appear to be allowed to wear additional accessories, such as sunglasses and earrings. There also appear to be members of lower ranks who wear dark green side caps instead of the visors that also have the SSS symbol as its cap badge.

The Guard Regiment officers that are introduced in the Red Circus Arc appear to wear camouflage uniforms along with a simple ballistic vest and a belt with several utility pouches. They use titanium helmets and possibly wear balaclavas under them. They are mainly armed with rifles but are also seen with axes, sledgehammers, and ladders, presumably for operations that require breaching buildings or vehicles.

The marks of higher-ranking officers like Wilker[9] and the SSS Superior[17] are yellow with a red stripe in the middle. Some marks have black and white circles that further indicate their rank, with three circles appearing to represent the higher ranks. Lower-ranking members appear to have all-red marks.[9]

In Spy x Family, the SSS, or State Security Service, is the secret police of Ostania, the authoritarian nation opposing Westalis.

Key Facts about the SSS:
Full Name: State Security Service (SSS)
Country: Ostania
Role: The SSS functions like a classic totalitarian secret police agency—similar in spirit to the real-world Stasi (East Germany) or KGB (Soviet Union). They monitor the public, crack down on dissent, and root out spies and traitors.
Targets: The SSS focuses on identifying and eliminating foreign spies (especially WISE agents), suppressing political resistance, and controlling internal unrest.
Notable Member: Yuri Briar, Yor Forger’s younger brother, is a high-ranking officer in the SSS. Ironically, while he is devoted to protecting Ostania and catching spies, he is unaware that his brother-in-law Loid is actually the top spy working against Ostania.
SSS vs WISE:
Feature	WISE (Westalis)	SSS (Ostania)
Nation	Westalis	Ostania
Type	Foreign Intelligence (Espionage)	Secret Police (Domestic Surveillance)
Mission	Prevent war, gather intel	Detect and eliminate threats/spies
Approach	Covert, strategic, manipulative	Authoritarian, strict, ruthless
Notable Member	Loid Forger (Twilight)	Yuri Briar
The tension between WISE and the SSS reflects the larger cold-war themes of distrust, secrecy, and political manipulation that drive the plot of Spy x Family.

The People's Republic of Ostania (東人民共和国オスタニア, Osutania?) is a large country that borders the east of Westalis and the main country where the SPY x FAMILY series takes place. The capital city of Ostania is Berlint.


ADVERTISEMENT
Overview


00:00

41:20

Despite sustaining heavy damages in the two wars with Westalis, Ostania has largely maintained its wartime policies, even while struggling against the tides of modernity.[1] The country promotes its open politics and rapidly developing economy to foreign countries, but this is strongly motivated by propaganda. Its security organization, the State Security Service, openly promotes the arrest of those who spread unfavorable information and facts to other countries, and free speech is strictly controlled. However, as long as one does not transmit information that is detrimental to the state or embarrass it, the people of Ostania can live normal lives with a high level of security and can freely take up jobs and study, depending on their abilities.[1]
History

For many years, Ostania has always had enmity with its neighboring country of Westalis due to cultural and political differences.[2] Eventually, a war broke out with the goal of unifying the two nations.

Military propaganda in Eden Academy
Military propaganda in Eden Academy
During this first East-West war, Ostania held a very patriotic approach to the conflict and pushed their citizens to fight in the war. At Eden Academy, students took mandatory military training courses and could have been punished for sedition if they boycotted them.[3] Additionally, the school held assemblies for the army, who encouraged the youth to join their cause.[4] While the parliament was considering lowering the minimum draft age by two years and deferred drafting for teachers, anti-Westalis propaganda was being spread across Ostania through its radio programs and other means. As the war continued, Ostania participated in many battles, with some being held over the Southern Islands.[5] Many lives were lost during these battles, and Ostania and Westalis stopped fighting after both sides took heavy tolls. At some point after the first war, the two countries agreed to a pact to end conflicts between them.

This peace was short-lived, however, as another war broke out after the Ostanian Army invaded Westalis's eastern provinces and bombed the region of Luwen. While the actual start of the second East-West war and its reasoning are still unknown, it was reported by an Ostanian Foreign Minister that the pact was being reconsidered, and tensions were heating up at the border shortly before the war began.[6] The war was long and brutal, claiming more lives of soldiers and innocent civilians.

Bond receives an injection in Project Apple
Animal experimentation
After the war started, the then-chairman of the National Unity Party, Chapman, was succeeded by Donovan Desmond as Ostania's Prime Minister.[7] Following this succession, Ostania began human experimentations[8] and even had Project Apple, a research project funded by the government to produce highly intelligent animals for military purposes, knowledge that is currently being kept secret from the public. Thanks to the efforts of key figures like Colonel Erik Zacharis meeting with Westalian diplomats, a truce was achieved and the war ended. After the National Unity Party lost power and was replaced by a new government toward the war's end, activities such as the experiments were quickly shut down.[9]

Although the war ended, a thin veneer of peace remains between Westalis and Ostania, with the latter maintaining most of its older wartime policies and still feeling animosity toward the former. As such, with the chance of another war breaking out at any moment, a new conflict in the form of a cold war began, with both nations having intelligence agencies with operatives secretly working within the other's borders in a fierce information war.
ADVERTISEMENT

Biodiversity

Ostania Fauna
Fauna of Ostania
TBA[10][11]
Politics

Ostania appears to have a parliamentary government, as it has a parliament led by a prime minister.

During the first East-West war, the parliament was considering lowering the minimum draft age by two years, and even teachers were deferred from being drafted into the war.[5]

By the time Luwen was invaded by Ostania and thus started the second war, the National Unity Party, a far-right-wing political party and a hardliner against Westalis, was the ruling political party of Ostania. Chairman Chapman, then-Prime Minister, was succeeded by Donovan Desmond in the government[7]. By the end of the war, the National Unity Party was deposed from the ruling position and replaced by a less hawkish party to be in charge of the state administration, resulting in a truce with Westalis. Despite this new age of peace, it was only a thin veneer of it, as tensions between the countries remained hot.

Foreign Ministers Windsor and Brantz Meeting TV
Ostanian Foreign Minister Windsor (right) and Westalian Foreign Minister Brantz's (left) meeting to improve their diplomatic relations
Over ten years after the war, Ostania appears to be taking a conciliatory approach with Westalis, with groups like the Nationalist Party appearing to work toward this path.[12] Foreign ministers from both countries have also made official meetings with one another for peace talks, intending to normalize diplomatic relations. However, many Ostanian citizens do not seek reconciliation, leading to a situation where it is difficult to predict when their discontent will erupt.[1] Some high-ranking Ostanian officials have even gone as far as making unlawful restrictions on exports to Westalis[13] and blackmailing politicians supporting Westalis[14] due to anti-West values. From this tension, attempts to break the two countries' thin veneer of peace have been made, the most recent being by a group of isolationist student terrorists in Berlint.

Many people have defected from Ostania to Westalis, with there even being rumors that people in the southern regions of Ostania have been using the word "picnic" as a code for defecting to Westalis through a third country.[15] Those who have gone from Westalis to Ostania typically go to see their families or pursue a mission of some sort.[16]

As of recently, despite the war ending and Ostania's current administration's efforts for peace, the internal political struggle appears to be leaning toward the right wing once again, greatly affecting the prime minister.[17]
ADVERTISEMENT

Education

Main article: Eden Academy
There are many schools to teach the youth in Ostania, like Fontaine Academy[18], but none are as famous and influential as Eden Academy, a highly prestigious private school for the elites.

For post-secondary, the only known schools are Berlint University and Berlint University of Education, with the latter school having a teaching program for those aspiring to become teachers.
Military

One of the groups in Ostania's army is called the National People's Army Command, of which Bill Watkins's father, Wesley Watkins, is a major.[19] Another is the Army Commissariat, of which Sergei Ostosky was a former officer of.[13] During the first East-West war, the army was known as the Ostanian People's Army.[20] Ostania also has a navy, of which Mr. Green was a former officer of.[21]

Ostania has its own intelligence agency similar to Westalian Intelligence and may have more than just one.[16] One of these agencies may be the Military Intelligence Division, which Colonel Erik Zacharis was part of. Possibly related to the division is the Military Intelligence Special Reconnaissance Regiment.[22]
State Security Service

Main article: State Security Service
The State Security Service, also known as the Secret Police, is the primary security and counterintelligence organization of Ostania.

Women's Combat Battalion

Martha fighting in the war
The Women's Combat Battalion fighting on the front
During the first East-West war, Ostania's officer training program did not initially allow women in their ranks, instead allowing them to join the war effort through the Women's Defense Auxiliary. In this group, the women could help support the military, but they would not be sent near the front lines.[23] However, as the war dragged on and grew more serious as more soldiers died in battle, the higher-ups of the military decided to deploy the women in the Defense Auxiliary to address the loss of morale at the front. Despite only being given basic combat training, the women were placed in a special combat unit to send to the front. This unit was the Women's Combat Battalion, also known as the Special Women's Military Unit, which fought as part of the Ostanian army's 99th Regiment.[4] During a battle to break through the Westalian army's encirclement in the city of Minth, the battalion was wiped out, with some even being killed for attempting to flee. While the battle ended in Ostania's victory, the unit's loss was felt by the soldier's loved ones and was used as propaganda for the war against Westalis. The only soldier from the unit who is known to have survived was Martha Marriott.[24]

ADVERTISEMENT

Underworld

Ostania's underworld consists of all kinds of groups and individuals, from smuggling rings and criminal organizations to informants and counterfeiters. There are also black markets where one can find interesting illegal developments, like former test subject animals.

Leonardo Hapoon Anime Infobox
Leonardo Hapoon, the current Gretcher crime family head
According to the Shopkeeper, the Gretcher crime family managed Ostania's underworld in an honorable fashion for generations. After the second East-West war with Westalis, the family lent their aid to the war victims during a food shortage with the black market they ran. However, in a recent incident, the family head Gram Gretcher and his sons were killed in an internal dispute. In the aftermath, the organization was usurped by Leonardo Hapoon, a man who gained his wealth by befriending pro-war extremists through arms dealing. The last surviving members of the Gretcher family, Gram's daughter Olka and her son, fled to a foreign country to seek asylum shortly after Hapoon came into power. For unknown reasons, Hapoon attempted to have the two killed by placing a 400,000 dalc bounty on both of them. While many hitmen in and out of Ostania gathered to fulfill this task, their efforts were thwarted by assassins from Garden protecting the Gretchers.
Garden

Main article: Garden
Garden is a secret assassination organization in Ostania. Their existence is unknown to all, with only a certain few, even in the State Security Service, aware of them. To others, they are merely an urban legend.[25]

ADVERTISEMENT

Currency

The currency used in Ostania is dalc (ダルク, daruku?), commonly represented as Đ, and pent (ペント, pento?) coins, commonly represented as Ᵽ[26]. 100 pents is equivalent to 1 dalc. 1 dalc is also equivalent to 320 Japanese yen (or 2.20 US dollars) in today's exchange rate.[27]

The design of the dalc bills appear to be the same, as they include a portrait of a gray-haired bearded man on the obverse side and a building and flower on the reverse side, with the colors depending on the value of the banknote. One-dalc bills are pink banknotes, ten-dalc bills are grayish-yellow,[28] one-hundred-dalc bills are blue,[8] and thousand-dalc bills are green.[28] This currency is also used in Westalis[6] and Hugaria[29].

Culture

Berlint in Love Anime Infobox
Berlint in Love on TV
There are a variety of entertainment facilities in Ostania where the government is highly restrictive, as if no citizens would complain if there was food and entertainment. Many are of a high cultural standard and can be enjoyed by both children and adults. On the other hand, there is also a deceptively obvious fact that business tycoons and underground dwellers gather here to hold illegal gambling events where huge sums of money are at stake.[30] A notable drama called Berlint in Love is popular in Ostania, as even elementary first-years know about the series. Entertainment is more developed in Westalis compared to Ostania, so there are so many things that go in and out of style.[27]

Running through the city of Berlint are many streetcars, which are the primary mode of transportation for citizens who do not own a car.[30] Below the streets is the subway system, which commuters like Yor and Yuri take when going home from work.[31][32] When going long distances to other regions, travelers have the option of taking the train.[14][33]
Performing Arts

Despite its oppressive state, Ostania has an advanced art scene. One of the more popular arts in the country is opera singing, which happens to be a tradition for those in Ostania's high society. One of Ostania's most renowned opera singers is Jonas Wellman, whose fame reaches even beyond its borders.

Martha's ballet performance on the theater stage
Ballet performance
Another noteworthy art in Ostania is ballet. Around 49 years ago, there was a prominent ballet troupe in the country called the Marlov Ballet Company.[34] However, during the first war, they disbanded after 17 of its members, including its principal ballerina Johanna, were killed in an air raid while supporting a war-torn Anber.[35] After the first war, many postwar reconstruction charity events were organized. One of the events involved Martha Marriott, who performed ballet on the theater stage while being advertised as a survivor of the Women's Combat Battalion.[36]

Berlint General Hospital (バーリント総合病院そうごうびょういん, Bārinto Sōgōbyōin?) is located in Berlint, Ostania, and the current workplace of Loid Forger for his cover.


ADVERTISEMENT
Description


00:00

41:20

Berlint General Hospital is the longest-established hospital in the capital, and is used by many major Ostanian figures in politics, industry, and the military.

Gerald Gorey watches and eavesdrops on Loid and Fiona at work
Gerald Gorey's following of his co-workers
Loid Forger works in the Psychiatry Department of the hospital as part of his cover story. A number of WISE assets like Fiona Frost are in the hospital to support him and secretly provide him with missions. The Chief Medical Director of the hospital is Gerald Gorey, who dislikes Loid because of his sudden popularity in the hospital and closeness with Fiona. After Loid and Fiona injure themselves on a mission, their handler Sylvia Sherwood briefly fills in for their jobs while they recover, acting as a nurse.

One of the consultation rooms used by Loid contains an emergency escape route hidden behind a bookcase, used when he goes out on missions as Twilight.
ADVERTISEMENT

History

During the second East-West war, Melinda Desmond, the then-First Lady of the country, was a patient at Berlint General Hospital. She appeared to have suffered from some stress as the eyes of the people, as well as other countries, were on the First Family, and she sought help as Donovan Desmond's wife. However, Melinda's experience at the hospital was unwell, as the doctor in charge of her care treated her with great agitation due to the country's mood, and she did not return to the hospital since.

In the present, as part of his civilian cover for Operation Strix, Loid began working at the hospital as a psychiatrist, choosing the profession in the hopes of getting close to Donovan, his target. While he had other career options, Loid chose to work at the hospital, as he could make plenty of opportunities to steal intel and forge connections through many influential figures in Ostania by working there. To support his cover and assign him missions, other WISE assets like Fiona have been placed among the hospital staff. Occasionally, when leaving his family to do spy work, Loid uses his work at the hospital as an excuse. Since arriving at the hospital, Loid has quickly grown popular among the staff and patients of the hospital, even being invited to play golf with its director.
Campbelldon Tennis Arc

Berlint General Hospital staff pampering Anya
The hospital staff pampering Anya
Anya is assigned to investigate an occupation and write a report on it for her social studies project at school. Asking Loid for help, he takes her to Berlint General Hospital. During their tour of the hospital, Anya asks Loid several questions about his profession as a psychiatrist. They also run into the regular staff, who quickly take a liking to Anya, doting on her and giving her snacks. After Loid takes Anya to one of his consultation rooms, he gets a knock on the door from Fiona. Keeping Anya occupied with a sand table, Loid meets with Fiona, who gives him documents for an extra mission.

Anya, who has learned from Loid's thoughts that there is an emergency escape route in the room, locates and ventures through it. Looking through a vent to a room below her, she witnesses a meeting concerning the neuroscience of paranormal perception. She accidentally makes a noise and decides to head back to the room before Loid returns, but realizes that her leg has gotten stuck between some pipes. As she struggles to free herself, her noises cause the doctors to believe they are hearing a ghost. After Anya gets her foot free and quickly hurries back, the doctors decide to keep an open mind when patients speak of ghosts.

Anya's sand table
Anya's work on the sand table
Anya returns just before Loid does and hurriedly makes a mess of the sand table to look like she is playing with it. As the sand table is used to analyze a person's subconscious mind, Loid is utterly shocked by what he sees. Believing that Anya has been stressed since her sudden adoption and blaming himself as a parent and spy for not noticing her feelings, Loid decides that Anya requires immediate care. Wanting to help with her report, Loid takes a look into her notebook, only to find unintelligible scribbles.[1]

Cruise Adventure Arc

The day before Loid leaves for his cruise trip on Princess Lorelei, he apologizes to his co-workers for giving them extra work while he leaves, but they wish him a great time on the cruise, to which he thanks them. Working nearby, Fiona overhears the conversation and is also being watched by Gerald Gorey from the corner.

Fiona happy with her souvenir from Loid
Fiona happy with her gift from Loid
When Loid returns to work after his trip, he gifts his co-workers with souvenirs. He later meets with Fiona at his consultation room, who hands him documents of his patients during his absence. They both ask each other if anything changed while Loid was gone, but with both parties thinking of different things, they say not much happened. To thank Fiona for covering his missions in his place, Loid gives her the bag of leftover souvenirs. Fiona glares at Loid while accepting the gift and thanks him, confusing Loid. When alone, Fiona begins skipping through the hospital's halls, overjoyed with the gift.[2]

Friendship Schemes Arc

Loid is handcuffed
Loid is handcuffed at the hospital
Twilight continues to maintain his cover as Dr. Loid Forger, the well-loved and adored psychiatrist of the hospital. Following Yor's meeting with Melinda Desmond, Loid seeks out any patients connected with Melinda in the hopes of extracting useful information from them. However, Loid learns from Fiona that Gerald will not assign him any patients out of spite and jealousy of Loid's popularity within the hospital. Unbeknown to either of them, Gerald also despises Loid due to his closeness with Fiona. With his past efforts to get on Gerald's good side being a failure, Loid decides to deal with him. Loid puts up with Gerald's schemes to make him a pariah in the hospital and ends up receiving more affection from everyone.

As a last resort, Gerald attempts to call the SSS to report Loid as a spy. However, Loid had planned ahead, using Franky to intercept his phone call. Franky and Fiona help with Loid's plan as they arrive at the hospital disguised as SSS agents. Gerald shows them Loid and accuses him of selling information to Westalis, even planting fake evidence inside his desk. Fiona and Franky pretend to arrest Loid with Gerald present, but the three proceed to expose the director's accusation and his own misdeeds. The faux Secret Police agents pretend to take him away, but Loid makes an impassioned speech to convince them not to arrest Gerald, moving the director and making him indebted to Loid.[3]

Red Circus Arc

Loid holds the first consultation with Thomas Austin
Loid consults Thomas
Thomas Austin, suffering from a series of nightmares, begins to attend consultations with Loid. He believes that his nightmares and other symptoms are caused by his experience with hostage-taking, but his mannerisms make Loid (and an eavesdropping Fiona) think otherwise. After looking into Thomas's background, Loid informs Thomas that the source of his nightmares and fears is his embittered wife, who has become antagonistic toward him as their twenty-year marriage has soured. Deciding to help ease this trauma, Loid has a talk therapy session with Thomas, which proves to be tiresome, making him conclude that authentic marriages are difficult.

After a while, Loid's sessions are beneficial, and Thomas slowly begins to be able to talk to his wife again. Later, he thanks Loid for his help.[4]

Mole Hunt Arc

Loid is called to the hospital to discuss a serious incident under the guise of a medical emergency. On his way there, he is briefly tailed by Yuri and Yor, the former suddenly leaving while the latter follows him all the way there before leaving herself. At the hospital, Fiona informs Loid that a mole in WISE HQ in Westalis has stolen top-secret documents, including Operation Strix. Emphasizing the direness of the situation, Fiona says they must retrieve the documents before Ostania does.[5]

Nurse Sylvia and Fiona
A disguised Sylvia visits the recuperating Fiona
The mission to recover the files from the mole Winston Wheeler is a success, but Fiona returns with heavy injuries after breaking her body in a fight against Winston. Fiona is sent to Berlint General Hospital with the claim of falling down the hospital stairs from the fourth to the first floor. Gerald secures a private room for Fiona, where he fails to spend time with her. Before leaving, he hands Fiona the medical files for VIP patients to be assigned to Loid. Sylvia is also at the hospital as a nurse, forced to fill in for Loid and Fiona for the day while they recover (and also to fulfill her desire to wear a nurse uniform). Sylvia informs Fiona that her injuries are not too severe and that she will be able to return to work in time. Sylvia praises Fiona for completing the mission but instructs her not to push herself so hard, hinting that she knows Fiona's feelings for Twilight. Fiona becomes flustered upon this realization, much to Sylvia's amusement.[6]

Term Break Arc

Since receiving the medical files for VIP patients, Loid has been busy working with both normal and VIP patients. After Berlint's Annual Winter Sheep Festival, the psychiatry department is visited by a surprise VIP drop-in patient: Melinda Desmond. Gerald informs Loid of her visit and says they must show extreme care and discretion with her. He then asks Loid to take care of Melinda, and Loid is more than happy to accept this opportunity.[7]

Melinda tells Loid that Donovan is an alien
"In truth, my husband... is an alien."
Loid cheerfully greets Melinda as her doctor but is confused when she suddenly throws up her hands in defense. Before starting her consultation, Melinda reveals that she came at Yor's urging during the winter festival while also mentioning her wariness of Loid's alleged "concussive therapy." After clearing up the misunderstanding, Loid begins by looking at Melinda's symptoms and tries to help her find their root causes. He senses Melinda's hesitation to open up and encourages her to share her troubles with him, concealing his intentions to get any useful intel for Operation Strix out of her. After some thought, Melinda discloses to Loid her history with the hospital and her desire to change herself. She adds that she is seeking help as a mother and wife, prompting Loid to ask if she is experiencing distress with her family. Melinda suddenly asks Loid if he believes in UFOs, and although it takes him aback, Loid plays along to gauge her reaction and see if she is interested in the topic. After getting nothing, he returns to the topic of her family, asking if there is a connection between them and UFOs. Melinda confirms this, but she astounds Loid as she tells him that Donovan is an alien.[8]

When asked to explain her reasoning, Melinda quickly panics as she worries about Donovan discovering their session. Loid manages to calm Melinda down and believes she is being abused. However, Melinda denies that Donovan has done anything to her, prompting Loid to tell her that harm can come in many forms and that she is obviously suffering from lots of stress to come to the hospital. Melinda agrees with Loid's idea but says it is already too late. She then elaborates on her suspicions of Donovan, saying that between the birth of their two sons, he has somehow been replaced by a telepathic alien. Melinda shares her intense fear of this alien, which has made her unable to protect her sons from it, though when asked if Donovan has ordered her how to interact with their children, she denies it.

Loid gives Melinda a notebook
Loid gives Melinda a notebook to record her experiences with Donovan
To ease her fears, Loid suggests that Melinda calmly talk things out with Donovan. Furthermore, he offers to be a neutral third party to assist her and proposes that she invite her husband to one of their sessions. Melinda is skeptical, but Loid advises her to keep an open mind about discerning the true nature of the changed Donovan. He also asks to see Melinda again for another session before giving her a notebook to journal moments when she felt her mind was being read by her husband. While Melinda believes that Loid thinks she is ill, Loid clarifies that he thinks she is suffering, and he offers his full support toward her recovery for the sake of her and her family. As Melinda leaves the hospital, Loid convenes with Fiona, who had talked with Melinda's attendant, Nola, during the session. While Fiona is sure that Donovan will never come to the hospital, she believes that Melinda may not be lying about his changed nature, though Loid wants to wait for Melinda's examination results before investigating into the matter further.[9]

Fiona's Get-Well Visit

Loid tells a sick Fiona to take it easy
Loid tells Fiona to take it easy
When Fiona suddenly calls in sick at work, Gerald decides to pay her a get-well visit and asks Loid to accompany him, knowing Fiona will not greet him if he is alone. Happening to have intel to pass to Fiona and taking the opportunity to curry favor from Gerald, Loid agrees to go. As they get close to Fiona's home, Loid signals to her to inform her of their arrival, which she hears and quickly tidies herself and her home before greeting them. After rejecting Gerald's advances, Fiona speaks with Loid and says she will return to work later in the afternoon. Fiona then becomes upset as she refuses the urge to cough and sniffle to avoid embarrassing herself in front of Twilight. Picking up on her mood, Loid leaves with Gerald, but not before advising Fiona to rest, which she follows. While returning to the hospital, Loid tells Gerald that leaving when they did is a sign of a truly caring boss.[10]

Westalis (西国ウェスタリス, Wesutarisu?) is a large country that borders the west of Ostania in the SPY x FAMILY series and is Loid Forger's home country. Despite its major role, little is known about Westalis beyond their advanced intelligence agency, WISE.


ADVERTISEMENT
Overview


00:00

41:20

Westalis appears to be a relatively free and open country with positive relations with other Western nations, which is why it is believed that it recovered from the second war faster than Ostania. Seeking further recovery and diplomatic stability, their government has recently focused on defusing any possible strife, while ministers and diplomats have been proactively working to prevent a renewal of hostilities with Ostania.[1]
History

Going back many years, Westalis has always had enmity with its neighboring country of Ostania due to cultural and political differences. Eventually, a war to unify the nations broke out. The first East-West war greatly affected the Westalian civilians and furthered their anti-Ostanian sentiments. Some civilians were even relocated to small villages after their homes were burned down in the war.[2] After both sides took staggering losses, the war would eventually come to a close, and the two countries created a pact to end their conflicts.

Twilight watches his hometown in ruins
Luwen's town square in ruins after the Ostanian army's initial bombing
Despite the seemingly newfound peace, relations between Westalis and Ostania remained tense, which eventually led to another war. Days before this second war began, tensions between the nations appeared to rise once more, as some anti-Ostanian protests in Westalis were held, the Ostanian Foreign Minister said the pact was being reconsidered, and Loid's father left for the border as enmity grew. While the actual start of the war is still unclear, the initial invasion of Westalis's eastern provinces by the Ostanian Army with the bombing of Luwen appears to be the spark that ignited it. Despite the efforts of the Westalis Army to resist the attacks, they could not stop the fall of Luwen, which suffered significant civilian casualties. Other regions, like Kielberg, were also devastated by later bombings.[3]

Sylvia's memory about the war
The ruins of one of the cities during the second war
The second war between the two countries was long and brutal, claiming the lives of many soldiers and innocent civilians. During this time, Westalis committed P.O.W. massacres, knowledge that is currently being kept secret from the public.[4] Due to the efforts of key figures from both nations, the fighting came to an end, and the two countries eventually brokered peace; Ostania's anti-West political party, the National Unity Party, was deposed from its ruling position. Even after that, however, the peace was only a thin veneer as tensions still remained hot between the two countries, with Westalis on guard from Ostania's aggression and appearing to be ready for another conflict should an incident against them from Ostania come to pass. An "iron curtain" was placed to sever them, leading to the beginning of a different war, a cold war.

Many have defected from Ostania to Westalis, with there even being rumors that people in the southern regions of Ostania have been using the word "picnic" as a code for defecting to Westalis through a third country.[5] Defecting to Ostania appears to be a rare occasion, as those who do typically go with the purpose of seeing their families or pursuing a mission of some sort.[6]

Westalis Embassy Anime
The Westalis Embassy in Ostania
On the surface, Westalis appears to be taking a conciliatory approach with Ostania, with foreign ministers from both countries making official meetings with one another for peace talks with the intention of normalizing diplomatic relations, and the Westalis Embassy has been placed in Ostania's capital city of Berlint. In recent events, there have also been discussions of improving East-West relations with things like the cultural exchange event headlined by Jonas Wellman, an Ostanian former opera singer who was an influential figure in both Westalis and Ostania.[7]

Over ten years after the second war's official end, a Westalian diplomat perishes in a car accident in Ostania after crashing through a road barrier. Westalis's intelligence agency, WISE, suspects it was an assassination carried out by the National Unity Party, who they also suspect is plotting another war. As such, they send their best agent, "Twilight," to investigate the party's chairman, Donovan Desmond, leading to the events of the current story.
ADVERTISEMENT

Politics

Not much is known about Westalis's political system, but it likely has a parliamentary government similar to Ostania's, which is also led by a prime minister.

During the second East-West war, Westalis appears to have been led by Prime Minister Adner.[8]
Military

During the second East-West war, Westalis's military force was known as the Westalis Army. Although not much about the force is known, their minimum enlistment age was 18, and soldiers could have been recruited into military intelligence.
Intelligence Agency

Main article: Westalian Intelligence
Westalis has a military intelligence, which has recruited soldiers in the past. Some time after the second war's end, Westalian Intelligence launched a special division solely focused on monitoring activities in Ostania in order to maintain peace between the two countries, calling it WISE.[9] Several members from military intelligence joined the agency, including Sylvia Sherwood and Loid, the latter taking on the code name "Twilight." WISE has many operatives currently working within Ostania, and they have mostly managed to evade the nation's counterintelligence agency, the State Security Service. It can also be assumed that Westalis has its own counterintelligence agency.[6]

ADVERTISEMENT

Currency

The currency used in Westalis is dalc (ダルク, daruku?), commonly represented as Đ, and pent (ペント, pento?) coins, commonly represented as Ᵽ[10]. 100 pents is equivalent to 1 dalc. 1 dalc is also equivalent to 320 Japanese yen (or 2.20 US dollars) in today's exchange rate.[11]

The design of the dalc bills appear to be the same, as they include a portrait of a gray-haired bearded man on the obverse side and a building and flower on the reverse side, with the colors depending on the value of the banknote. One-dalc bills are pink banknotes, ten-dalc bills are grayish-yellow,[12] one-hundred-dalc bills are blue,[4] and thousand-dalc bills are green.[12] This currency is also used in Ostania[3] and Hugaria[13].

Culture

Compared to Ostania, Westalis seems to have a stronger economy.[11] It also appears to have more advanced entertainment that even Ostanian Intelligence agent Winston Wheeler called the books and movies in Ostania dull compared to theirs.[14] Opera singing also appears to be well-liked in Westalis, as Jonas Wellman is popular there and was eagerly expected by Westalis when he announced plans to visit the country for a cultural exchange event.

In the past, many streetcars ran through the region of Luwen, which also held town fairs. The male youth would often roleplay as soldiers, playing with toy helmets and guns while reenacting fights as Ostanians and Westalians.[3]

The Lady Patriots Society (愛国婦人会あいこくふじんかい, Aikoku Fujin-kai?) is a women's group in Berlint, Ostania and which Melinda Desmond and her small, exclusive social circle are a part of. She knew most of its members even before she became the First Lady of Ostania. They partake in all sorts of community activities, including an all-mothers volleyball game and helping organize city events.


ADVERTISEMENT
Overview


00:02

41:20

After the National Unity Party lost power and Donovan Desmond was removed from his post of prime minister, Melinda stopped engaging in politics and began to lead a closed lifestyle. She and four of her friends, each of whom appeared to be wives of important figures in Ostania, joined with other women in the Lady Patriots Society, which allowed them to casually socialize with one another. Melinda also became its current chairwoman of the group.

There appears to be a different section of the group in Ostania, as Melinda and her friends in Berlint regularly played against the "Northside Team" in their volleyball games. In addition to being Ostanian elites, it seems that some women are mothers of children who study at or have graduated from Eden Academy. Melinda never invited strangers to their get-togethers, and Yor Forger became an unexpected exception after she took an interest in her.[1]

The group also participates in city events, like the charity bazaar for disabled veterans[2] and the Winter Sheep Festival[3]. In the case of the charity bazaar, the ladies come to the event every year, working with the Wounded Veterans Association in support of their country's soldiers.

The Lady Patriots Society appears to have a poor reputation with other women outside of their group, with Camilla calling them "busybody old shrews." There also appear to be rumors of the group reporting people who get on their bad side to the SSS. Some of these claims are not baseless, as there are some members who look down on those younger than them, speaking to them with sharp tongues and some even attempting to use physical violence. These actions do not appear to reflect in Melinda, who actively discourages these actions.[2]

This article is about the assassin group titled Garden. For information on the song, see Garden.
The Garden Assassins Syndicate (暗殺組織「ガーデン」, Ansatsu Soshiki Gāden?),[1] simply known as Garden, is an assassin group that operates within Ostania and which Yor Forger works for as "Thorn Princess."


ADVERTISEMENT
Overview


00:02

41:20

As an unofficial paramilitary organization, Garden purges traitors of the country under orders from the shadow government. Little is known about this organization, as their existence is unknown to all, with only a few in the State Security Service aware of them.[2] Garden has supposedly been in Ostania for a long time, and many stories of them are believed to be urban legends, with there even being rumors that one of their soldiers can wipe out an entire military troop.[3]

Yor's Assassin Mission
Yor carrying out an assassination
Most of what is currently known about Garden is through the perspective of Yor, who appears to have been in the organization since she was young and works under the code name "Thorn Princess." Assassin missions are handed out by the Shopkeeper, the organization's leader, who seeks to "help make the world a beautiful place." When handing out missions, he typically does it through a phone call, whether it be at the assassin's home or at their cover workplace. Another method is by personally assigning them at his garden (which itself is at an unknown location).[4]

Yor saves the Gretchers from gun shots
Yor saves her clients
Missions target groups and individuals who are considered traitors to Ostania and are referred to as "clients" or "customers." In preparation for an assassination, "the shop" analyzes their target's capabilities and defenses, leaving the assassin to simply get the job done.[5] In rare cases, an assassin may be tasked with protecting their client, which was Yor's main task during the Cruise Adventure Arc. To not overlap with the assassin's double life, Garden provides them with alibis and cover stories.
Assassins

The assassins of Garden are the organization's main force. They often consider themselves as soldiers, as the Shopkeeper regards their profession as a noble calling, and that they should be proud as any soldier who devotes their life to their country.[6]

Yor and Matthew are going to fight the assassins
Yor and Matthew against other assassins
The two notable assassins from Garden (and the only ones that have currently been shown thus far), Thorn Princess and Matthew McMahon, are shown to be on a higher level than assassins outside their organization, as Thorn Princess, with the support of McMahon, was able to wipe out over 20 enemy assassins in one night. Despite the difference in their power and abilities, they both appear to share similar skills. Naturally, as assassins, they are expert killers. Both are skilled at hiding their presence, able to appear behind people without them noticing. Thorn Princess and McMahon also have sharp accuracy and senses, able to land precise blows regardless of the weapon they are armed with and dodge surprise attacks. Additionally, they are quite skilled at cleaning, which is usually done to clean up the bloody aftermath of an assassination to hide evidence, especially if it involves disposing of a large number of bodies.[7]

The Briar Family (ブライア家, Buraia-ke?) is one of the Ostanian families that suffered during the second war between Ostania and Westalis.


ADVERTISEMENT
History


00:01

41:20

Yor and Yuri happy to have each other
Yor caring for Yuri after their parents' passing
Not much is known about the Briar family's personal history. The Briars lived in Eastern Nielsberg, Ostania, where the mother gave birth to Yor and, seven years later, Yuri. Although the family appeared to have a happy home, it was cut short when Yor and Yuri's parents died during the second East-West war under unknown circumstances, leaving the still-young children to care for themselves. Yor dutifully took on the role of Yuri's caretaker, cooking him food and tending to him when he got sick, regardless of how terrible she was at it.[1] While the siblings were happy to have each other, they were poor and could not afford many things, including finances for Yuri's education. Wanting to protect her little brother's innocence and financially provide for the family, Yor secretly joined Garden, an underground assassin group, under the tutelage of the Shopkeeper.[2] The job proved to pay a lot, as Yor was able to put Yuri in school and buy him the things he wanted.[3]

As the siblings grew older, they eventually moved to the capital city of Berlint, where they continued to live together. Thanks to his smarts, Yuri was able to skip grades and attend college at 14 years old.[4] He later moved away from Yor after accepting an offer from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs[5], after which he was recruited to Ostania's counterintelligence agency, the State Security Service. Meanwhile, Yor became an office clerk at city hall and continued her assassin work.

Yuri meets Loid
Yuri meets his sister's new husband, Loid Forger
During the first phase of Operation Strix, Yuri was expecting a promotion but wanted to hold off on it unless he knew Yor was doing okay on her own and proposed introducing her to someone. For the sake of his job, Yor decided to find a boyfriend and met Loid Forger, and the two agreed to enter a sham marriage together after discovering that they shared similar goals, and so she married into the Forger family. While Yor helped Loid fulfill his goal of enrolling his daughter, Anya, into Eden Academy, she completely forgot to tell Yuri about her marriage. This resulted in Yuri later learning about it through their mutual friend, Dominic. Wanting to know why his sister did not tell him that she got married for an entire year (as Loid backdated it for his goal), Yuri decided to visit Yor to meet Loid for himself and call their marriage into question.
ADVERTISEMENT

Members

The family consists of:

Unnamed mother: The mother of the family who died during the second East-West war when Yor and Yuri were still young.
Unnamed father: The father of the family who also died during the second East-West war.
Yor Briar (currently Forger): The older sister of the family and a Garden assassin.
Yuri Briar: The younger brother of the family and a State Security Service officer.

The Forger Family (フォージャー家, Fōjā-ke?) is a family in Ostania that Agent "Twilight" was tasked to make for Operation Strix.


ADVERTISEMENT
History


00:03

41:20

Loid and Anya

Loid exhausted by Anya
Loid exhausted by Anya's behavior
WISE's top agent, Twilight, receives a new mission that orders him to procure a wife and a child to infiltrate Eden Academy in order to investigate Donovan Desmond. Thus, he began to start a life in Berlint, Ostania, with a new name: Loid Forger. Deciding to secure a child first, he goes to a shady orphanage to look for a child capable of reading and writing. He is introduced to Anya, who impresses him by solving a crossword puzzle all by herself. Impressed by her intellect, he chooses to adopt her. Unbeknownst to him, Anya is a telepath who had read his mind for the answers so he would adopt her. While on a shopping trip, he notices that Anya may not be that smart and considers replacing her. However, she starts to cry and causes a scene, panicking Loid, and he buys her peanuts to calm her down. On their way home, Anya gets tired and asks Loid to carry her. Rattled by her irrational behavior, he borrows books on child-rearing to try and understand her. Loid decides that after his mission is complete, he will send Anya back to the orphanage, saying there is no future for them.

Anya passes the admission exam
Loid and Anya celebrate passing the admission exam
The next day, Loid struggles to get Anya to study. Frustrated, he decides to head out without her, but Anya attempts to follow him until he barricades her inside their home. When Loid returns, he discovers an ambush and that Anya has been kidnapped. While initially considering moving on and replacing Anya, Loid rescues her and remembers his reason for being a spy. He decides that he will not be involving kids in his mission and tries sending Anya to a better orphanage, but relents when she begs to stay with him. After Anya passes Eden's written exam, Loid is genuinely happy and relaxed for the first time in years. However, the two soon learn that in order to attend the interview for the second phase of the enrollment, the applicant requires both the father and mother.

Yor

Loid and Yor agree to help each other
Loid and Yor agree to help each other
Yor Briar, a 27-year-old office clerk at Berlint City Hall who is secretly an assassin working for Garden, decides to look for a partner to bring to a party hosted by her co-worker, Camilla, and ease the mind of her concerned younger brother, Yuri. While visiting the tailor to get her dress mended, she meets Loid and Anya. Both Yor and Loid think of asking the other to be their fake partners to fulfill their respective goals but have reasons not to. Anya reads their minds and complains about not having a mother, prompting Yor to ask Loid about it. After Loid explains his "widowed" status, Yor asks him to attend a party with her as a pretend boyfriend. Loid agrees on the condition that she act as Anya's mother at the school interview, intending on playing the long game with Yor to eventually make her agree to a real marriage. Yor accepts, and the two arrange to meet up on the day of the party.

Loid proposes to Yor
Loid says his vows to Yor
However, an urgent extra mission causes Loid to accidentally stand Yor up, and she goes to the party alone. Loid arrives just as Yor is about to leave and accidentally introduces himself as her husband to her co-workers. When Loid is informed of Yor's suspicious work history by a jealous Camilla, he praises her dedication to work for the sake of someone or something else, which moves her. After leaving the party together, Loid apologizes for his slip-up. Suddenly, they are chased by pursuers from Loid's previous mission. Together, they fight the men off, and Yor proposes to Loid, reasoning that it would be a beneficial cover for the both of them. Loid agrees, and the two get married that night. Afterward, Loid helps Yor move into the Forger home and backdates their marriage by a year, and Anya is happy to meet her new mother. Thus, Yor Briar officially becomes Yor Forger.

Bond

Anya declares to save the day with Bond
Anya and Bond work together to save the future
When Anya earns her first Stella Star, she requests a dog as her reward. Thus, the Forgers go on an outing to find her a dog for Anya. While looking around an adoption center, Anya notices a large white dog outside and sees in his mind a vision of the Forgers, which draws her attention. Anya sneaks away from Yor to follow the dog but gets captured by his owners, a group of terrorists who try to kill her for eavesdropping. After the dog protects Anya and helps her escape, Anya discovers that he has powers like her, as he is able to have visions of the future. After Yor saves Anya from the terrorists, Anya sees the dog having another vision and foresees a terrible future and Loid's death at the clock tower, so she runs away on the canine's back to save him.

Bond joins the Forger Family Anime
Bond joins the Forger family
After covertly saving the future and Loid's life, Anya and the dog return to the pet shop and reunite with Loid and Yor. After Loid thanks the dog for protecting Anya, his handler, Sylvia Sherwood, and another WISE agent arrive to take the dog into their custody. Anya remembers the first vision she saw with her family and refuses, threatening to quit school if she cannot have the dog. Sylvia accepts and tells the family that the dog will be delivered to their house the next day. The next day, the dog arrives at the Forger residence but is hesitant after remembering his past abuse as a military research experiment. In the end, he joins them, and the family welcomes him with a smile. The day after, the dog returns Anya's gloves to her when the family goes to a dog park. This act reminds Anya of a scene from her favorite show and its protagonist, Bondman, so she officially names their dog Bond, thus completing the current Forger family.

ADVERTISEMENT

Members

The family consists of:

Loid Forger: The adoptive father of Anya, who works as a psychiatrist at Berlint General Hospital, while he secretly works as a spy for WISE.
Yor Forger: The mother of the family. She works as a civil servant at Berlint City Hall while moonlighting for an unknown assassin organization known as Garden by the code name "Thorn Princess." Yor thinks Anya is Loid's biological daughter.
Anya Forger: The adopted daughter of Loid and Yor Forger. She was a research experiment used by a certain organization and gained the ability to read minds. After escaping their facility, Anya moved from orphanages multiple times until she met Loid, who adopted her.
Bond Forger: The pet of the family. Similar to Anya, he was used as a military research test subject funded by the previous Ostanian government. After the research project was shut down, Bond found his way into the black market, where he was sold to be a bomb dog. From there, he would eventually meet Anya due to his precognition ability given to him by the experiments.
